jobs.title: Key Account Manager till Securitas
jobs.description:
Företagsbeskrivning

Securitas har en viktig roll i samhället och förvaltar ett av Sveriges viktigaste uppdrag - att skydda och hjälpa människor att känna sig trygga. Nu har du chansen att bli en del av Sveriges största säkerhetsföretag.

Som landets största arbetsgivare i vår bransch kan vi erbjuda dig utvecklingsmöjligheter och variation som få andra företag kan. Vi strävar efter ett enhetligt ledarskap med balans mellan förväntningar och förutsättningar.

Securitas Sverige krigsplacerar sin personal. Detta innebär i korthet att du som anställd kommer, i händelse av krig, ha kvar din anställning och arbetsledas av Securitas.

Du tar hand om människors säkerhet – Securitas tar hand om dig.

Om rollen

Som Key Account Manager på Securitas kliver du in i en verksamhet där säkerhet är kärnan i allt vi gör. Du arbetar med kunder som ofta har komplexa behov, många anläggningar och höga krav på både kvalitet, tillgänglighet och utveckling. Din uppgift är att, tillsammans med våra specialister och driftorganisation, se till att Securitas lösningar verkligen gör skillnad i deras vardag. Du arbetar både strategiskt och operativt med att identifiera nya affärsmöjligheter, bygga långsiktiga relationer och utveckla vår position inom ett område där säkerhet, samhällsnytta och höga krav på kvalitet går hand i hand.

En viktig del av rollen är prospektering och nykundsbearbetning. Du arbetar strukturerat med att kartlägga marknaden, identifiera prioriterade kunder och affärsmöjligheter samt etablera relevanta relationer långt innan en eventuell upphandling annonseras. Du förstår hur komplexa affärer utvecklas över tid och kan navigera i komplexa organisationer med många intressenter, långa beslutsprocesser och tydliga regulatoriska ramar.

Du ansvarar för dina kunders säkerhetslösningar och följer samarbetet från behov och utveckling till avtal, kvalitet och lönsamhet. I praktiken driver du dialogen med kunden, fångar upp nya behov och omsätter Securitas breda erbjudande till konkreta lösningar som skapar trygghet och affärsnytta. Vår portfölj är bred och innefattar bland annat klassisk fysisk bevakning, tekniskt avancerade lösningar och moderna brandskyddstjänster. Din uppgift är att knyta ihop rätt delar och säkerställa en enhetlig och professionell kundupplevelse - oavsett var i landet kunden finns.

Rollen ingår i ett nationellt team med kollegor över hela Sverige. Vi ser gärna att du utgår från något av våra kontor i Stockholm, Göteborg eller Malmö. Resor med övernattning förekommer.

Digitala presentationer är en stor del av rollen, både internt och mot kund. Därför ser vi gärna att du visar lite av din kreativitet redan i din ansökan, till exempel genom hur du utformar ditt CV.

Säkerhetsprövning

Observera att tjänsten är placerad i säkerhetsklass och innebär att du kommer att genomgå en säkerhetsprövning enligt Säkerhetsskyddslag (2018:585). För att utreda och bedöma om du uppfyller kraven för att bli godkänd enligt gällande regelverk kommer det genomföras säkerhetssamtal, bakgrundskontroll och registerkontroll. Bedömningen syftar till att utreda laglydnad, lämplighet, pålitlighet, lojalitet samt eventuella sårbarheter enligt Säkerhetspolisens föreskrifter och vägledningar. Uppgifter som inhämtas kan ex. komma från dig själv, öppna källor eller myndigheter. Vi tillämpar en helhetsbedömning om dig, din livssituation samt ekonomiska förhållanden vid prövning av din lämplighet. I förekommande fall kan motsvarande kontroll göras av den som du sammanbor med, eller har en liknande relation med.

Kravspecifikation

Vi vänder oss till dig som redan kan KAM-hantverket och som vill använda den erfarenheten i en verksamhet där affären är nära kopplad till samhällsnytta.

Du är trygg i att möta stora kunder och har erfarenhet av strategisk kundbearbetning, långsiktiga partnerskap samt arbete med avtal, uppföljning och lönsamhet. Du har lätt för att bygga förtroende över tid och uppskattar att samarbeta med både kundens organisation och interna funktioner. Du är också bekväm med att driva frågor framåt, även när alla ramar inte är helt satta.

Specifikt efterfrågade krav:

    Dokumenterad erfarenhet av B2B-försäljning och relationsbyggande mot större/komplexa kunder
    Erfarenhet av att sälja och utveckla tjänsteerbjudanden
    Erfarenhet av kundrelation, affärsutveckling och konsultativ försäljning (Value Based Selling)
    Dokumenterad erfarenhet av offentlig upphandling och god förståelse för LOU
    Erfarenhet av att utveckla befintliga kunder och driva lönsamhet i portfölj
    Erfarenhet av samarbete med drift och stödfunktioner
    Erfarenhet av att arbeta med behovsanalyser och BI, i CRM-system samt med analys av kunddata
    Relevant akademisk utbildning, alternativt av arbetsgivaren bedömd motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet
    Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska
    B-körkort

Meriterande:

    Erfarenhet från säkerhetsbranschen
    Erfarenhet av försäljning till statliga myndigheter, kommuner, regioner eller andra offentliga verksamheter
    Etablerat nätverk inom offentlig sektor
    Erfarenhet av säkerhetsbranschen eller annan verksamhet med komplexa och samhällskritiska tjänster
    Erfarenhet av större offentliga upphandlingar och komplexa anbudsprocesser

Ytterligare information

Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via vårt rekryteringsverktyg.

Har du frågor kring rollen är du välkommen att höra av dig till rekryterande chef Elin Skarp på elin.skarp@securitas.se.

Har du frågor kring rekryteringsprocessen är du välkommen att höra av dig till rekryterare på julia.olander@securitas.se.

    Tjänsten är en heltidsanställning med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Vi tillämpar 6 mån provanställning
    Placeringsort för tjänsten är flexibel till Stockholm, Göteborg eller Malmö
    Vi kommunicerar i första hand via mail
    Vi använder tester som en del av vårt urval
    Sista ansökningsdag är 30 augusti

För anställning inom Securitas Sverige AB krävs det att du har godkända betyg från gymnasiet i svenska samt blir godkänd av Länsstyrelsen för anställning i auktoriserat bevakningsföretag enligt Lag (1974:191) om bevakningsföretag (den ansökan görs av Securitas). För den här rollen krävs det även att du genomgår en säkerhetsprövning enligt Säkerhetsskyddslag (2018:585).

Lön och anställningsförhållanden baseras på kollektivavtal mellan arbetsgivarorganisationen Säkerhetsföretagen och Unionen samt Ledarna.

Mer info om Securitas som arbetsgivare och hur det är att jobba hos oss hittar du på securitas.se

jobs.title: Kokenut ajoneuvoasentaja monimerkkikorjaamolle (15-17€)
jobs.description:
Haluatko tehdä muutakin kuin perushuoltoa – ja päästä oikeasti käsiksi jakopää- ja moottoriremontteihin modernissa monimerkkikorjaamossa?



Etsimme nyt kokenutta ajoneuvoasentajaa asiakkaamme tiimiin Tampereelle. Tässä roolissa pääset työskentelemään monipuolisten ja vaativampien asennustöiden parissa, itsenäisesti mutta osaavan porukan tukemana.



Tämä rooli sopii sinulle erityisesti, jos:

* sinulla on useamman vuoden kokemus ajoneuvoasentajan työstä

* jakopäät, jakohihnat ja vaativammat remontit ovat sinulle tuttuja

* viihdyt itsenäisessä työssä, mutta arvostat toimivaa tiimiä ympärilläsi

* haluat kehittyä edelleen ja tehdä työsi kunnolla


Mitä työ käytännössä sisältää?

Työpäiväsi koostuvat monipuolisista asennus- ja korjaustöistä, kuten:

* jakohihnan ja jakopään vaihdot

* moottori- ja voimansiirtoremontit

* kolarikorjaukset ja muut vaativammat työt

* vianhaku ja diagnostiikka

* tarvittaessa myös huoltotyöt

Työ on pääosin itsenäistä, mutta et jää yksin – tiimiltä saa aina tarvittaessa jeesiä.



Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

* Palkka: tyypillisesti noin 15-17 €/kk kokemuksestasi riippuen

* Työsuhde: aluksi määräaikainen vuokratyösuhde Worknow'n kautta

* Työympäristö: modernit työvälineet ja siistit tilat

* Urakehitys: mahdollisuus syventää osaamista ja kehittyä uralla

Lisäksi pääset osaksi porukkaa, jossa hommat hoidetaan suoraan ja ilman turhaa säätöä – hyvä fiilis syntyy tekemisestä, ei juhlapuheista.



Kiinnostuitko?

Jenna Vuorinen
p. 040 160 3159
jenna.vuorinen@worknow.fi [jenna.vuorinen@worknow.fi]

Halutessasi voit laittaa lyhyen viestin tai soittaa, niin jutellaan lisää.



Worknow Oy työnantajana

* Nopea ja sujuva rekryprosessi

jobs.title: Svenskunderviser til online undervisning
jobs.description:
Erfaren svenskunderviser søges til online eneundervisning (freelance)

Er du en fagligt stærk og engageret svenskunderviser med solid undervisningserfaring og lyst til at undervise unge og voksne kursister?

International Communication A/S søger en kompetent freelanceunderviser til online eneundervisning i svensk. Vores kursister er både private og erhvervskunder med meget forskellige sproglige forudsætninger, og vi søger derfor en underviser, som er fagligt stærk, fleksibel og god til at tilpasse undervisningen til den enkelte kursists behov.

Stillingen egner sig til dig, som allerede har betydelig undervisningserfaring og trives med selvstændigt ansvar, fleksibilitet og tæt kontakt med kursisterne.

Vi søger en underviser, som:

  • Har en læreruddannelse eller anden relevant sproglig/pædagogisk baggrund.

  • Har minimum 3 års dokumenteret undervisningserfaring.

  • Har solid erfaring med undervisning af unge og voksne.

  • Har erfaring med onlineundervisning og er fortrolig med digitale undervisningsplatforme.

  • Har gode danskkundskaber og kan anvende dansk som støttesprog ved behov.

  • Er stærk i mundtlig formidling og formår at skabe en engagerende, tryg og motiverende undervisning.

  • Har forståelse for svensk kultur og hverdagskommunikation og kan inddrage dette naturligt i undervisningen.

  • Arbejder selvstændigt, struktureret og professionelt.

  • Er fleksibel, positiv og møder kursisterne i øjenhøjde.

Vi tilbyder:

  • En fleksibel freelanceopgave med mulighed for selv at planlægge din undervisningstid.

  • Online eneundervisning af unge og voksne kursister på forskellige niveauer.

  • Samarbejde med en landsdækkende og veletableret sprogkursusvirksomhed med fokus på kvalitet, høj faglighed og personlig kontakt.

  • Løbende freelanceopgaver efter behov.

Er du vores nye underviser?
Kan du se dig selv i ovenstående, hører vi meget gerne fra dig.
Send din ansøgning og CV til jobcv@intcom.dk.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte os.

Om os:
International Communication A/S er en landsdækkende sprogkursusvirksomhed, som tilbyder skræddersyet sprogundervisning på højt niveau til både private og erhvervslivet. Vi arbejder med høj faglig kvalitet, fleksibilitet og engagerede undervisere over hele landet.

jobs.title: Siivouksen kohdevastaava pääkaupunkiseudulle
jobs.description:
RTK-Palvelu Oy on suomalainen kiinteistöpalvelujen monialayhtiö jo 50 vuoden kokemuksella. Yhtiön 3000 ammattilaista antaa asiakkailleen päivittäin mahdollisuuden keskittyä olennaiseen. Olemme aidosti ylpeitä liiketoimintamme jalommasta tarkoituksesta, jonka myötä olemme omistajamme kautta jo vuosikymmenten ajan tukeneet lasten ja nuorten urheilua ja hyvinvointia valtakunnallisesti.

Etsimme osaavaa kohdevastaavaa Helsinkiin

Haemme siivouksen kohdevastaavaa vastaamaan oppilaitoksen ylläpitopalveluista sekä osallistumaan kohteen siivoustyöhön. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät käytännön työ, kohteen arjen sujuvuudesta huolehtiminen sekä palvelun laadun varmistaminen.

Tehtävänkuva ja odotukset

Kohdevastaavana vastaat sinulle nimetyn oppilaitoskohteen päivittäisestä toiminnasta, siivouspalvelun laadusta ja sovittujen tehtävien toteutumisesta. Työhösi kuuluu kiinteistön ylläpitopalveluiden tehtäviä sekä siivoustyötä. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä esihenkilöiden, asiakkaan ja muun palvelutiimin kanssa.

Toivomme sinulta kokemusta puhtaus- ja/tai kiinteistöpalvelualalta. Alan koulutus on tehtävässä eduksi, mutta arvostamme ennen kaikkea osaamista, vastuullista työotetta ja halua kehittää kohteen toimintaa.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää oma-aloitteisuutta, organisointikykyä ja kykyä ottaa vastuuta kokonaisuuksista. Arvostamme hyvää yhteistyökykyä, joustavuutta sekä kykyä toimia muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Olet työssäsi tarkka, käytännönläheinen ja huolehdit siitä, että asiakkaan tilat ovat toimivat, siistit ja turvalliset käyttää.

Tarjoamme sinulle

Pääset osaksi motivoitunutta ja yhteistyökykyistä tiimiä, jossa arvostetaan jokaisen panosta. Yhteisömme ilmapiiri on avoin ja kannustava, mikä luo parhaat mahdolliset edellytykset onnistumiseesi.

Pidämme huolta henkilöstömme osaamisen kehittämisestä sekä työhyvinvoinnista. Pyrimme siihen, että työntekijämme työskentelevät meillä tyytyväisinä ja pitkään.

Panostamme työturvallisuuteen vahvasti – tarjoamme esimerkiksi työturvallisuuskorttikoulutuksia sitä tarvitseville, ja kehitämme turvallisia työskentelytapoja jatkuvasti.

Tarjoamme monipuolisia henkilöstöetuja, jotka tukevat hyvinvointiasi sekä arkeasi – etuihimme kuuluu lounasedun lisäksi muun muassa matkailuun, hyvinvointiin ja autoiluun liittyviä etuja. Virike-edulla haluamme kannustaa sinua liikkumaan ja palautumaan juuri sinulle sopivalla tavalla.

RTK-Palvelu tarjoaa osaajilleen kattavan perehdytyksen ja sisäisten koulutus- ja etenemismahdollisuuksien lisäksi täyden tuen ammattitutkintojen suorittamiseen työn ohessa.

Yrityksessämme vaalitaan hyvää työilmapiiriä ja auttamisen kulttuuria – tukenasi ovat osaavat kollegat ja kannustava esihenkilö.

Meille on myös tärkeää, että viihdyt työssäsi! – vuosittaisessa työvirekyselyssä saimme työntekijäkokemuksesta erinomaisen arvosanan 4,1/5.

Työsuhde

Työsuhde solmitaan toistaiseksi voimassa olevana ja töiden aloitus on sopimuksen mukaan. Työaika tehtävissä on kokoaikainen. Palkkaus tehtävässä on sopimuksen mukaan, aiempi kokemus- ja koulutustaustasi huomioiden. Työsuhteessa sovelletaan kiinteistöalan toimihenkilöitä koskevaa työehtosopimusta.

Tehtävään valitun henkilön on ennen työn alkamista esitettävä rikosrekisteriote lasten kanssa työskentelystä.

Jos koet hyvän työyhteisön olevan sinulle merkityksellinen, viihdyt meillä varmasti!

Lähetä hakemuksesi tai vinkkaa kaverille, toimi kuitenkin mahdollisimman pian, sillä haastattelut aloitetaan jo hakuaikana! (Huomioithan, että emme käsittele sähköpostitse saapuneita hakemuksia.)

Meille on tärkeää, että jokainen voi kokea olevansa arvostettu ja osallinen – siksi panostamme monimuotoisuuteen ja yhdenvertaisuuteen. Huomioimme kaikki hakijat tasapuolisesti ja toivomme hakemuksia erilaisista taustoista tulevilta henkilöiltä.

jobs.title: Dumpperi kuljettaja
jobs.description:
DUMPPERIKULJETTAJA – KONE KULKEE, SINÄ OSAAT!

MaiMed Oy Henkilöstöpalvelut etsii asiakkaalleen osaavaa ja motivoitunutta DUMPPERIKULJETTAJAA!

Etsimme nyt ammattitaitoista dumpperikuljettajaa rakennus- ja maanrakennustyömaille. Jos raskas kalusto on sinulle tuttua, työskentelet turvallisesti ja haluat nähdä oman kädenjälkesi työmaan etenemisessä, tämä tehtävä voi olla juuri sinulle!

Mitä työ pitää sisällään?

Dumpperikuljettajana vastaat materiaalien tehokkaasta ja turvallisesta siirtämisestä työmaalla. Työskentelet osana ammattitaitoista työporukkaa ja huolehdit siitä, että työmaan materiaalivirrat liikkuvat suunnitellusti.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- Dumpperin turvallinen ja tehokas käyttö
- Maa- ja kiviainesten kuljetukset työmaalla
- Kuormaus- ja purkutehtävät
- Työmaan liikenteen ja turvallisuusohjeiden noudattaminen
- Kaluston päivittäiset tarkastukset ja asianmukainen käyttö

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

- Aikaisempaa kokemusta dumpperilla työskentelystä
- Ammattimaista ja huolellista työotetta
- Hyvää työ- ja työturvallisuusasennetta
- Kykyä työskennellä itsenäisesti sekä osana työporukkaa
- Joustavuutta ja luotettavuutta
- Valmiutta fyysisesti vaihtelevaan työympäristöön

Maanrakennusalan kokemus ja muu raskaan kaluston ajokokemus katsotaan eduksi.

Mitä tarjoamme?

MaiMedilla työntekijä ei ole vain numero.

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Työmahdollisuus ympäri Suomea
- Kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen osaamisesi mukaan
- Asianmukaiset työehdot ja perehdytyksen
- Ammattitaitoisen ja mukavan työyhteisön
- Mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa maanrakennusalan tehtävissä
- Luotettavan henkilöstöpalveluyrityksen tuen koko työsuhteen ajan

jobs.title: Elevassistent med kompetens inom NPF
jobs.description:
Arbetsuppgifter

Dina arbetsuppgifter är att finnas som stöd för elever i behov av särskilt stöd på lektioner och raster och du arbetar för att stödja barnens utveckling och kunskaper. I samverkan med annan personal tillser du att alla elever kan tillgodogöra sig undervisningen på bästa sätt.

På en del av din tjänst kommer du att arbeta i skolans fritidshem och det ingår både öppningar och stängningar på fritids.

Vi lägger stort värde i att skapa en trivsam miljö för både elever och personal och förväntar oss att du har samma synsätt.

Du kommer att ha möjlighet till handledning för att kunna utföra ditt uppdrag på bästa sätt.

Vem är du?

Vi söker i första hand dig som är utbildad socialpedagog eller som har annan utbildning som av arbetsgivaren kan anses likvärdig. Vi vill att du har erfarenhet från skolans tidigare år (åk F-3) och har erfarenhet och utbildning med inriktning mot NPF.

Vi söker dig som ser det som en självklarhet att sätta eleven i fokus och få eleven att växa. Du har lätt för att samarbeta, är lyhörd och skapar en god relation med kollegor, elever och föräldrar.

Tidigare arbete i grundskolan (åk F-3) samt i fritidshem är meriterande, på samma sätt som erfarenhet av arbete med elever i behov av extra anpassningar och särskilt stöd är meriterande.

Övrigt

Du ska dela värderingar och förhållningssätt som beskrivs i vår medarbetar- och ledarpolicy.

Utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister ska uppvisas före anställning.  Du kan hämta det på Polisens hemsida. Belastningsregistret - begära utdrag | Polismyndigheten

Då det förekommer arbetsuppgifter som kan komma att kräva signering av specifika dokument

förutsätter tjänsten att du har en privat mobiltelefon där du kan identifiera dig med Mobilt BankID.

För dig med skyddade personuppgifter hänvisar vi till HR-administratör Simon Priebe för vidare information kring hur du ansöker.

Innan anställning behöver du visa upp pass/nationellt id. Har du medborgarskap från ett land utanför EU/EES behöver du också visa upp ditt arbetstillstånd eller uppehållstillstånd. Detta för att vi ska kunna säkra din identitet och din rätt att arbeta i Sverige.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

Tjänsten tillsätts under förutsättning att vederbörliga beslut fattas.

Hässleholms kommun tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning enligt gällande avtal.

Om oss

Barn- och utbildningsförvaltningen ansvarar för kommunens förskolor, grundskolor, gymnasieskolor, anpassad skola och kulturskola. Vi arbetar gemensamt för en lärmiljö där barn, elever och medarbetare lyckas och får bli sitt bästa. Förvaltningens uppdrag är att samordna, planera och stödja de olika verksamheterna samt arbeta för samordning mellan skola och arbetsliv.

Söderparkskolan, centralt belägen i Vinslöv och på gångavstånd från järnvägsstationen, har tre klasser i vardera årskurs F-3. Våra drygt 265 elever kommer från Vinslövs tätort samt den omgivande landsbygden. På skolan finns även ett fritidshem där elever är fördelade på tre avdelningar. Vi erbjuder både elever och pedagoger en arbetsplats i fina och modernt inredda lokaler. Skolbiblioteket är en fantastisk samlingssal för både fritidshem och skola, bemannat med skolbibliotekarie på deltid. Vi har även god tillgång till en digital lärmiljö. Vår utemiljö består av en nyanlagd skolgård med många olika lekytor samt grönytor och naturområden i närheten av skolan.

Hässleholms kommun är en viktig knutpunkt i Sverige. Här möts människor för att leva, uppleva, arbeta och lära i en kommun präglad av nyfikenhet och utveckling. Hos oss får du ett meningsfullt och varierande jobb med utrymme att påverka och ta ansvar. Vi tror på din förmåga att skapa god service för de vi är till för. Tillsammans gör vi varandra bättre!

Välkommen att bli en av oss!

jobs.title: Kotisiivooja Ruovesi
jobs.description:
Haluaisitko tehdä merkityksellistä ja joustavaa osa-aikatyötä apua tarvitsevien sympaattisten asiakkaiden, kuten ikäihmisten kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, eläkeläinen tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden, lasten ja oikeastaan ihan kaiken ikäisten apua tarvitsevien kotipalveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys. Tarjoamme iloa ja turvaa asiakkaidemme arkeen ja mottomme on: autamme kuin omaa äitiämme tai isäämme.

Mikä on helpperi? Helpperi on henkilö, joka tarjoaa arjen apua, seuraa ja/tai tukee kodin puhtaanapidossa omaa nimettyä avustettavaa henkilöä, kuten ikäihmistä. Helpperin työ voi sisältää avustajan tehtäviä, kuten asiakkaan tukemista kaikenlaisissa arjen askareissa, kuten ulkoilussa, kauppareissuilla, roskien viemisessä tai ihan vain kahvitellen yhdessäolon ja jutustelun merkeissä. Etsimme myös avustajien lisäksi siivooja-helppereitä, joiden työtehtäviin kuuluu ammatillinen kotisiivous ja ikkunanpesu. Ajan myötä helpperistä ja asiakkaasta tulee usein jopa ystäviä työskentelyn myötä.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin. Tärkeintä on reipas työote ja aito halu auttaa.

Mitä helpperin työ vaatii? Sitä, että palat halusta auttaa. Avustajan työ ei vaadi muita erityisiä taitoja. Riittää, että haluat viettää aikaa apua tarvitsevien kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa ja helpompaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat. Siivooja-helppereiltä edellytämme kokemusta puhtaanapidon alalta.

Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä? Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

- "Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

- "Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

- "Hembyn yhteisöön kuuluminen."


Helpperinä saat:

- Oman nimetyn asiakkaan, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana

- Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun tai osa-aikatyön ohelle. Tyypillinen työaika on 1-2 kertaa viikossa muutaman tunnin ajan.

- Kilpailukykyisen tuntipalkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset.

- Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro-helpperiksi tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!


Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

jobs.title: AIFM Risk Management, Manager (m/f)
jobs.description:
AIFM Risk Management, Manager

Department: Funds

Company Description

ABOUT IQ-EQ

We're a leading Investor Services group offering end-to-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide.  We employ a global workforce of 5,800+ people across 25 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$750 billion. We work with 13 of the world's top-15 private equity firms.

Our services are underpinned by a Group-wide commitment to ESG and best-in-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in-house experts.      
                                                                              
Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding. 

We're driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities.

Job Description

As a Risk Manager, you will play a pivotal role in overseeing and enhancing the risk management framework for alternative investment funds managed by the AIFM. You will support the Head of Risk Management in leading the risk management team, ensuring robust risk governance, and acting as a key point of contact for senior management, clients, and governing bodies on risk management matters. You will be responsible for the effective identification, assessment, monitoring, and reporting of all material risks, ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and alignment with the firm's risk appetite.

You will:

• Serve as the back-up for the Head of Risk Management, taking over key responsibilities when needed and ensuring continuity of leadership.
• Support the Head of Risk Management in daily team management, including coordination, task allocation, and staff development.
• Support the implementation, maintenance, and regular update of the Risk Management Procedure (RMP), policies, procedures, registers, and framework.
• Assist in identifying applicable risk types, proposing measurement methodologies and limits.
• Support the development, monitoring, and updating of risk profiles for all AIFs under management, ensuring alignment with investment strategies and regulatory standards.
• Assist the team in performing pre-trade investment compliance controls.
• Monitor and regularly review the adequacy of risk indicators.
• Prepare and review quarterly risk management reports for the AIFs. Report material risk issues, breaches, and emerging risks to senior management, risk committees, and governing bodies, and ensure appropriate remediation actions are taken.
• Collaborate with the onboarding team to assess risks of new products and projects, ensuring business growth aligns with the firm's risk appetite.
• Contribute to the preparation of annual CSSF Risk Management reports and Annex IV (AIFMD) reporting.
• Advise internal and external stakeholders on complex risk management matters and regulatory developments affecting Luxembourg investment funds.
• Lead the analysis of new regulations and assess their impact on risk management activities for both funds and the company.

What we offer

• Comprehensive remuneration and pension: motivating financial packages based upon market rates for your role and is proportionate to your qualifications, level of experiences and skills profile
• Wellbeing: additional social benefits
• Flexible working: we recognise the value of working flexibly and want to ensure all employees enjoy an excellent work-life blend. As such, we are open to conversations with employees related to setting up flexible working arrangements.

Qualifications

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field.
• 7+ years of experience in risk management within the asset management or fund industry
• Strong knowledge of Luxembourg AIFM regulatory environment, including SFDR, and alternative investment strategies.
• Fluency in English; additional languages are an asset.
• In-depth knowledge of Annex IV Reporting is highly desirable.
• Advanced IT skills (e.g., VBA, SQL, Python) are a plus.

Additional information

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT

Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.  

There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to oury people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We're committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.

Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees' careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 5,800+ employees - from 94 nationalities, acrosfyts 25 countries - to each achieve their potential.  
Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.

We're committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients' sustainability and success leads to our sustainability and success. We're emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

Manager Accounting - ITAA Certified

Department: Core Team Accounting

Reporting Line: Reports to the Head of Pool in Luxembourg

Role Purpose

The manager acts as a hands-on a technical expert within the Core Team Accounting contributing to high-quality client delivery achieves impact through technical oversight, review, guidance and knowledge transfer.

Tasks (what does the role do on a day-to-day basis) & Responsibilities

1. Technical Oversight and Quality Assurance

- Act as a technical reviewer for accounting deliverables prepared by team members and GCD, including:

• Bookkeeping
• Annual financial statements
• Management and regulatory reporting
• BCL reports
• CIT and VAT returns and related tax calculations

- Ensure that work delivered complies with:

• Applicable accounting standards (BeGAAP, Lux GAAP; IFRS / US GAAP where relevant)
• Internal procedures and quality standards
• Regulatory and client‑specific requirements

- Identify technical risks, inconsistencies, or errors and ensure appropriate remediation.

2. Portfolio and Client Support

- Manage a portfolio of clients (primarily SPVs and alternative investment funds located both in Belgium and in Luxembourg), acting as the technical reference for accounting matters.
- Review accounting output prepared for the portfolio and assist with complex client requests.
- Support clients and internal teams during closing processes, reporting cycles, tax reportings, audits, and exceptional transactions.
- Assist with liquidation processes and structurally complex cases as required.

3. Technical Guidance and Knowledge Transfer

- Provide technical guidance and feedback to Accounting and GCD teams, without exercising line‑management authority.
- Transfer technical knowledge through:

• On‑the‑job guidance
• Targeted trainings on accounting standards, processes, or regulatory topics
• Written guidance, checklists, or technical notes

- Act as a point of escalation for complex technical accounting questions.

4. Cross‑Functional and External Collaboration

- Collaborate closely with Corporate Secretarial, Tax, and other internal departments to ensure consistent and accurate client delivery.
- Maintain professional relationships with external service providers, including auditors, tax advisers, law firms, and banks.
- Support onboarding of new or complex structures by assessing accounting, reporting, and tax implications.

5. Process, Tools, and Continuous Improvement

- Ensure correct and timely use of internal systems and tools (e.g. Navigator WF, Navigator Doc, QICS).
- Verify adherence to internal procedures and participate in process reviews.

The skills required for this role are outlined in the job profile in the MyCareer platform.

Key behaviours we expect to see in this role

• Strong technical accounting expertise and sound professional judgement
• Ability to review, challenge, and validate accounting work
• Clear and pragmatic communication skills, enabling effective knowledge transfer
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality
• Ability to work autonomously while collaborating effectively across teams
• Structured, solution‑oriented approach to complex issues
• Collaborative and approachable, acting as a technical partner
• Proactive in identifying risks, technical gaps, or improvement opportunities
• Takes ownership for technical output and quality of work
• Resilient and organised, able to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
• Reliable technical expert to colleagues, clients, and stakeholders

Requirements

• Education: Bachelor/BAC+5: Accountancy/Business Administration
• At least 6-8 years of experience in Accounting
• Computer/program knowledge: Microsoft office, Demasy
• Strong technical accounting (Lux GAAP) skills are essential, IFRS and US GAAP will be an asset
• Registered with and fully licenced by the Belgian Institute for Tax Advisors and Accountants (ITAA)
Languages: Native French or Dutch, Fluent in English and French/Dutch, any other language would be an advantage

Luxembourg

Job Description & Summary

Pwc Luxembourg is hiring a Senior Associate – Deals (Financial Due Diligence) (m/f/d). What if it was you?  

Your mission: Our Deals (Financial Due Diligence) team supports corporates, private equity houses and financial institutions throughout the transaction lifecycle by providing independent financial insights on buy- and sell-side transactions. You will work within multidisciplinary and international teams on cross-border deals, helping clients understand historical performance, key risks, and value drivers to support informed investment decisions.

As a Senior Associate in Financial Due Diligence, you will take ownership of core workstreams across transactions, working closely with Managers and Directors to deliver high-quality, insight-driven analyses and reports. You will also coordinate junior team members and contribute to client interactions and deliverable preparation.
Depending on business needs, you may also have opportunities to contribute to broader Deals projects, including M&A advisory and Valuations assignments.

Be a part of our team where you will:  

• Lead day-to-day execution of buy-side and sell-side financial due diligence engagements across multiple sectors, with a strong focus on Luxembourg and cross-border transactions;
• Analyze historical and forecast financial performance, including quality of earnings, revenue analysis, margin drivers, net working capital, net debt and cash flow sustainability;
• Perform detailed data analytics and financial reconciliations using large datasets extracted from client systems and data rooms;
• Identify key transaction risks, accounting considerations and potential deal adjustments, and articulate their impact on valuation and SPA mechanisms;
• Prepare clear and concise due diligence reports, executive summaries, dashboards and client presentations highlighting findings and actionable insights;
• Coordinate information requests, manage interactions with management teams and maintain structured communication with other advisors (Tax, Legal, Regulatory, IT, HR, etc.);
• Support discussions on deal structuring topics such as NWC targets, net debt definitions, earn-out mechanisms and SPA financial clauses;
• Coach and review work performed by Associates and Interns, ensuring quality, consistency and timely delivery;
• Contribute to proposal preparation, credentials, market research and internal knowledge sharing initiatives within the Deals practice.

Let's talk about you. If you …  

• Have 3–5+ years of experience in Transaction Services / Financial Due Diligence, Audit with strong deal exposure, or Corporate Finance;
• Possess a strong understanding of financial accounting (IFRS, LUX GAAP) and the key drivers of financial performance;
• Demonstrate advanced analytical skills with the ability to translate complex financial information into clear, practical deal insights;
• Are comfortable interacting with client management teams and presenting findings to senior stakeholders;
• Show strong organizational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple deadlines in fast-paced deal environments;
• Are highly proficient in Excel and PowerPoint; experience with data analytics tools (e.g., Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau) is a strong asset;
• Are fluent in English, with French, Luxembourgish and/or German considered strong advantages; any additional language relevant to the Luxembourg market is a plus;
• Hold a degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics or a related field; professional qualifications (e.g., ACA/ACCA/CPA, CFA) are highly valued.

…You are the candidate we are looking for!

Job Posting End Date

PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,600 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. About the SnT
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust (SnT) at the University of Luxembourg is a leading international research and innovation centre in secure, reliable and trustworthy ICT systems and services.
We play an instrumental role in Europe by fueling innovation through research partnerships with industry, boosting R&D investments leading to economic growth, and attracting highly qualified talent. We look for researchers from diverse academic backgrounds to contribute to our projects in areas such as: Network Security, Information Assurance, Model-driven Security, Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Satellite Systems, Vehicular Networks, and ICT Services & Applications.
The successful candidate will become a member of the Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust within the Signal Processing and Communications Research Group (SIGCOM) under the supervision of Prof. Symeon Chatzinotas at the University of Luxembourg.
Ever-evolving intelligent connectivity systems require increasingly efficient systems to transmit, analyze, and reconstruct high-quality data. The SIGCOM group at SnT conducts research aimed at designing, emulating, and testing new high-performance systems for the future of mobile and satellite communications. Fields of applications range from 6G telecommunications to satellite-based internet connectivity and quantum internet. The SIGCOM group works across the entire spectrum of blue-sky research and applied research to conceive future communication networks. Prospective researchers will find a large and vibrant team of over 100 members fostering a collaborative atmosphere. The group consistently publishes in top 10% venues, approaching 200 papers per year, supported by 60 running research projects.

Your role
• Conduct research and technology transfer in the area of advanced and intelligent wireless communications networks, with emphasis in the next-generation 6G cellular networks and non-terrestrial components
• Have the potential to build/lead a research team within the SIGCOM Research Group at SnT
• SIGCOM conducts research in close collaboration with the industry/government partners and is engaged in a number of European/International projects. The candidate will contribute to the definition, acquisition, and management of research projects together with other faculty or as a principal investigator
• Supervise PhD students in relevant topics with other faculty or as principal supervisor
• Ensure continuity in the laboratory/experimental research activities, international visibility and recruitment efforts
• Design and deliver Bachelor and Master level classes in computer science, wireless communications and/or optical-quantum communications, in the Bachelor in Engineering, or at the Masters belonging to FSTM Faculté des Sciences, des Technologies et de Médecine

The candidate detailed mission is to:
• Acquire, manage and contribute to research, innovations, and technology transfer activities with private and public partners
• Disseminate scientific results in top 10% conferences/journals
• Independently supervise PhD candidates and junior research associates
• Prepare and contribute to European and National research proposals to sustain the group's strategic research

Your profile
• PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics or other relevant field
• At least 4 years of PostDoc research experience in relevant research area(s). Documented research expertise in:
o next-generation wireless communications and networking paradigms, non-terrestrial communications, quantum and optical communications, edge computing, telecom artificial intelligence, multi-functional systems (communications, sensing, positioning, computing), antenna and beamforming design and practical validation of technologies in Lab environment
• Proven track record in carrying a leading role in research project acquisition and project management
• Experience in research collaboration with industrial and international partners
• Experience in supporting PhD candidates in their research

Language requirements: The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired for this position must demonstrate an excellent command of English (C1). The University encourages its staff to learn French or German and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply
Applications should include:
• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable
Additional documents required:
• Research statement and research plan for the next five years, including proposed research projects in the framework of the theme and mission of the profile
• Names, contact information and current position of up to 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you

The University of Luxembourg embraces inclusion, diversity and gender equality as essential for academic excellence. We are fully committed to removing discriminatory barriers in recruitment and career progression and to advance gender balance among academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

jobs.title: Corporate Advisor - Banque des Grandes Entreprises (M/F)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:


Fondée en 1856, la Banque Internationale à Luxembourg (BIL) est la plus ancienne banque universelle du Grand-Duché. Depuis sa création, elle joue un rôle actif dans les principales phases du développement de l'économie luxembourgeoise. Elle exerce aujourd'hui les métiers de banque de détail, banque privée et banque des entreprises et participe aux marchés de capitaux. Avec plus de 2.000 collaborateurs, la Banque est présente au Luxembourg, en Suisse et en Chine.
Acteur majeur de la place financière luxembourgeoise et signataire des « Principles for Responsible Banking » de l'UNEP FI (United Nations Environment Programme Finance Initiative), la BIL s'engage pour la construction d'une économie durable.


Vos responsabilités :  

Gérer et surtout développer activement un portefeuille clients dédié aux « International Companies ».
Fournir une analyse complète et détaillée des entreprises, à la fois sur les plans quantitatif et qualitatif.
Servir de point de contact principal pour les clients au sein de la BIL, assurant une communication fluide avec d'autres parties prenantes de la banque.
Atteindre les objectifs fixés en matière de revenus, coûts, collecte de dépôts et crédits.
Veiller au suivi opérationnel des demandes des clients et des dossiers de crédit.
Évaluer la structure financière des entreprises, suggérer des options d'optimisation et conseiller sur les financements appropriés.
Structurer, négocier et clôturer des opérations de financement complexes, notamment des financements syndiqués et structurés, des financements de type LBO, etc.
Être apte à réaliser des analyses financières complexes et à approfondir l'évaluation des risques de crédit.
Disposer d'une connaissance approfondie des modèles stratégiques majeurs, intégrer les implications macroéconomiques, et avoir une maîtrise de la réglementation bancaire pour prendre des décisions éclairées dans le cadre des opérations de financement.
Collaborer avec les équipes internes, notamment la gestion des risques, la salle des marché, les affaires juridiques et Compliance pour assurer la diligence requise et la structuration appropriée des transactions.
Identifier et évaluer les opportunités de cross-selling, en proposant aux clients des produits tels que des dérivés, des services de trésorerie et des solutions de gestion de fonds.
Intégrer les critères ESG dans les analyses financières et les recommandations, tout en conseillant les clients sur les opportunités et risques liés à l'ESG.
Jouer un rôle proactif dans la collaboration et la formation au sein du département, en partageant des connaissances et en se formant sur des domaines spécialisés.


Vos compétences :

Min. 5 à 10 ans d'expérience dans une fonction similaire.
Formation supérieure (Bac+5 accomplie) en Finance, Gestion d'Entreprises ou Ingénieur de Gestion.
Fort atout : Le candidat dispose déjà d'un réseau européen existant respectivement d'une expérience dans le marché du Corporate Banking à l'échelle européenne.
Expertise avancée en finance d'entreprises : compétence en comptabilité générale et analytique (IFRS / local Gaap), analyse financière, structuration financière, modélisation et évaluation d'entreprise.
Bonnes connaissances en économie et du monde d'affaires bancaire.
Connaissance de la finance de marché. Notions fondamentales en risk management.
Connaissance détaillée de l'environnement économique d'au moins un des pays concernés.
Des notions en sciences, technologies, ingénierie et mathématiques (STEM) et une sensibilisation au développement durable (ESG) sont des atouts.
Maîtrise totale des outils informatiques courants (PowerPoint, Excel, Word).
Orienté client, avec une présentation impeccable, une aisance relationnelle et un bon sens de l'écoute.
Solide compétence en analyse.
Intégrité, éthique professionnelle et discrétion.
Forte inclinaison pour le travail en équipe et la collaboration, ainsi qu'une capacité à partager des connaissances techniques et à former les autres membres de l'équipe.
Ouverture d'esprit et un vif intérêt pour l'innovation.
Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais. La connaissance de l'allemand et du luxembourgeois est un atout majeur.


La BIL offre une large gamme de projets stimulants et un important choix de carrières. Nous vous aiderons à trouver la voie qui répond le plus à vos compétences et à vos attentes. Votre développement personnel est notre priorité et nous vous encourageons à vous impliquer le plus possible pour que votre expérience soit la meilleure.
La BIL est convaincue que la diversité et l'inclusion contribuent à accroître la performance collective de la Banque. Nous nous engageons à créer une culture inclusive qui encourage le développement individuel de nos employés.

NB : le candidat retenu devra délivrer un extrait de casier judiciaire (bulletin n°3); datant de moins de 3 mois, afin de garantir son honorabilité au poste visé compte tenu de la confidentialité des informations à observer dans l'exercice de sa fonction. D'autres documents seront demandés dans le cadre d'un background check.

jobs.title: Business Manager - Finance (M/F)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:


BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.


We are hiring a Business Manager to work directly with the Chief Finance Officer, a member of the Executive Committee.

More than a traditional business support role, this position acts as a strategic advisor and internal consultant to the CFO. You will tackle complex business challenges, drive transformation initiatives, support executive decision-making, and work across the organization to deliver strategic outcomes.

This is a unique opportunity for a former consultant or strategy professional seeking direct exposure to executive leadership and the ability to influence the direction of a leading financial institution.


Your next challenge:


1. Strategy Advisory & Information Management

Act as a trusted sparring partner to the CFO on strategic, organizational and business topics.
Structure complex topics, challenge assumptions, and prepare forward-looking positions.
Monitor internal and external developments (e.g. market trends, industry shifts, regulatory changes, finance trends) and flag relevant risks or opportunities.
Research and prepare materials, briefings, and presentations on diverse topics - either proactively or at the Executive's request.


2. Operational Support & Execution

Prepare high-quality content (slides, briefings, memos) and coordinate inputs from across the business line.
Ensure the Executive is fully briefed for meetings and urgent topics.
Coordinate and participate in meetings, taskforces, and workgroups - internally and externally - ensuring follow-up on action items.
Synthesize workshop documentation and ensure the Executive is always well-prepared.


3. Stakeholder Management & Communication

Act as a trusted liaison between the Executive and internal/external stakeholders.
Build a strong network within the Executive's departments and across the bank.
Facilitate alignment, cascade key messages, and ensure two-way communication across N-1/N-2 levels.
Identify conflicts, flag issues for intervention, and engage in brainstorming sessions with the Executive.


4. Project Leadership

Independently lead and drive complex, high-stakes projects aligned with the Executive's strategic priorities.
Take ownership of key issues before escalation and proactively propose solutions.
Demonstrate initiative, problem-solving, and leadership readiness.
Deepen your business acumen and gain a comprehensive understanding of the business line's functioning.
Act as an internal consultant on key business priorities, including organisational transformation, operating model improvements and strategic initiatives.


Your skills:

Master's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering - or equivalent.
Minimum 6 years of experience in strategy consulting, banking, finance or a relevant strategic role, with a strong preference for candidates having gained experience in a top-tier consulting firm or a comparable strategic advisory, transformation or Chief of Staff environment.
Strong analytical skills and advanced Excel proficiency.
Solid understanding of finance.
Fluent in French and English; additional languages are a plus.
Strong knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and project management.
Excellent communication and presentation skills: Ability to convey complex information clearly and persuasively in both written and verbal formats. This includes preparing and delivering impactful presentations to diverse audiences, ensuring clarity and strategic alignment.
Politically astute, discreet, and capable of navigating complex stakeholder environments.
Dynamic, proactive, and willing to go the extra mile.
Solution-oriented with complex problem-solving and critical thinking skills.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

About the FSTM
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Faculty of Science, Technology and Medicine (FSTM) at the University of Luxembourg contributes multidisciplinary expertise in the fields of Mathematics, Physics, Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences and Medicine.
Through its dual mission of teaching and research, the FSTM seeks to generate and disseminate knowledge and train new generations of responsible citizens in order to better understand, explain and advance society and the environment we live in.
Within the FSTM, the Department of Health, Medicine and Life Sciences (DHML) coordinates all teaching programmes in life in sciences, medicine, nursing, radiology and midwifery. The department's research combines basic and translational, molecular and computational approaches, with a particular focus on cancer biology, while also encompassing clinical research in human health and disease.
The DHML cooperates with the national health care centers and leading international biomedical research institutions. As medicine and health are strategic priorities for the University of Luxembourg, the department is actively expanding its education and research activities in these fields, providing exceptional opportunities for medical and biomedical initiatives.

Your role
The position focuses on innovative, interdisciplinary teaching in public health at the bachelor's level and within health-related specialization programmes. The recruited professor will establish teaching and expertise in areas such as epidemiology, health systems, disease prevention, and health policy.
The successful candidate will lead the development and coordination of public health teaching activities across the University's programmes in medicine, nursing sciences, and midwifery. The role includes the implementation of a state-of-the-art public health curriculum, incorporating advanced educational tools such as digital learning platforms, data-driven health simulations, case-based learning, and interactive policy analysis. Working closely with faculty members and clinical partners, the successful candidate will ensure an integrated and cohesive learning experience for students.

Research Portfolio
The candidate is expected to have an internationally recognised research profile and to bring a coherent research programme in public health. The candidate will develop and lead an ambitious research agenda in areas such as population health, primary care, prevention, health systems, epidemiology, health inequalities, data driven health sciences, and digital health.

Policy and Practice Integration
The ideal candidate will have a strong background in public health research and/or practice, with a commitment to integrating real-world perspectives into education. This will enhance the practical application of public health principles in healthcare and policy contexts. The possibility of maintaining collaborative activities with national health authorities or international organizations may be considered, depending on the candidate's profile and institutional partnerships.

For further information about the role, please contact: Serge Haan, Head of DHML, Email: serge.haan@uni.lu


Your profile
• MD/PhD or PhD in Public Health, Epidemiology, Health Systems, or a closely related field. An MD is considered an asset
• Extensive experience in public health research and/or practice, ideally with a strong track record in population health, primary care, health policy, or health systems analysis
• Substantial teaching experience in public health, epidemiology, or health sciences at undergraduate and/or postgraduate levels, preferably within medical, nursing, or life sciences programs
• Proven commitment to interdisciplinary and innovative teaching, particularly in integrating public health with medicine, life sciences, and nursing
• Demonstrated ability to design and implement new educational courses, including modules on health systems, epidemiology, and preventive strategies
• Familiarity with modern teaching methods and tools, such as online learning platforms, simulation-based training, data-driven case studies, and interactive policy analysis

Language requirements
The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired on this position must be proficient in English and either French or German. However, a strong command of French is considered a significant asset. The University encourages its staff to learn the other language and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply
Applications should include:
• Cover letter, to be addressed to Serge Haan, Head of DHML
• CV, including any periods of absence from work such as family-related leave and career breaks

The University | About us...
The University of Luxembourg aspires to be a world-class research university. It strives for excellence in both fundamental and applied research, and in education. It drives innovation for society, has a high proportion of graduate students, and intertwines research, teaching and societal impact.
The University of Luxembourg has the profile of a research university with a strong activity in research, a high proportion of doctoral candidates and success in internationally competitive third-party funding, combined with excellent research-driven teaching throughout the University. The University has three missions: research, higher education and contribution to the social, cultural and economic development of the country.
The Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences (FHSE) brings together expertise from the humanities, linguistics, cognitive sciences, social and educational sciences. People from across 20 disciplines are working within the Faculty. Along with the disciplinary approach a very ambitious interdisciplinary research culture has been developed.
The faculty's research and teaching focuses on social, economic, political and educational issues with the common goal of contributing to an inclusive, open and resourceful society. The FHSE offers 7 Bachelor and 20 Master degrees and a doctoral school providing students with the necessary knowledge and high-qualified skills to succeed in their future career.

Your Role...
The holder of the position will be a member of the Department of Education and Social Work within the Faculty of Humanities, Education and Social Sciences.
She/he is expected to:
• Develop and maintain research activities — with national embedding and of (inter)national relevance — explicitly focusing on school management and school development in fundamental education (e.g. pedagogical leadership, organisational management and change management, implementation of educational policies on the ground, quality development and assurance, communication and collaboration, professional competencies and continuing professional development, data and assessment literacy), possibly including the leveraging of digital opportunities (e.g., collaborative technologies), thus identifying and (further) developing best practices that can feed back into both teacher training and the school system;
• Exercise leadership internally and externally both in their field of knowledge and, as a leading educationist, apply their general knowledge and skills as a researcher and scholar;
• Develop and sustain the scale and quality of teaching and learning in the full range of the Faculty's study programmes in Education;
• Undertake tutoring and internship supervision of BScE and BFP students, and engage with national education actors and stakeholders;
• Undertake doctoral and post-doctoral supervision and mentoring, further contributing to the development of doctoral education and training; and
• Undertake leadership roles that ensure that the Faculty further strengthens its position as a leading European multicultural and multilingual site of research and teaching in the field of educational and social sciences.

Teaching areas
The holder will mainly be teaching in the Bachelor en Sciences de l'Education, the new Bachelor en Formation Pédagogique and the new Master in School Management and Development (Master en Gestion et Développement des Ecoles).
The holder will also lead the new Master in School Management and Development (Master en Gestion et Développement des Ecoles).

• PhD in educational sciences or a closely related field (a multi/interdisciplinary research profile is particularly welcome);

• An outstanding research record in educational and social sciences;
• International research and teaching experience (teaching experience in basic training and/or specialisation programmes for fundamental school teachers is an advantage);

• Knowledge of and familiarity with Luxembourg's multilingual educational system and its actors is considered an advantage;

As part of ArcelorMittal Group International Mobility Team, your mission will be to manage the full mobility cycle for expatriations, secondments or short terms assignments. You will work in close cooperation with HR coordinators, local C&B teams and local HR administrators in charge of the logistical elements of the relocations.

• Provide mobility-related expertise, consultation and cost estimates to HR and other key stakeholders. Check the consequences of the transfer in terms of personal income tax, pension and social security and payroll compliance

It's stimulating work in a supportive and diverse team environment. You'll work with inspiring and passionate people. We'll equip you with new capabilities. You can enrol in the ArcelorMittal University and mentoring programmes to develop new skills, knowledge, and fresh perspectives. You also have unlimited access to the ArcelorMittal Learning Platform to boost your development.

• Master's Degree in Law, Tax, Finance or equivalent

The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.

The LCEL focuses on the interdisciplinary field of European law and uses to full capacity its proximity to key EU institutions in Luxembourg. The new Interdisciplinary Centre (IC) will combine academic excellence and strategic research with impact. The IC will reflect in its strategic focus the European political agenda of a dual (digital and green) transition and topics related to European sovereignty.

Complementing the library landscape, the Luxembourg Centre for European Law library, located in the Weicker building (Kirchberg), supports research and teaching activities by providing specialised resources in European Union law, public and private law, and related areas, and by acting as a central hub for scholars, students and practitioners interested in European and international legal studies.

The librarian recruited for this position will be based primarily in Weicker, working in close collaboration with colleagues in the LLC and other University areas You will join a committed, international team of more than 35 library and information professionals who are engaged to delivering high-quality services, collections, research support and innovating to meet user needs.

As a Librarian, you will be part of the team providing direct support to users in the University libraries. Your main focus will be on user services and information support, complemented by training and guidance in using documentary or information resources.

• Welcome and advise users at the library front desk (and via e-mail or phone), providing a professional, service-oriented first contact

• Keep informed about developments in librarianship and in the University's teaching and research areas and integrate this into daily service

Your profile

• Bachelor's degree in Library and Information Science, Documentation or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
• At least 2 years of relevant experience, preferably in an academic or specialised library
• Good knowledge of front office library services and ability to coordinate daily service processes
• Familiarity with library management systems and discovery tools; comfortable working with online databases and digital resources; knowledge Alma is a strong asset

Language Requirements: Excellent command of English (C1) and very good command in at least one of French or German (B2); knowledge of Luxembourgish or any other language at any level would be considered an asset.

jobs.title: Data Management Senior Officer (m/f)
jobs.description:
Data Management Senior Officer
Locations Luxembourg
Time type Full time
Job requisition id JR000687

Arendt & Medernach is the leading independent business law firm in Luxembourg with over 800 professionals. The firm's international team of more than 450 legal experts represents Luxembourg and foreign clients in all areas of Luxembourg business law from its main office in Luxembourg and representative offices in Frankfurt, Hong Kong, London, New York, and Paris.

Our service to clients is differentiated by the end-to-end specialist advice we offer, covering all legal, regulatory, taxation, and advisory aspects of doing business in Luxembourg.

Our firm advises international and domestic clients in all areas of business law relevant to their business activities, ranging from fund formation, banking, insurance, private equity, and real estate to corporate and tax matters.

Given the ongoing development of our firm, we are currently recruiting:
‎
Senior Data Management Officer (DMO)

Your Role:

You will join the Data Management Office (DMO) and play a key role in driving its implementation, governance and continuous development. The DMO has a broader remit covering the quality, integrity and lifecycle management of Client, Payor, Matter and related master data across the firm. Your responsibilities include:

• Driving the design, rollout and continuous improvement of the DMO operating model, including scope, roles, controls, governance routines and interfaces with other departments;
• Defining, maintaining and enforcing firm-wide standards for Client, Payor, Matter and related master data, including validation rules, ownership principles and escalation paths;
• Overseeing the DMO contribution to the redesigned Central Business Intake process and ensuring that key information is validated before being introduced or amended in the firm's systems;
• Designing and supervising centralised processes for entity lifecycle management in our ERP, including legal name changes, address changes, corporate actions, record inactivation, mergers and other third-party data events;
• Leading duplicate prevention, analysis and clean-up initiatives, prioritising remediation backlogs and coordinating stakeholders to address root causes;
• Structuring and leading third-party data enrichment activities, including VAT ID, EUID, business register ID and other identifiers required for reliable operations, compliance, billing and reporting;
• Coordinating with owners of satellite applications to ensure that major master data changes are shared and reflected consistently across systems;
• Leading or contributing to transformation projects impacting master datas, including requirements definition, testing, deployment, adoption and post-implementation follow-up;
• Creating and maintaining DMO procedures, working instructions, control checklists, data dictionaries, accountability matrices, training materials, KPIs and management reporting;
• Coaching DMO Officer(s), reviewing complex cases and promoting a culture of data accuracy, accountability and continuous improvement.

Your Profile:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent experience, in finance operations, data governance, process management, business transformation or a comparable field;
• You have significant experience in master data management, data quality, data governance, process excellence or cross-functional operations;
• You have proven experience leading implementation, data clean-up, operating model or transformation projects;
• You are able to define standards, controls, KPIs, procedures and practical governance routines;
• You combine strong analytical and documentation skills with a pragmatic approach to implementation;
• You have excellent stakeholder management and communication skills and are comfortable facilitating workshops across departments;
• You are able to influence without direct authority while maintaining independence, objectivity and governance discipline;
• You have a good understanding of ERP, CRM, compliance and finance data flows; knowledge of Elite is a strong asset;
• You are fluent in English; French and/or German are considered an asset

We Offer:

• Excellent career development opportunities with tailor-made internal training focused on both technical and soft skills;
• An entrepreneurial work culture where we promote talent & ideas;
• Multicultural, diverse teams encouraging collaborative work;
• The opportunity to work and interact within a wide network of specialists; and
• A hybrid working environment offering flexibility and the possibility to work from home.
‎
Within Arendt, we uphold high standards. Our professionals work with clients on engaging projects, empowered from the start. With a strong local presence in Luxembourg and international reach, we support and train our team members to thrive in a culture of excellence. Specialised teams ensure the right skills are available, allowing for a focus on added value. Our leaders are approachable, providing support and mentoring.

We offer a vibrant social life with numerous events, embracing sports and art, our culture encourages openness and discovery beyond the professional realm.
