jobs.title: EY-Parthenon Engagement Manager | Carve-out | Strategy & Execution
jobs.description:
The opportunity



At EY-Parthenon, our unique combination of transformative strategy, transactions, tax and corporate finance delivers real-world value – solutions that work in practice, not just on paper. Benefiting from EY’s full spectrum of services, we’ve reimagined strategic consulting to work in a world of increasing complexity. With deep functional and sector expertise, paired with innovative AI-powered technology and an investor mindset, we partner with CEOs, boards, private equity and governments every step of the way.



EY-Parthenon is looking for an Engagement Manager with significant experience from operational related M&A projects, specifically within carve-outs. The role is part of our Nordic practice and can be based in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Oslo, Copenhagen, or Helsinki, working closely with colleagues and clients across the region.





Your key responsibilities



As an Engagement Manager in EY-Parthenon’s dedicated carve-out practice, you will play a pivotal role in helping clients navigate complex carve-out transactions and separation programs. Working across the full deal lifecycle, from pre-sign strategy and diligence through post-sign execution, you will support both buy-side and sell-side engagements.



In this role, you will help organizations make critical decisions that shape business performance, operational readiness, and long-term value creation. You will work closely with leading corporates and investors on high-profile, complex transactions, while also contributing to the continued growth and evolution of our market-leading carve-out practice, capabilities, and team. Some of the key responsibilities include;



    Leading buy- and sell-side carve-out engagements from pursuit and scoping through delivery and client management
    Driving carve-out analyses, standalone operating model design, cost assessments, separation planning, and TSA scoping
    Establishing and leading Separation Management Offices for Day 1 and IPO readiness programs
    Supporting the development and expansion of our carve-out offering
    Mentoring junior team members and fostering an inclusive, high-performance team culture





Skills and attributes for success



    Proven experience leading carve-out and separation programs across the deal lifecycle, gained within strategy consulting, transaction advisory, corporate development, M&A, or a related environment.
    Strong understanding of operational M&A and value creation, with the ability to translate complex transaction challenges into actionable solutions.
    Master’s degree in business and economics, Engineering or equivalent
    Great communication skills, both verbal and written, in English and preferably Swedish or another Nordic language
    Ability to structure and solve complex problems and communicate effectively with senior stakeholders





Ideally, you’ll also



    Have experience from post-signing related activities, including sign-to-close planning, cutover planning, and PMO / Deal team support throughout the transaction life cycle
    Experience from other technical separation related topics, including vendor and/or customer contract separation, legal entity structuring and optimization
    Have experience leading value creation related projects, both identification and quantification as well as execution
    Being a team player with the ability to build effective relationships at all levels in EY and with clients, both in the Nordics and internationally





What We Look For



    An agile, business and growth-oriented mindset. We’re looking for innovative individuals who can work in an agile way and adapt to a changing business environment
    Curiosity and a purpose-driven approach. We seek people who see opportunities instead of challenges and ask better questions to build a better working world
    Inclusivity. We value individuals who embrace diverse perspectives and work inclusively to build safety and trust





What we offer you



You will join a collaborative and entrepreneurial team environment where you will receive significant responsibility early on and you could develop rapidly as a professional. By joining our team, we offer:

    Opportunity to work on complex and high-impact engagements with leading Nordic and international clients in high-stakes transactions environments
    High-performing, inclusive, collaborative, fun, and entrepreneurial team culture
    Modern offices in central locations in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Oslo, Copenhagen, or Helsinki, and flexible ways of working as part of our Nordic Hybrid Model.

Learn more about careers at EY-Parthenon.





Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.



The application deadline is August 30th, 2026. We will review your application before the summer vacations and start the interviewing process during August. For inquiries about the position, contact Viktor Köpman at viktor.kopman@parthenon.ey.com, and for recruitment process questions, reach out to Simon Aspler at simon.aspler@se.ey.com.



Note that a background check will be conducted as part of the recruitment process.



At EY, we celebrate diversity and encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds. If you have any questions, require assistance, or need adjustments to the recruitment process due to a disability, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at recruitmentsweden@se.ey.com. We are here to support you.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

Haemme avustajaa osa-aikaiseen työhön avustamaan sympaattista asiakastamme Valkeakoskelle. Käynnit 2 kertaa viikossa.

Haluaisitko tehdä hoiva-avustajan työtä osa-aikaisesti, kiireettömästi ja ilman sairaanhoidollisia työtehtäviä sympaattisten asiakkaiden kanssa? Saatat olet tuleva hoitaja-helpperimme! Olit sitten opiskelija, kerryttänyt jo kokemusta hoiva-avustajana tai etsit muuten vain osa-aikatyötä, tässä roolissa ratkaisee innokkuus ja aito halu auttaa suurella sydämellä!

Me olemme Hemby, ikääntyneiden palveluita rohkeasti uudistava yritys, joka tarjoaa iloa ja turvaa ikäihmisten arkeen. Mottomme on: autamme ikääntyviä kuin omaa äitiämme.

Kasvamme jatkuvasti ja etsimme lisää hoiva-avustajan koulutuksen omaavia helppereitä tiimiimme. Löydät lyhyen ja helposti täytettävän hakulomakkeemme täältä: https://helpper.hemby.fi/apply

**Mitä helpperiltä vaaditaan?**

Helppereiltä ei vaadita sote-alan kokemusta tai tutkintoa. Tärkeää on, että palat halusta auttaa ja sinulla on reipas työote. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat myös hyvin joustavat.

Helpperin työtä voivat tehdä kaikki yli 18-vuotiaat opiskelijoista eläkeläisiin.

Tärkeintä on, että haluat viettää aikaa ikäihmisten kanssa ja tehdä omalla toiminnallasi heidän arjestaan parempaa. Työtä voi tehdä oman tilanteen mukaan ja työajat ovat hyvin joustavat.

**Mikä on parasta helpperin työssä?**

Kysyimme tätä helppereiltämme, ja näin he vastasivat:

"Ihmisten kiireetön kohtaaminen ja ystävystyminen seniorin kanssa."

"Toisen auttaminen ja merkityksellisyyden tunne."

Auttaminen kokonaisvaltaisesti seniorin tarpeiden mukaan."

**Helpperinä saat:**

Oman nimetyn ikäihmisen, jota autat arjen askareissa ja olet hänelle seurana Joustavat työajat, jotka sopivat mainiosti esimerkiksi opiskelun ohelle tai lisätyöksi. Tavallisin työaika on 2-10h/vko. Kilpailukykyisen palkan: 13,20-15,98 €/h + työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät sekä lomakorvaukset. Hyvät etenemismahdollisuudet: Voit edetä kokemuksen ja hyvän asiakaspalautteen ansiosta pro- tai guru-helpperiksi ja saada korotusta palkkaasi!

Hakemukset lähetetään sähköisen lomakkeen kautta. Olemme kaikkiin hakijoihin yhteydessä hakemuksen lähettämisen jälkeen.

jobs.title: Vi søker erfarne sykepleiere til hjemmetjenesten natt
jobs.description:
Fast stilling 65% | Vikariater | Sykepleiervikarer på natt

 

Er du sykepleier og trives med selvstendig arbeid, faglige utfordringer og ansvar på natt? Da kan hjemmetjenesten være arbeidsplassen for deg.

 

Om tjenesten

Nattjenesten i hjemmetjenesten har en viktig og selvstendig rolle. Du vil møte varierte oppgaver, håndtere ustabile og akutte situasjoner, og være en avgjørende fagperson for både brukere og kollegaer gjennom natten.

Hos oss får du bruke sykepleierkompetansen din aktivt på natt i møte med komplekse og varierte pasientsituasjoner. Arbeidet byr på høy grad av selvstendighet, tydelig faglig ansvar og samarbeidsflater som bidrar til trygghet i utøvelsen av tjenesten.

Nattjenesten er organisert for å sikre faglig forsvarlige tjenester og god støtte i arbeidet. Stillingen gir rom for selvstendige vurderinger, samtidig som du er en del av et faglig fellesskap.

 

Kort om stillingene

  • Fast sykepleierstilling på natt: 65 % (per tiden arbeid hver 3. helg)
  • Ledige vikariater på natt
  • Stort og løpende behov for sykepleiervikarer på natt
  • Søknader behandles fortløpende og stillingene er ledige omgående

 

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Arbeid i team på natt (per tiden tre ansatte), med arbeid hver 3. helg
  • Utførelse av vedtaksbaserte tjenester i hjemmet
  • ASN – ambulerende sykepleier natt: ivareta sykepleiefaglige oppdrag på tvers av driftsseksjoner
  • Håndtering av trygghetsalarmer og akutte hendelser
  • Sende innleggelsesmeldinger ved behov
  • Følge opp legemiddelhåndtering i tråd med lovverk og gjeldende rutiner
  • Veiledning og informasjon til pasienter, pårørende og kollegaer
  • Bidra til et trygt og godt arbeidsmiljø

 

Kvalifikasjoner

Formelle krav:

  • Autorisasjon som sykepleier
  • Førerkort klasse B

 

Ønsket kompetanse:

  • Erfaring fra hjemmetjenesten
  • Erfaring med eller trygghet i håndtering av selvstendige sykepleiefaglige vurderinger, særlig på natt
  • Gode ferdigheter innen dokumentasjon, IKT og kommunikasjon

 Personlige egenskaper

  • Trygg og rolig i sykepleierrollen, også i uforutsette og krevende situasjoner
  • Evne til å arbeide strukturert og selvstendig på natt
  • Gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner
  • Ansvarsbevisst, pålitelig og faglig reflektert
  • Løsningsorientert og fleksibel i møte med varierte oppgaver
  • Bidrar til et trygt og godt arbeidsmiljø

 Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt.

 

 Vi tilbyr

  • En faglig utfordrende nattstilling med varierte og selvstendige sykepleieroppgaver
  • En arbeidshverdag med tydelig ansvar og rom for egne faglige vurderinger
  • Et trygt og støttende arbeidsmiljø med erfarne kollegaer
  • Gode rammer for å utføre faglig forsvarlige tjenester på natt
  • Konkurransedyktig lønn, inkludert funksjonstillegg i turnus:
    • kr 15 000 ved under 10 års ansiennitet
    • kr 25 000 ved over 10 års ansiennitet
  • God pensjonsordning og gruppelivsforsikring

 

Annet

Søknader vurderes fortløpende.
Arbeidstakere tilsettes i Kongsberg kommune. Lønns- og arbeidsvilkår i henhold til gjeldende avtaleverk. Det stilles krav til norskkunnskaper, skriftlig og muntlig, ved ansettelse. Dersom det kan trekkes i tvil om søkere har de nødvendige norskkunnskaper, skal vedkommende kunne dokumentere sin kunnskap ved bestått språkprøve nivå B2 eller tilsvarende før evt ansettelse. I henhold til gjeldende lov- og avtaleverk må tilfredsstillende politiattest, egenerklæring tuberkulose/MRSA og taushetserklæring må leveres før tiltredelse.

Søknad

Vi ber om at søkere benytter vårt elektroniske søknadsskjema. Vennligst fyll ut søknaden så fullstendig som mulig. Attester og vitnemål tas med til et eventuelt intervju.Det vil etter søknadsfristens utløp utarbeides en offentlig søkerliste. Søkere som ønsker å være unntatt offentlighet må begrunne dette særskilt. Begrunnelsen vil bli vurdert i forhold til reglene i Offentleglova. Hvis det etter kommunens vurderinger ikke foreligger en særskilt grunn, vil søkeren bli offentliggjort. Søker vil i et slikt tilfelle bli kontaktet på forhånd.


Link til søknadsskjema: Søk her

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Er du nysgjerrig på Kongsberg? Les mer på https://www.kongsberg.no Kongsberg er en kommune i vekst, med et av Norges mest innovative teknologi- og industrimiljøer. Regionen opplever nå en historisk høy utviklingstakt, drevet av verdensledende industri og framtidsrettet kompetanse. Samtidig kan vi i Kongsberg by på et rikt kulturliv, fantastiske friluftsområder og et stort mangfold av bomiljøer – fra det urbane til det landlige. Du finner også stor skog- og jordbruksaktivitet i Kongsberg. I Kongsberg kommune er vi stolte av arbeidsplassen vår, og vi har med oss verdiene våre åpenhet, raushet, stolthet og nyskaping i arbeidshverdagen. Vi jobber hver dag for at våre 29.000 innbyggere skal oppleve mestring og livskvalitet i alle livsfaser.

jobs.title: Requirements Engineer
jobs.description:
_Basemark | Automotive Software Projects_

_About the Role: Basemark is looking for a_**_Requirements Engineer_** _to join our automotive software engineering team. In this role, you will work within a customer-facing automotive project delivering advanced software solutions for a leading automotive manufacturer. You will play a key part in ensuring that customer and system requirements are accurately captured, structured, and maintained throughout the development lifecycle, in full compliance with ASPICE processes. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives at the intersection of technical detail and cross-functional communication, working closely with automotive OEM stakeholders and internal engineering teams. What You'll Do:_

- _Gather, analyze, structure, and maintain functional and non-functional system requirements for automotive AR (Augmented Reality) projects._

- _Establish and maintain bi-directional traceability between customer requirements (SYS.2) and software requirements (SWE.1)._

- _Manage change requests, including impact analysis, throughout the requirements lifecycle._

- _Ensure compliance with ASPICE processes (SWE.1, SUP.9, SUP.10), supporting process assessments and audit readiness._

- _Act as a key point of contact with automotive OEM representatives to clarify technical ambiguities, negotiate requirement scope, and refine customer specifications into actionable engineering requirements._

- _Facilitate requirement reviews between engineering teams, ensuring alignment and clarity across disciplines._

- _Support problem resolution processes related to requirements and specifications._


_What We're Looking For_

- **_At least 5 years of hands-on experience_** _with ASPICE Software Engineering processes (SWE.1, SUP.9, SUP.10)._

- _Solid knowledge of process assessments, audit readiness, and traceability compliance, as well as problem resolution and change request management._

- _Proven track record in gathering, analyzing, structuring, and maintaining functional and non-functional system requirements for automotive AR projects._

- _Proven experience establishing bi-directional traceability (Customer Requirements SYS.2 Software Requirements SWE.1) and managing change requests with impact analysis._

- _Proficiency with industry-standard tools for requirements lifecycle management (IBM DOORS, CodeBeamer, PTC Integrity, Jira, Confluence)._

- _Direct experience interacting with automotive OEMs to clarify technical ambiguities, negotiate requirement scope, and refine customer specifications into engineering requirements._

- _Experience facilitating requirement reviews between engineering teams._

- _Strong communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to bridge technical and business perspectives._

- _Fluent English; additional languages are a plus._


_Location & Compensation_

- **_Location:_** _Helsinki, Finland. The role is primarily based at our office, with on-site presence expected for most of the work week._

- **_Salary:_** **_EUR 33,500 - 33,700 per year_**_._


_Why Basemark? Basemark offers you the chance to work on cutting-edge automotive technology in a collaborative, international environment. You'll be part of a team that values technical excellence, ownership, and continuous improvement — with the opportunity to make a tangible impact on projects used by major automotive manufacturers._

The Field CTO partners closely with Sales, Solutions Engineering, Product, and Marketing to influence both customer strategy and Docker’s technical direction in the market.

  • Deep understanding of modern application architectures, containers, and developer platforms.

The Developer Experience team builds the backend systems and product capabilities that help developers understand, secure and ship software with confidence. The team powers important parts of Docker Scout, Docker Hardened Images and the workflows that turn supply-chain data into useful developer experiences.

Our systems are deliberately polyglot. Today that includes Clojure and Go services, event-driven workflows, Kafka, legacy Datomic components and newer Spanner-backed services. We will keep evolving the stack as the product and business change. We are looking for an adaptable backend engineer who can become effective in an unfamiliar codebase, choose technology pragmatically and help other engineers do the same. Clojure experience is useful, but it is not a requirement and this is not a Clojure-specialist role.

We make extensive use of AI-assisted engineering tools. We expect engineers to use them thoughtfully, validate their output and remain accountable for the quality, security and operability of what ships. At Staff level, you will also help the team turn good individual practice into repeatable workflows, controls and shared standards.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you will lead ambiguous, cross-team work from problem definition through measurable outcomes. You will remain hands-on in code while shaping architecture, raising operational standards and creating enough clarity for several engineers and partner teams to move quickly. Work may span developer-facing features, build and artefact workflows, data and event pipelines, platform evolution and integrations with Docker's build and security systems.

Success in This Role Looks Like

You will succeed by finding the highest-leverage problem, creating momentum before every detail is known and bringing people with you. Within your first year, teams should be delivering more confidently because you have made system boundaries clearer, reduced operational risk, connected technical choices to customer outcomes and helped senior engineers take on larger work.

  • Make pragmatic recommendations about when to retain, evolve or replace existing components, including the continued reduction of legacy Datomic dependencies.

  • Improve observability, incident readiness, performance and service ownership across the Developer Experience estate.

  • Mentor senior engineers, raise the quality of design and code reviews and create reusable patterns that multiply the team.

  • Communicate decisions and trade-offs clearly in a remote, async-first environment.

jobs.description:
Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

The Secure Build team builds and operates the infrastructure behind Docker's container builds. The team owns Docker Build Cloud and Auto Builds while developing the next generation of trusted build and CI capabilities.

Software is being changed faster than ever, but CI remains a bottleneck and a major trust boundary. Developers and software agents need to run build and test work quickly without exposing secrets, losing local-to-cloud parity or accepting an unverifiable result. Our direction is to make Docker the trusted place CI runs and turn that constraint into an accelerator.

The technical work spans Go services, container and build technology, cloud infrastructure, isolated execution and software supply-chain security. It also requires disciplined operation of the production systems customers rely on today. Docker Build Cloud and Auto Builds will need targeted reliability and operational improvements while useful capabilities evolve towards a coherent Secure Build platform.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will turn these problems into practical product and technical outcomes. You will own substantial work from discovery and design through production, make sound security and reliability trade-offs, and stay close to the experience of developers and the agents they delegate work to.

We make extensive use of AI-assisted engineering tools. We expect engineers to use them thoughtfully, validate their output and remain accountable for the quality and security of what ships.

Success in This Role Looks Like

You will succeed by becoming an end-to-end owner for secure, reliable build infrastructure. Within your first year, you should have delivered a material secure-build or CI capability, reduced operational risk in Docker Build Cloud or Auto Builds, and become a trusted partner to the teams and customers that consume the platform.

Responsibilities

  • Turn developer, agent and security problems into clear requirements, staged technical decisions and measurable outcomes.

  • Keep Docker Build Cloud and Auto Builds reliable, make targeted improvements that reduce operational load, and help their capabilities evolve towards the wider Secure Build direction.

  • Design for a clear developer experience, including workflows initiated or consumed by software agents.

  • Partner with Product, Security, Developer Experience, Registry and other platform teams on end-to-end customer workflows.

  • Participate in the team's paid on-call rotation and drive improvements from incidents and recurring operational work.

  • Communicate decisions, risks and progress clearly in a remote, async-first environment.

Qualifications

Required

  • 6+ years of software engineering experience, with demonstrated technical leadership on production systems at scale.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

  • Strong backend engineering experience building and operating distributed systems in production.

  • Production experience with Go and the ability to write, test, review and debug maintainable Go services.

  • Experience with containers and build or CI systems, such as OCI, BuildKit, Buildx, GitHub Actions or comparable platforms.

  • Experience with cloud-native infrastructure and a major cloud platform.

  • A strong operational mindset covering observability, reliability, incident response and on-call ownership.

  • Evidence of taking a feature or service from an ambiguous problem through production operation and measurable results.

  • Working knowledge of security boundaries, identity, secrets and common software supply-chain risks.

Helpful, but not required

  • Experience with Kubernetes.

  • Experience with sandboxing, microVMs, untrusted workload execution or multi-tenant infrastructure.

  • Experience building hosted CI runners, remote builders or developer-platform infrastructure.

  • Experience with agentic development workflows or building systems used programmatically by software agents.

  • Experience evolving a legacy production system while delivering new capabilities.

What to Expect

First 30 Days

  • Build context on Docker Build Cloud, Auto Builds and the Secure Build product and technical direction.

  • Pair with the Secure Build team on core services, deployments and operational practices.

  • Ship a useful production change and take part in an operational review or incident-learning session.

First 90 Days

  • Deliver an observable improvement to the reliability or operability of an existing build service.

One Year Outlook (First Year)

jobs.title: Ønsker du å gjøre en forskjell i en meningsfull jobb?
jobs.description:
Jeg er en kvinne i  30-årene som søker faste BPA-assistenter og tilkallingsvikarer. Jeg trenger assistanse på dagtid, ettermiddag og kveld, både ukedager og på helger.   Litt om meg:   Jeg liker å fylle livet med små og store gleder. Jeg elsker en god latter, men også gode samtaler. Om du både har evnen til å lytte, tilpasse tempoet ut i fra hensynet til mine behov så kan du være den jeg ser etter. Jeg elsker god mat, og det er fint om du kan hjelpe meg med å tilberede den, følge meg på opplevelser og mine interesser. Jeg er en person med mange interesser og ønsker å leve et aktivt og innholdsrikt liv. Noen av mine interesser er:
  • Historie, bøker, film og museum
  • Gaming
  • Kreative aktiviteter, ulike kunstformer og ulike hobbyprosjekter
  • Reiser, frivilligarbeid og fritidsaktiviteter
  • Jeg ønsker også å komme i gang med svømming
Som min assistent vil du være mine forlengende armer og bein, og bidra til at jeg kan delta i aktiviteter jeg trives med. Samtidig som du hjelper meg med praktiske gjøremål i hverdagen.   Arbeidsoppgaver Arbeidsoppgavene vil blant annet kunne bestå av:
  • Praktisk og personlig bistand 
  • Matlaging og tilrettelegging rundt måltider
  • Forflytning og følge til ærender, avtaler, aktiviteter, turer og fritidsinteresser
  • Dyrestell
  • Assistanse ved reiser
  • Sosial støtte og tilrettelegging i hverdagen
  • Andre daglige gjøremål etter behov
  Hvem ser jeg etter? Jeg ønsker assistenter som:
  • Er rolige og beholder oversikten i stressende situasjoner
  • Er omsorgsfulle 
  • Liker å lage mat
  • Er gode samarbeidspartnere, men også kan arbeide selvstendig
  • Er pålitelige og ansvarsbevisste
  • Ikke er allergiske mot dyr
  • Har respekt for at BPA-ordningen handler om å støtte meg i mitt liv og mine valg, og  at du respekterer meg som arbeidsleder – du jobber i mitt hjem
  • Er praktisk anlagt og ikke redd for å ta i et tak
  • Har god fysisk helse og kan håndtere små løft
  • At du møter presist til arbeid
Vi tilbyr
  • Faste stillinger og mulighet for tilkallingsvikariat
  • Varierte og meningsfulle arbeidsdager
  • God opplæring og digitale kurs
  • Egen kontaktperson i Medvind Assistanse
  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med fokus på respekt, trygghet, samarbeid og godt humør
  • En jobb hvor du faktisk gjør en forskjell
  • Tariffestet lønn og ordnede arbeidsforhold
Personlig egnethet vil bli vektlagt høyt. Arbeidssted: Bodø
Arbeidstid: Dag, ettermiddag, kveld, ukedager og helger
Stillingstype: Faste stillinger og tilkallingsvikarer Høres dette interessant ut? Vi ser frem til å høre fra deg!    Søknader vurderes fortløpende    
Medvind Assistanse AS er et norskeid selskap som leverer likestillingsverktøyet BPA for mennesker med funksjonsvariasjon. For funksjonsvarierte skal BPA bidra til å til å gi mulighet til å leve et aktivt og selvstendig liv med fokus på selvrealisering og samfunnsdeltakelse. BPA handler like mye om friheten til å kunne velge hvilket liv man vil leve, og hvem man vil være. Med BPA skal man i størst mulig grad kunne ivareta plikter, interesser, behov og ønsker som alle andre samfunnsborgere. Medvind Assistanse AS ble stiftet i 2020 og har lokale kontorer i store deler av landet.

About FLC:

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The TE systems are part of the scope of the Marine team as temporary measures to facilitate the immersion of the elements. In total, 79 standard elements will connect the Femern Belt Tunnel to both Germany and Denmark. To be able to float up, transport and immerse the Tunnel Elements, the elements require temporary installations. These installations ensure that the elements float, stay balanced, immerse and can connect to the preceding element. A team of mechanics and electricians will install and test these installations. At the same time, an outfitting team from another department is outfitting the element with more permanent additions. It is up to the Site engineer to assist the production team and to document and verify the activities that are executed. There will be interface with several Supervisors, work preparation of the outfitting and subcontractors.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

▪ Prepare work method statements (WMS) and work procedures (WPR).

▪ Adjust the WMS and WPR where needed to optimize the procedure of installation.

▪ Ensures that schedules and planning are optimized in coordination with all departments, both within and outside FLC.

▪ Takes an active part in the structural meetings.

▪ Ensures clear communication, including minutes of meeting, to all parties involved.

▪ Is supportive of Commissioning Engineers and TE Systems execution teams by providing planning, documentation and the necessary equipment.

▪ Ensures a safe working environment through toolbox meetings, pre-start meetings, safety walks and by addressing issues directly.

▪ Document executed activities in the tools provided by FLC.

▪ Verify and validate contract requirements.

▪ Has experience working with drawing applications.

▪ Has experience working with Office 360.

▪ Has experience in work preparation.

▪ Has good organizational skills.

▪ Enjoys coordinating with multiple parties involved.

▪ English, minimal B1

▪ Is willing to work in shifts and at irregular hours.

▪ Has a background as mechanical or electrical engineer.

At Femern Link Contractors (FLC), we are responsible for designing and constructing the immersed tunnel, portals and ramps on both ends of the tunnel, in Rødbyhavn and Puttgarden.

We are also building the facilities for prefabricating tunnel elements as well as accommodation facilities, also known as the “Tunnel village” in Rødbyhavn, which provides housing for FLC workers.

About the department:

The FLC Survey Department plays a key role in supporting the construction of this immersed tunnel project. The marine survey team delivers positioning, navigation, monitoring, and hydrographic survey services for offshore construction activities using advanced technologies such as multibeam echo sounders, Inertial Navigation systems, LBL and USBL systems, Fibre Optic Gyroscopes and many more. Together with over 60 hydrographic and topographic survey professionals from more than 15 countries, the department ensures accurate survey data for all project phases. The topographic survey teams support construction through stake-out, control, and as-built surveys, utilizing state-of-the-art equipment including Total Stations, GNSS, drones, laser scanners, and specialist software for planning, execution, and data processing.

Within the marine survey team, the Positioning Specialists play a key role in the immersion of tunnel elements. They install, configure and operate advanced positioning systems, combining GNSS, INS, LBL, tautwire, and distance sensor technologies to ensure the precise placement of tunnel elements.

Main tasks and responsibilities:

Prepare positioning systems for (re-)installation operations by performing maintenance, calibration, and configuration of the hard- and software.

Configure positioning software in preparation for positioning operations, such as Qinsy, Delph SP and Delph INS and project specific software.

Operate and monitor the positioning systems during tunnel element installation operations, such as GNSS (Septentrio), INS (Exail), LBL (Exail), SVP (AML) and a project specific Light Tautwire and Distance Sensor system.

Remote or on-board troubleshooting of positioning system issues.

Analyse positioning data of tunnel installation process.

Write installation-, configuration- and commissioning reports for positioning systems.

Create reports for ‘as-installed’ and ‘as-configured’ survey set-ups.

Create ‘as-installed’ reports for installed tunnel elements

Cooperate with the operational team to schedule installation and removal of survey systems.

Cooperate with pontoon and vessel crews during remote- or on-board troubleshooting.

Concise communication with the immersion master during installation of the tunnel elements.

Qualifications:

Degree, diploma, or equivalent professional experience in Hydrographic Surveying, Geomatics or Geodesy, Survey Engineering, Offshore Engineering, Marine Technology, Navigation, Positioning, or a related technical discipline

Minimum 5 years of experience with surface and/or subsea positioning systems.

Proven experience configuring, maintaining, and operating marine positioning systems during offshore operations.

Experience with working with Qinsy survey software.

Experience with USBL and/or LBL positioning systems.

Ability to configure, calibrate, and troubleshoot complex positioning systems.

Strong capability in quality control, analysis, and interpretation of positioning data.

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Able to remain calm and make sound decisions during critical offshore operations.

Strong verbal and written communication skills, particularly when coordinating with immersion masters, vessel crews, engineers, and survey teams.

jobs.title: Vapaaehtoistoiminnan verkoston koordinaattori (Päijät-Häme)
jobs.description:
Tule Päijät-Hämeen vapaaehtoistoiminnan verkoston koordinaattoriksi!

Alueellinen koordinaattori vastaa Päijät-Hämeen alueella toimivan vapaaehtoistoiminnan verkoston toiminnasta ja kehittämisestä. Työ on monipuolista ja vaihtelevaa ja sitä tehdään yhdessä työparin sekä verkoston jäsenten kanssa.

Jos sinulla on hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja osaat ilmaista itseäsi suullisesti sekä kirjoittaen etkä pelkää tarttua isoissakaan kokonaisuuksissa organisointivastuuseen, saatat olla etsimämme henkilö.

Työssä onnistumista auttaa innostava ja läsnä oleva työote, kyky toimia ja nähdä mahdollisuuksia muuttuvissa tilanteissa. Rohkeutta, sinnikkyyttä ja yhteistyötä tarvitaan uusien ideoiden läpiviennissä. Vapaaehtoistoiminnan tuntemus katsotaan eduksi, asenne ja avoimuus uusia asioita kohtaan on välttämätöntä. Hyvät ja monipuoliset IT-taidot ja erilaisten ohjelmien käyttökokemus ovat tärkeitä työkaluja.

Jos sinulla on tehtävään soveltuva korkeakoulutus sekä aiempaa kokemusta hanke- ja verkostotoiminnasta, laita hakemus tulemaan! Paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Tehtävä on STEA - rahoitteinen. Tällä hetkellä rahoitusta on vuoden 2026 loppuun asti. Työn jatko riippuu rahoituksen jatkumisesta.

Työpaikka on Lahdessa, mutta työ vaatii liikkumista koko P-H hyvinvointialueella. Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus ja ajokortti on välttämätön.

Noudatamme Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES:iä. Koeaika on kaksi kuukautta.

Lahden Lähimmäispalvelu ry on ikääntyneiden ja vapaaehtoistoiminnan parissa toimiva yleishyödyllinen yhdistys. Järjestämme ikäihmisille vapaa-ajantoimintaa, vapaaehtoistoimintaa ja kotipalvelua. Koordinoimme P-H vapaaehtoistoiminnan verkostoa ja kehitämme Liikkuva senioripiste -toimintaa.

Nordjysk Projektledelse er et specialiseret projektlederhus, der hjælper virksomheder med at styrke deres projektorganisation gennem erfarne og kompetente projektledere. jobs.title: Fagleder
jobs.description:
Barnevernstjenesten i Bærum kommune er en av Norges største barnevernstjenester med cirka 160 ansatte og i underkant av 150  fosterhjem, besøkshjem, støttekontakter og tilsynsførere. Barnevernstjenesten består av seks fagavdelinger og en forvaltningsavdeling. Barnevernstjenesten ønsker å gå foran innen kvalitetsutviklingsarbeid på barnevernsområdet og drifter spesialiserte hjelpetiltak som RFT, MST-CAN, ABC og PMTO, i tillegg til eget veilederteam for fosterhjem og for foreldre etter omsorgsovertakelse. Barneverntjenesten  er vertskommune for Asker og Bærum barnevernvakt. og har formalisert samarbeid med flere forsknings- og kompetansemiljøer om utvikling og implementering av barnevernsfaglige tiltak etter barnevernsloven.

Avdeling omsorg søker nå etter ny fagleder for et av teamene som følger opp barnevernkonsulenter. Avdelingen består av avdelingsleder, 2 fagledere med ansvar for hvert sitt team bestående av hhv 5 og 6 barnevernkonsulenter, og en fagleder for et team bestående av 7 familie- og fosterhjemsveiledere. Avdelingen har ansvar for oppfølging av alle barn under omsorg som i hovedsak bor i fosterhjem, deres foreldre og fosterforeldre, samt ungdom som mottar ettervern. 

Barnevernstjenesten holder til i Kommunegården i Sandvika, med gode kollektivforbindelser og kort reisevei både til Oslo og Asker/Drammen.


Arbeidsoppgaver
  • Sørge for god daglig drift og oppfølging i eget team
  • Kvalitetssikre det barnevernsfaglige arbeidet knyttet til oppfølging av barn under omsorg, deres foreldre, fosterforeldre og ungdom som mottar ettervern
  • Systematisk veiledning av barnevernkonsulentene i avdelingen
  • Bidra til veiledning av studenter etter barnevernsloven
  • Sikre at oppdatert barnevernsfaglig standard og metodikk implementeres og etterleves i avdelingen
  • Pådriverrolle i barnevernstjenestens strategiske kvalitetsutviklingsarbeid.
  • Bidra til at den enkelte medarbeider følges opp og ivaretas i en tidvis krevende arbeidshverdag
  • Representere barnevernstjenesten i saker for barneverns- og helsenemnda og rett
Kvalifikasjoner
  • Relevant grunnutdanning/bachelor fra universitet eller høgskole. Aktuelle fagretninger er hovedsakelig barnevernspedagog eller sosionom
  • Andre grunnutdanninger i kombinasjon med relevant videreutdanning eller mastergrad kan vurderes
  • Det kreves relevant barnevernsfaglig videreutdanning som tilsier 30 studiepoeng eller mer
  • Må ha oppdatert og lang erfaring og kompetanse i barnevernsfaglig arbeid og forvaltningskrav etter barnevernsloven
  • Erfaring fra arbeid med barn, unge og familier vektlegges
  • Erfaring fra saksbehandling i førstelinjetjeneste vektlegges
  • Erfaring fra fosterhjemsarbeid og oppfølging av barn som er under omsorg  og deres foreldre er en fordel
  • Det vektlegges erfaring fra kvalitetssikringsarbeid, ledelse i veiledningssituasjoner overfor medarbeidere/kollegaer og/eller liknende ledererfaring
  • God skriftlig og muntlig fremstillingsevne. Søkere fra land utenfor Skandinavia må ha bestått min. norskprøve B2, skriftlig og muntlig
  • Gode engelskferdigheter muntlig og skriftlig
  • Førerkort klasse B
Personlige egenskaper
  • Inneha god rolleforståelse og samarbeidsevner
  • Evne til god og tillitsbyggende kommunikasjon med mennesker i vanskelige livssituasjoner, ledere, kollegaer, medarbeidere og samarbeidsinstanser
  • Evne til å inspirere og engasjere, og samtidig være tydelig og ha gjennomføringsevne
  • Evne til analytisk tenkning og gjennomføring av faglige vurderinger og beslutninger
  • Evne til, og erfaring fra, å arbeide strukturert og planmessig
  • Interesse for faglig og etisk refleksjon
  • Trives med ulike og varierende dager, oppgaver og arbeidstempo, samt inneha stor arbeidskapasitet

Personlig egnethet tillegges stor vekt

Vi tilbyr
  • Arbeid i en av Norges største barneverntjenester som:
    • aktivt deltar på en rekke utviklingsarenaer og etterstreber å være i forkant av den faglige utviklingen
    • tør å satse og prøve ut nye veier og metoder innen barnevernfaget, og arbeider strategisk og systematisk med kvalitetsutvikling
    • er utviklingsorientert og endringsrettet, og som fokuserer på et godt og trygt arbeidsmiljø
  • Opplæring i Barnesamtalen DCM og mulighet for kurs i nettverksmøteledelse
  • Mulighet for kompetanseutviklingsstipend
  • Offentlig tjenestepensjon
Annet

  • Bærum kommune legger vekt på mangfold på arbeidsplassen og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke
  • Vi har et personalpolitisk mål om å oppnå en balansert alders- og kjønnssammensetning og rekruttere personer med flerkulturell bakgrunn
  • Bærum kommune er en IA (inkluderende arbeidsliv)-virksomhet
  • Før ansettelse i Bærum kommune skal identitet dokumenteres og oppholdstillatelse være gyldig
  • Søkere gjøres oppmerksom på at iht. offentleglova § 25 kan opplysninger om dem bli offentliggjort, selv om søkeren har anmodet om ikke å bli oppført på søkerlisten
  • Originale vitnemål og attester vil etterspørres ved intervju

Sammen skaper vi et godt og inkluderende samfunn for over 130 000 innbyggere, både i dag og i årene som kommer. Vi skaper rammer som bidrar til at de aller minste kan leke og lære og at de som trenger en hjelpende hånd får en hverdag preget av mestring, mening og verdighet. Vi gjør et bredt spekter av arbeidsoppgaver, og felles for oss alle er at vi får tillit og myndighet til å påvirke vår egen arbeidshverdag for å skape et samfunn som er godt å leve i. jobs.title: Durability and Sensor Design Engineer
jobs.description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will step into a technically broad engineering role in an advanced automotive development environment, working closely with chassis systems and wheel suspension. The focus is on turning measured forces and simulation data into better durability decisions, from sensor design and calibration to CAE-based stress and strain analysis.

A large part of the role is about connecting theory with real-world testing. You will help ensure that strain gauge solutions and other sensor setups generate reliable data for model correlation and laboratory testing, while also supporting the long-term durability of components and systems. You will work cross-functionally with CAE engineers, design teams and test stakeholders, which gives you real influence on both technical direction and engineering quality. This is a great opportunity if you enjoy combining simulation, hardware and testing in work that directly shapes vehicle durability.

Job Description

    You will lead sensor design activities with a focus on strain gauge applications for vehicles and test rigs.
    You will drive the workflow from design input and test needs to sensor concept, placement strategy and final calibration.
    You will define load ranges, identify testing needs and perform strength simulations to support sensor design.
    You will design physical components and sensor solutions, using detailed stress and strain analysis to optimize strain gauge placement.
    You will plan and oversee calibration activities to secure accurate and reliable measurement data.
    You will perform stress and strain CAE simulations for chassis systems and components during the design phase.
    You will provide recommendations to improve durability in ongoing programs and design concepts.
    You will contribute to developing durability requirements, targets and technical guidelines together with the wider engineering organization.
    You will collaborate across CAE, CAD and physical testing to connect analytical work with practical validation.

Requirements

    MSc in Mechanical Engineering.
    Knowledge of Wheel Suspension design.
    Documented knowledge and a few years of experience from the durability domain.
    Experience of the CAE tools Ansa, Abaqus and nCode, as well as the CAD tool CATIA.
    Broad knowledge of the vehicle design process.
    Experience in writing requirements and technical guidelines.
    Ability to work across disciplines and balance theoretical modeling with hands-on testing and analysis.
    Fluent in English, written and spoken.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

jobs.title: Chief Revenue Officer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
WER WIR SIND

Wir sind ein junges, schnell wachsendes IT-Consulting-Unternehmen. Für unsere Kunden sind wir Problemlöser in den Bereichen Customer Service, CRM und AI. Dies erreichen wir mit viel Kreativität, Transparenz und Ehrgeiz, was uns bei Kunden von Start-ups bis hin zu Konzernen zu bewährten Partnern macht.


LEAVE YOUR FOOTPRINT

Als erster Chief Revenue Officer bei Leafworks übernimmst Du eine Schlüsselrolle für unsere nächste Wachstumsphase.

  • Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung entwickelst Du unsere kommerzielle Strategie weiter.

  • Du baust Sales, Marketing, Customer Success und Partner Management zu einer gemeinsamen Commercial Organisation aus.

  • Du schaffst Strukturen für nachhaltiges und profitables Wachstum.

  • Du gestaltest die Zukunft von Leafworks aktiv mit – mit Perspektive auf die Geschäftsführung.


DEIN TALENT

Du bist kein klassischer Vertriebsleiter und auch kein Konzern-CRO. Du denkst unternehmerisch, handelst pragmatisch und packst selbst mit an.

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in einer Commercial-, Revenue- oder Sales-Führungsrolle

  • Nachweisbare Erfolge beim Aufbau von profitablem Wachstum

  • Erfahrung mit Enterprise Sales oder Value Selling

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau strukturierter Sales- und Revenue-Prozesse

  • Sicherer Umgang mit CRM, Forecasting und Pipeline Management

  • Verständnis für Marketing, Customer Success und Account Management

  • Verhandlungssicheres Deutsch und Englisch

  • Idealerweise Erfahrung im Consulting-, SaaS- oder Software-Umfeld


HAVE AN IMPACT

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung unserer kommerziellen Wachstumsstrategie

  • Ausbau der Neukundengewinnung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Sales-Ansatzes

  • Aufbau einer nachhaltigen Lead-Pipeline gemeinsam mit Marketing

  • Professionalisierung unseres Key Account Managements und Ausbau von Cross- und Upselling

  • Weiterentwicklung von CRM, Forecasting, Pricing und Sales-Prozessen

  • Optimierung der Zusammenarbeit zwischen Sales, Consulting, Entwicklung und Customer Success

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und aktive Mitgestaltung unserer nächsten Unternehmensphase

  • Positionierung unserer AI- und Customer-Experience-Lösungen im Markt


WARUM LEAFWORKS

Wir sind ein internationales, bunt gemischtes, ähnlich tickendes Team. Wir schauen erst aufs Menschliche und danach auf die Skills, in dieser Reihenfolge. Egal welche Ausbildung Du hast, wie alt Du bist, wo Du wohnst, wo Du herkommst oder wie dein Lebenslauf aussieht: Come as you are and be yourself!

  • Mikro-Management ist nicht dein Stil? Unserer auch nicht: Du kannst dir deine Arbeitszeit selbst einteilen und wir arbeiten 100 % remote. Ab und zu mal Lust auf ein Co-Working mit LWees in deiner Nähe? Jederzeit gerne.

  • Prepare for challenges: Langweilige Projekte wirst Du bei uns nicht finden. Sei bereit, aus deiner Komfortzone rauszukommen.

  • Here to stay: Wir bauen auf langfristige Zusammenarbeit. Befristete Arbeitsverträge haben wir nicht.

  • Dresscode: Nein danke.

jobs.title: Senior Fullstack Developer & Team Lead to Wioniq Nordic // Borås
jobs.description:
Wioniq Nordic is a pioneer in smart IoT solutions for the water, energy, and construction sectors. With our new brand identity and ambitious growth targets leading up to 2028, we are heading into an exciting future. Our innovative platform monitors and protects critical infrastructure worldwide, and we are now looking for you who want to be part of our journey and contribute to developing the next generation of solutions. Together with us, you will have the opportunity to help shape the smart and sustainable societies of the future.

About the role

You’ll take on a central role as a hands-on Fullstack Developer while also leading and coordinating a technical team of approximately 5–7 people. A significant part of your day will be spent developing alongside the team, building robust and scalable solutions and contributing to the continued evolution of our IoT platform.

Alongside your own development work, you’ll provide direction for the team by setting priorities, coordinating the day-to-day work and helping remove blockers. You’ll also collaborate closely with other teams and stakeholders across the organization, making sure technical priorities are aligned with customer needs and business goals. When requirements shift or the scope changes, you know how to reassess, prioritize and keep the work moving forward.

You’ll be involved throughout the entire journey, from concept to production, working with a modern tech stack including Go, TypeScript/Node.js, Vue3, Kubernetes and PostgreSQL. Here, leadership means staying close to both the technology and the people, creating clarity, communicating across teams and making sure everyone is moving in the same direction.

We’re looking for someone who..  …is an experienced developer who enjoys staying close to the technology while taking an active role in leading and supporting others.

You’re curious, hands-on and comfortable taking ownership, but you also have the ability to step back, see the bigger picture and understand where your focus will make the most difference.

You’re a strong communicator who can connect with different personalities, roles and stakeholders. You listen, ask the right questions and know how to turn complex discussions into clear decisions and next steps. When priorities compete or circumstances change, you stay calm, reassess what matters the most and create a clear path forward.

As a leader, you build trust through both your technical knowledge and the way you work with others. You enjoy supporting and challenging your colleagues, sharing knowledge and creating an environment where people can take ownership, collaborate and deliver great work together.

    

6+ years of experience in fullstack development, working with Go and/or TypeScript/Node.js and modern frontend frameworks such as Vue, React or Angular

    

3+ years of experience as a Team Lead or in a similar technical leadership role

    

Strong communication skills and the ability to collaborate with different personalities, roles and stakeholders

    

Proven ability to prioritize, create structure and keep delivery moving when requirements or scope change

    

Experience working in containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes, Linux) is a plus

    

Post-secondary education i Software Engineering, or equivalent experience

    

Fluent in English, both spoken and written, Swedish is a plus

About Wioniq Nordic  As part of the Wioniq Group, operating across Europe, we at Wioniq Nordic are proud to be a driving force in creating more sustainable and smarter cities, industries, and buildings. We believe in technology’s ability to simplify, improve, and transform, and that’s exactly what we do. Through our IoT solutions, we already help over 400 companies across the Nordics optimize and monitor their critical systems in real time, from district heating and water to energy flows and building monitoring.

Our ambition is to make the complex simple and give our customers full control, where every decision is based on smart insights. Through a powerful platform and intelligent devices, we ensure that our automated solutions meet customer needs at every stage, detecting deviations, minimizing operational disruptions, and providing decision support that saves money, resources, and contributes to a better environment. At Wioniq, we are driven by curiosity, collaboration, and a desire to create change. We look forward to welcoming more like-minded individuals who want to help build a more sustainable and intelligent future for infrastructure around the world.

jobs.title: Senior Research Fellow / Yliopistotutkija (Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature, within the Centre of Excellence in Meliorist Philosophy of Suffering)
jobs.description:
Tampere University and Tampere University of Applied Sciences create a unique environment for multidisciplinary, inspirational, and high-impact research and education. Our universities community has its competitive edges in technology, health, and society. www.tuni.fi/en

[The Faculty of Social Sciences](https://www.tuni.fi/en/about-us/faculty-social-sciences)at Tampere University invites applications for a fixed-term Senior Research Fellow position in literary studies and/or philosophy of literature for a two-year period starting in January 2027 (or as agreed).

The position is open within the Centre of Excellence in Meliorist Philosophy of Suffering (MePhiS), funded by the Research Council of Finland, and its research team Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature. Among the five research teams of MePhiS, four are hosted by the Faculty of Theology at the University of Helsinki, while the team Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature is hosted by the Faculty of Social Sciences at Tampere University. The Centre offers a supportive and inspiring research environment and excellent opportunities for researchers to develop their careers in an international and interdisciplinary setting. More information about MePhiS is available at: www.helsinki.fi/mephis .

MePhiS engages in philosophical and interdisciplinary scholarship that places the concept of suffering at the centre of philosophical reflection and offers conceptual and argumentative tools for a deeper understanding of human engagement with affliction, starting from the meliorist (Lat. melior, better) idea that the world can and should be made better through active human efforts. According to meliorism, a positive outcome is neither guaranteed (optimism) nor impossible (pessimism).

The research group on Suffering and Meliorism in Literature and the Philosophy of Literature within MePhiS focuses on literary studies and the philosophy of literature as pathways to a meliorist philosophy of suffering. We take seriously the idea that literature can articulate philosophical questions and shape peoples ways of experiencing, expressing, and coping with suffering. The group critically examines writers and literary traditions associated with optimism, pessimism, and/or meliorism, and analyses literary works that reflect societal anxieties as well as human or non-human suffering arising from war, violence, poverty, marginalisation, the climate crisis, and related challenges. We also investigate how philosophers draw on literature in developing ethical responses to suffering.

Position

Towards these ends, we invite applications for a Senior Research Fellow with a background in literary studies and/or philosophy of literature with demonstrated interest in advancing research in these fields.

The Senior Research Fellow will be responsible for

- investigating representations of suffering and meliorism in literary and philosophical contexts;
- developing literary and philosophical analyses of ethical responses to suffering;
- authoring scholarly publications on the research topic;
- collaborating with other members of the Centre of Excellence, including through joint publications and other research activities; and
- contributing to teaching and administrative duties, amounting to approximately 5-10% of the working time.

Qualifications

We seek candidates with expertise in literary studies and/or philosophy of literature who are interested in advancing the research aims described above. Applicants must hold a doctoral degree in a relevant field within the humanities or social sciences (e.g., literary studies, philosophy) and have a demonstrated track record of high-quality research and international publications. A Senior Research Fellow typically has at least ca. five years of postdoctoral experience. In addition, applicants should possess the ability to lead a research group, a track record of securing external research funding, and the teaching skills required to successfully perform the duties and responsibilities of the position.

Familiarity with the topics of suffering, optimism, pessimism, or meliorism in literature and philosophy, as well as experience in combining literary studies with philosophical inquiry, will be considered an advantage.

The selected candidate should be capable of conducting independent research at a high international level and able to work both independently and collaboratively as a member of the research team. The working language of MePhiS is English, and excellent written and oral communication skills in English are required.

Applicants should be prepared to provide proof of their qualifications upon request. Please do not submit AI-generated proposals.

We offer

The position is fixed-term for two years starting in January 2027 or as agreed. A six-month trial period applies to all new employees at Tampere University.

The salary will be based on [the University Salary System](https://www.sivista.fi/esittely/in-english/general-collective-agreement-for-universities/). The salary of a Senior Research Fellow is at levels 6-7. In addition to the basic salary, a performance-based salary component is paid according to the appointees qualifications and experience. The starting salary (level 6) is approximately EUR 4,700-4,900 per month.

The appointee is expected to reside in Finland while employed by Tampere University. Tampere University is an internationally renowned research university offering a wide range of staff benefits, including occupational health care, flexible working hours, and excellent campus sports facilities. Please read more about [working at Tampere University](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us?navref=footer). International staff are supported in relocating to Finland.

jobs.title: 1-2 Doctoral Researchers in literary studies or history / 1-2 Väitöskirjatutkijaa kirjallisuustieteessä tai historiassa (The Verses of Learning: Epideixis and the Cultural Stories of Nature at Early Modern Universities, VERSITAS project)
jobs.description:
Tampere University and Tampere University of Applied Sciences create a unique environment for multidisciplinary, inspirational, and high-impact research and education. Our universities community has its competitive edges in technology, health, and society. www.tuni.fi/en

[The Faculty of Social Sciences](https://www.tuni.fi/en/about-us/faculty-social-sciences) at Tampere University invites applications for

1-2 Doctoral Researchers in literary studies or history. The duration of employment is determined by the progress of the doctoral studies and thesis work and is limited up to a maximum of four years, starting in January 2027 or as agreed.

The positions are open within Academy Professor Sari Kivistös project, [The Verses of Learning: Epideixis and the Cultural Stories of Nature at Early Modern Universities (VERSITAS)](https://projects.tuni.fi/versitas/in-english/), funded by the Research Council of Finland (2026-2031). The project examines the relationships between poetry, rhetoric, and nature in the early modern period, as well as their roots and continuities in earlier and later centuries. Myths and cultural narratives were an important part of early modern natural history and shaped experiences of nature. The project argues that understanding nature from a cultural perspective requires attention to the literary forms, genres, and rhetorical strategies through which it was represented. Through the study of scientific writing and occasional literature from the early modern period and adjacent centuries, we investigate how literary and stylistic devices shape relationships between humans and nature. Based in the Faculty of Social Sciences at Tampere University, the project offers a supportive and inspiring working environment, as well as excellent opportunities for researchers to advance their skills and careers.

Positions and Qualifications

We are seeking promising doctoral researchers with a masters degree in a relevant field within the humanities (e.g., literary studies, rhetoric and its history, book history, intellectual history, or classical studies). Applicants will be assessed primarily on the suitability of their proposed research topic to the projects aims and its potential to produce research of high international standard. Knowledge of early modern literature and/or history, as well as experience working with historical texts and archival materials, will be considered an asset. Possible dissertation topics include historical studies of nature, human-animal studies, and ecocritical approaches to pre-modern and early modern literature, with potential scope for transhistorical perspectives. Familiarity with the history of rhetoric or occasional poetry will also be considered an advantage.

The doctoral researchers will be responsible for writing a doctoral dissertation related to the projects research themes and completing the credits required for the doctoral degree. They will collaborate with the research team in organizing joint events and participating in other academic activities. The appointed researchers will contribute to teaching and administrative duties for up to 5% of their working time.

The selected candidates must apply for and be admitted to Tampere Universitys [Doctoral Programme in Literary Studies](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/doctoral-programmes/doctoral-programme-literary-studies) or [Doctoral Programme in History](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/doctoral-programmes/doctoral-programme-history) during the autumn semester of 2026. The application period for these programmes runs from 1 to 30 October 2026.

We offer

The positions are fixed term for four years (or a shorter period, depending on the stage of the dissertation) and will begin in January 2027 or as agreed. A six-month trial period applies to all new employees at Tampere University.

Salary is based on [the University Salary System](https://www.sivista.fi/esittely/in-english/general-collective-agreement-for-universities/). Doctoral Researchers are placed on levels 2-4 of the salary scale. In addition to the basic salary, a performance-based salary component is paid according to the appointees qualifications and experience. The starting salary is approximately €2,700 per month and will increase as the doctoral studies progress.

The appointees are expected to reside in Finland during their employment at Tampere University. Tampere University is an internationally renowned research university offering a wide range of staff benefits, including occupational health care, flexible working hours, and excellent campus sports facilities. Please read more about [working at Tampere University](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us) and explore our [Career Stories.](https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/work-with-us/career-stories)

For more information about Tampere, please see [VisitTampere](https://visittampere.fi/en/). For further information about Finland, please visit [InfoFinland](https://www.infofinland.fi/)and [This is Finland](https://finland.fi/).

How to apply

Applications must be submitted in English through Tampere Universitys electronic recruitment system (link below). The closing date for applications is 11 September 2026 (at 23:59/UTC+3). Online interviews with shortlisted candidates will be held on 22 and 23 September 2026.

Please attach the following documents to your application:

1) CV (max. 3 pages, including a list of publications, if applicable, and the contact details of the supervisor of your masters thesis)

2) Reference letter from the prospective supervisor of the doctoral dissertation (if external to the research team)

3) Preliminary research proposal (max. 3 pages), including

- a description of your previous research experience (e.g., your masters thesis);
- a research idea outlining why the projects themes or approach interest you and how you would position your doctoral research within this context;
- a timeline for your doctoral studies.

Please be prepared to provide proof of your qualifications upon request. Please do not submit AI-generated research proposals.

Enquiries

For further information about the position, please contact the project PI, Academy Professor Sari Kivistö, sari.kivisto(at)tuni.fi.

Stolpedalsskolen er beliggende på toppen af Hasseris, i et naturskønt område med Aalborg Zoo og Mølleparken som nærmeste naboer, og er en del af Aalborg skolevæsen. Med mere end 80 år på bagen er vi en stor og velkonsolideret skole med cirka 700 læringslystne og motiverede elever, omkring 100 dygtige og engagerede medarbejdere og en forældregruppe, der bakker aktivt og positivt op om skolens arbejde.

Kompetencer:

  • Du er nærværende og arbejder for at alle børn og unge bliver set og hørt hver dag
  • Du besidder stærke menneskelige og faglige kompetencer
  • Du kan planlægge, gennemføre og evaluere læringsforløb, så alle når de faglige og sociale mål
  • Gennem motivation arbejder du med den enkeltes ressourcer og læringspotentialer 
  • Du ser samarbejdet omkring børn og unges læring og trivsel, som en naturlig og væsentlig del af din hverdag
  • Du kan understøtte relationskompetencer i den pædagogiske praksis 
  • Du bidrager med glæde og god energi i undervisningen, forældresamarbejdet og tager aktiv del i de faglige og pædagogiske drøftelser med kolleger og ledelse
  • Du fremmer børn og unges læring, trivsel og dannelse og har høje ambitioner på alle børn og unges vegne

Vi tilbyder:

  • En spændende pædagogisk arbejdsplads med høj faglighed og kompetente, engagerede kolleger og ledelse
  • En skole i udvikling, som har et stort fokus på at skabe deltagelsesmuligheder for alle 
  • En skole, der har fokus på gode lære- og væremiljøer
  • En arbejdsplads, der vægter positiv kommunikation og samarbejde
  • En arbejdsplads præget af godt kollegafællesskab og samarbejde
  • En forældregruppe, der bakker op om skolen og dens værdier
  • En kultur, der er styret af et ressourcesyn på eleverne
  • Mulighed for sparring med kollegaer og ledelse
  • Et godt arbejdsmiljø, hvor vi spiller hinanden gode

 

Ansøgere skal have gennemført læreruddannelsen.

Sidste ansøgningsfrist er mandag d. 31. august 2026, og vi forventer at holde samtaler torsdag d. 3. september om eftermiddagen.

Yderligere oplysninger:

Interesserede er meget velkomne til at kontakte  afdelingsleder Casper Lund på tlf. 99 82 4404/22237956 eller skoleleder Torben Jensen på 99824401/22793069.

Arbejdsstedets adresse: 

Stolpedalsskolen, Stolpedalsvej 2, 9000 Aalborg 

Løn og ansættelsesvilkår:

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår i henhold til gældende overenskomst mellem KL og den forhandlingsberettigede organisation.

Forud for endelig ansættelse indhentes der straffe- og børneattest og reference. 


Send ansøgning

Du sender din ansøgning ved at trykke på knappen "Søg jobbet" og udfylde den formular, som kommer frem. Det er også muligt at vedhæfte bilag som f.eks. ansøgning og CV i begrænset omfang.


Bliv en del af Dobbelt A – få dobbelt op på muligheder
Hos os bliver du en del af et fedt fællesskab med 17.500 kolleger. Glæd dig til at få dobbelt op på udviklingsmuligheder, gode ansættelsesforhold og fokus på trivsel. Vi tror på, at forskellighed gør os stærkere, og opfordrer alle til at søge – uanset alder, køn, baggrund, religion eller handicap.
Se alle fordelene ved et job hos os og bliv klogere på ansættelsesprocessen trin-for-trin.

jobs.title: Myyjä, Sale Huhtinen / Försäljare, Sale Huktis
jobs.description:
Primary location:
PORVOO

MYYJÄ, SALE HUHTINEN, 12 H/VK, VAKITUINEN TYÖSUHDE

Etsimme myyjää Sale Huhtiseen vakituiseen työsuhteeseen. Myyjän työtehtävissä pääset tekemään monipuolisesti kaupan eri tehtäviä, mm. asiakaspalvelutyötä kassalla ja hyllytystä. Päivittäiseen työhösi kuuluu myös myymälän siisteydestä ja viihtyisyydestä huolehtiminen sekä tuotteiden esillepano ja saatavuuden varmistaminen.

Me Sale Huhtisessa sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Tavallisuus ei toki tarkoita, että meillä olisi täällä jotenkin tylsää tai tylsää porukkaa töissä – päinvastoin!

Toivomme sinulta:
- Kohtaat asiakkaat ja työkaverit sydän kohdallaan <3
- Reipasta ja asiakaspalveluhenkistä asennetta sekä halua oppia uutta.
- Kykyä ottaa järjestelmät haltuun.
- Mahdollisuutta tehdä vaihtelevaa vuorotyötä - myös juhlapyhinä.
- Suomen kielen taitoa ja ruotsin kieli katsotaan eduksi

Mitä ihan tavallinen työ meillä tarkoittaa?
- Työpaikkaa, johon on kiva tulla ja josta on kiva lähteä kotiin.
- Tiimiä, jossa kaveria ei jätetä ja jossa esihenkilöt ovat mukana arjen tekemisessä.
- Mahdollisuutta kehittyä ja kouluttautua.
- Alennuksia S-ryhmän tuotteista ja palveluista – ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista ja paljon muusta.
- Kulttuuri-, hyvinvointi- ja liikuntaetuja.
Palkkaus
- Kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkausta(10,89 €/h – 14,57 €/h), johon vaikuttavat kokemuksesi ja koulutuksesi.
-5 % kielilisä, jos asiakaspalvelu onnistuu vähintään suomeksi ja ruotsiksi.
- Mahdollisuuden koko henkilökunnan yhteiseen jopa 1,70 €/ tehty työtuntitulospalkkioonyrityksen tuloksen ja toimialakohtaisten mittareiden perusteella.

Kiinnostuitko?
Etenemme rekrytoinnissa jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, mutta viimeistään sunnuntaina 30.8.2026. Tarkempia tietoja tehtävästä antaa apulaistoimipaikkapäällikkö Anna Viren (anne.viren@sok.fi). Työsuhde alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

***

FÖRSÄLJARE, SALE HUKTIS, 12 H/VECKA, TILLSVIDAREANSTÄLLNING

Vi söker en försäljare till Sale Huktis för en tillsvidareanställning. Som försäljare får du arbeta mångsidigt med butikens olika uppgifter, bland annat kundservice i kassan och varuplock. I ditt dagliga arbete ingår också att se till att butiken är ren och trivsam samt att säkerställa produkternas exponering och tillgänglighet.

På Sale Huktis brukar vi säga att vi har ett helt vanligt jobb. Vanlighet betyder förstås inte att vi skulle ha det tråkigt eller att vi skulle vara ett tråkigt gäng – tvärtom!

Vi önskar att du
- möter du kunder och kollegor med hjärtat på rätt ställe <3
- har en glad och kundserviceinriktad attityd och vilja att lära dig nytt
- har förmåga att ta i bruk nya system
- har möjlighet att jobba i varierande arbetsskift – också under högtider.
Goda kunskaper i finska och kunskaper i svenska ses som en merit.

Vad innebär ett helt vanligt jobb hos oss?
- Ett jobb som får dig på gott humör både före och efter arbetsdagen.
- Ett team där man inte lämnar kollegorna i sticket och där cheferna jobbar sida vid sida med teamet.
- Möjlighet att utvecklas och utbilda dig.
- Personalrabatt på S-gruppens produkter och tjänster, till exempel på mat, dryck, smink, elektronik, restauranger, hotell och mycket annat trevligt.
- Kultur-, välbefinnande- och motionsförmån.
Lön
- Lön enligt handelns kollektivavtal (10,89 - 14,57 €/h), beroende på din erfarenhet och utbildning.
- Ett språktillägg på 5 procent om du kan betjäna kunder på åtminstone finska och svenska.
- Möjlighet till hela personalens gemensamma resultatpremie på upp till 1,70 euro per arbetad timme, baserat på företagets resultat och branschvisa mätare.

Intresserad?
Vi framskrider med rekryteringen redan under ansökningstiden, så lämna in din ansökan så fort som möjligt men senast söndag 30.8.2026. Närmare information om uppgiften ger biträdande enhetschef Anna Viren (anne.viren@sok.fi). Anställningen börjar enligt avtal.
