jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Solutions Consultants, Japan (Sales Leadership)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

We're looking for a Head of Enterprise Segment, Japan to lead Notion's Enterprise GTM motion in Japan as we evolve how we sell, build, and deliver outcomes for our largest customers. This is a senior second-line leadership role, leading leaders and teams across the Enterprise segment, with accountability for new logo acquisition, expansion, renewals, and the quality of execution that produces durable customer outcomes.

This person will play an integral role in scaling Notion's evolving GTM motion in Japan. You'll help define what great looks like for the Enterprise segment: how teams identify the right accounts, create urgency with executives, diagnose workflows, run compelling first and second meetings, deliver live builds and value narratives, and hand customers off into adoption with clarity. This is not a traditional pipeline-management role. The best leaders in this motion are coaches first: they can inspect the quality of a customer conversation, watch a live build or deal review, and tell a manager or IC exactly what to change.

As part of the Japan GTM leadership team, you'll be instrumental in helping define our Enterprise sales motion, meaningfully shape our product and customer strategy, and drive revenue growth while building a high-performing team. We need someone with an entrepreneurial and builder spirit, strong enterprise operating discipline, and experience leading through managers. This person should enjoy coaching leaders and reps to be the best they can be, be data-driven, and be experienced in managing complex, high-velocity Enterprise pipeline across new business, expansion, and renewal motions.




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Lead the Japan Enterprise Segment strategy, including territory design, account prioritization, pipeline generation, executive engagement, expansion strategy, renewal health, and long-term revenue growth

 - Lead and develop first-line leaders and senior ICs across the Enterprise motion, raising the bar on coaching quality, operating cadence, performance management, and team execution

 - Own the commercial performance of the Enterprise segment across new logo ARR, expansion ARR, renewals, and UBP outcomes, accountable for both the headline numbers and the quality of execution that drives them

 - Scale the evolved GTM motion in-market, including account strategy, workflow diagnosis, current → future architecture, live builds in Notion, value narratives, mutual action plans, and adoption hand-offs

 - Build the operating rhythm and inspection cadence for the segment, including weekly pipeline reviews, deal support sessions, call reviews against the motion quality rubric, forecast calls, and leadership reporting

 - Partner with Solutions Consultants and Outcomes Architects (Sales and Customer Success), BDR, Partnerships, Marketing, Deal Desk, Ops, Legal, and Product to build playbooks and define how Notion wins with Enterprise customers in Japan

 - Partner with BDR leadership on Enterprise pipeline strategy, outbound targeting, qualification standards, and messaging so the team's book of business is healthy and growing

 - Partner with Solutions Consultant and Outcomes Architect leadership on adoption hand-offs, at-risk account management, and renewal strategy, owning the overall commercial arc while collaborating on execution after close

 - Represent Japan Enterprise customer and team signal in regional and global leadership forums, clearly identifying what's working, what needs investment, and where execution is breaking down

 - Attract, hire, onboard, certify, and retain a world-class Enterprise organization, building a culture of high performance, coaching, accountability, and collaboration




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING:

 - 10+ years of B2B SaaS, AI, productivity, collaboration, or workflow technology experience, with a proven track record of winning and growing Enterprise customers

 - 3+ years of second-line leadership experience, with experience leading managers or multiple teams through a defined operating cadence, performance management, and talent development rhythm

 - Strong understanding of PLG and SLG sales motions, with successful experience combining bottom-up adoption with top-down executive selling in Enterprise accounts

 - Proven ability to scale a GTM transformation or new sales motion, including enablement, inspection, manager coaching, playbook adoption, and consistent execution across teams

 - Strong enterprise customer instincts, with the ability to guide teams through complex discovery, multi-stakeholder evaluation, technical validation, business case creation, and adoption planning

 - Deep coaching orientation: you can inspect a deal review, customer call, or live build and identify specifically what needs to change, not just whether the outcome was good

 - Strong analytical judgment, able to read pipeline health, identify risk early, use customer and team signal to build strategy, and drive urgency without micromanaging

 - Excellent cross-functional leadership skills, with experience partnering across Sales, Customer Success, Product, Marketing, Partnerships, Operations, Legal, and Deal Desk

 - A builder mentality who thrives in collaborative environments, operates well in ambiguity, and creates structure, playbooks, and operating rhythms where they do not yet exist

 - Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to engage senior customer stakeholders and represent Japan Enterprise priorities to regional and global leadership

 - Fluency in Japanese (native or bilingual level) and English (high-business level)

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter, coach better, and deliver stronger customer outcomes.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience leading Enterprise GTM in Japan or across APAC for a high-growth SaaS or AI company

 - Experience leading through a major GTM organizational change, sales methodology rollout, segment redesign, or role redesign across Enterprise teams

 - Experience selling or leading teams in a consumption, usage-based, or adoption-led business where customer outcomes matter as much as closed ARR

 - Track record building high-performing regional teams from an early stage, including hiring to profile, structured onboarding, certification, and performance management

 - Strong technical fluency or experience working closely with technical sales, solutions consulting, product, implementation, or partner teams

 - Experience selling through or partnering with systems integrators, channel partners, or strategic alliances in Japan

 - Experience with quarterly or annual sales planning, territory planning, and Enterprise capacity planning




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.description:
Monday Merch produces physical branded merchandise and custom apparel for international enterprise clients. Due to the high technical complexity of physical manufacturing, this role requires at least 1 year of hands-on experience specifically in merchandise, apparel, or packaging design.

A standard graphic design background is insufficient. The candidate must possess proven experience with pre-press production processes, including vectorizing artwork, Pantone (PMS) color matching, print separations for embroidery and Screen Printing/DTG, and mapping 2D artwork onto complex 3D product surfaces. Furthermore, the candidate must have experience executing designs within strict corporate B2B brand guidelines and working directly with technical specifications from global manufacturers.

About Monday Merch
Monday Merch is a fast-growing B2B merch platform based in Rotterdam. We design, produce, and deliver high-quality, sustainable custom merchandise and corporate gifts for leading global brands and scale-ups.

The Role: Graphic & Visual Designer
We are looking for a talented Graphic & Visual Designer to join our creative team. In this role, you will bridge the gap between creative visual design and physical product execution. You will be responsible for creating compelling visual assets, developing brand identities, and translating complex design concepts into production-ready physical merchandise.

Key Responsibilities:
Develop full visual identity packages, brand guidelines, and high-impact design assets.
Create production-ready vector files and technical specs (tech packs, CMYK/Pantone prepress) for apparel, accessories, and custom packaging.
Lead design projects from initial concept and artwork creation through final supplier handoff.
Collaborate with account managers, production teams, and external suppliers to maintain visual quality across physical products.

What We Offer:
A dynamic, international work environment in Rotterdam.
Full-time position (40h/week) with market-competitive remuneration.
Catered team lunches, travel reimbursement, and high-end merch benefits.

jobs.title: Bestuurslid

woensdag 22 juli 2026
Tijd om te lachen Boert Bewust zoekt bestuurslid voor verdere groei landelijke verbinding
De landelijke stichting Boert Bewust zoekt een nieuw bestuurslid dat wil bijdragen aan de verdere ontwikkeling van de organisatie. Boert Bewust brengt boeren, tuinders en burgers met elkaar in contact via activiteiten en ontmoetingen rond agrarische bedrijven.
Het nieuwe bestuurslid gaat samen met het bestuur werken aan de strategie en verdere groei van Boert Bewust. Tot de werkzaamheden behoren onder meer het ondersteunen van bestaande streken, het helpen ontwikkelen van nieuwe streken en het versterken van samenwerkingen en partnerschappen.
Regionale afdelingen

We are looking for motivated employees who want to work as a Reachtruck driver at Action in Echt. Are you interested? Read on!
Within the distribution center you and the team are responsible for handling the pallets. The work is focused on the accurate processing and placement of pallets. - At least 18 years old - You speak Polish, Slovak, Czech or good English - Approachable and accurate - You want to work for a longer period of time - Experience in working with a reachtruck is an advantage - Reachtruck certificate

Train smart: follow your capacity, not just the physical activity guidelines Train slim
13 July
Ana Rodrigues
We all know that exercise is healthy. But how much exercise is actually enough? And do you always have to give it your all during every workout? The Dutch Physical Activity Guidelines provide a good starting point for this. For adults, the advice is to to exercise moderately intensely for at least 150 minutes per week, and to perform muscle- and bone-strengthening exercises at least twice a week. to do and limit prolonged sitting as much as possible. It is important to know that this no targets , but the minimum amount of exercise which is necessary to stay healthy.
However, in practice, we see that many people unconsciously deal with this in two ways. They either do too little because work, family, or other obligations always take precedence, or they deliberately try to perform at their maximum during every training session, even on days when their body is actually not ready for it. Listen to your body
No two days are the same. One day you feel energetic and strong, while on another you may have slept less well, be under a lot of stress, or simply feel more tired. That is precisely why it is important not only to follow a training schedule, but also to listen to your load capacity to check. A simple way to do this is to ask yourself one question before every training:
"How strong do I feel today? "
Give yourself a score of 0 to 10. - 8 to 10: Do you feel fit and energetic? Then feel free to challenge yourself a little extra. - 5 to 7: Great energy? Follow your normal training schedule. - 0 to 4: Low energy? Scale back the training slightl...

Offer Description
This fully funded 36-month postdoc project aims to test whether targeting the aminopeptidase ERAP2 can tackle EBV infection in Multiple Sclerosis (MS), and is a joint effort of our group at the Department of Ophthalmology of the UMC Utrecht and the ErasMS team at Erasmus MC Rotterdam. You will use state-of-the-art molecular and cellular techniques available at the Kuiper group and its collaborating labs to elucidate how ERAP2 shapes pathogenic immune responses and if this can be corrected with small molecular inhibitors.
This project aims to test whether targeting ERAP2 can selectively remove pathogenic EBV-infected B cells in MS. Almost everyone with MS carries EBV, and EBV-infected B cells help drive disease. ERAP2 shapes how these B cells present viral peptides to NK cells and CD8+ T cells.
- You will build disease-relevant cellular models of EBV-infected B cells, modulate ERAP2 activity, and read out the downstream consequences for antigen presentation, NK and CD8+ T cell cytotoxicity, and B cell survival. You will be embedded in the research group of Dr. Jonas Kuiper within the Center for Translational Immunology (CTI) at UMC Utrecht and collaborate closely with the groups of Dr. Marvin van Luijn and Dr. Joost Smolders at MS Center ErasMS in Rotterd...

jobs.description:
EMA Centralised Procedure - Analysis of Marketing Authorisation Applications
Author
Cornelis Jansma
Published on
April 29, 2026
The European Medicines Agency (EMA) focus group on submission predictability monitoring report (H2-25 MAAs pipeline monitoring exercise) makes one thing clear: predictability in Marketing Authorisation Applications (MAA) is improving, but industry still has significant room to mature.
Key findings include: - 57% of MAAs were submitted on time, up from 48% in 2023. - Short-notice delays remain a major issue: over 60% of applicants provided less than 60 days' advance warning before shifting their submission date. - Justifications for delays are often missing or uninformative; only 73% of applicants who changed their plans provided a justification, and many cited internal resource constraints or planning issues. - Generics and biosimilars frequently bypass timely Letters of Intent, creating additional unpredictability. - While communication between applicants and regulators has improved, the overall planning reliability remains insufficient to support efficient workload allocation across the EU regulatory network.
The report concludes that although progress is visible, predictability challenges continue to strain regulatory resources, and further improvements in applicant planning and transparency are essential. EMA will continue monitoring but will shift focus toward new approaches aligned with the upcoming New Pharmaceutical Legislation.
With the regulatory network under increasing workload pressure, companies that invest in predictable, well-governed submission processes will be better positioned for smooth assessments and timely approvals.
If your organisation is preparing an EMA Marketing Authorisation Application for 2026-2027, now is the moment to reinforce planning discipline and operational readiness. At Starodub, we support teams in building predictable, regulator-aligned submission strateg...

jobs.title: Tømrer/stålmontør - carpenter
jobs.description:
Vi søker to dyktige håndverkere. Stillingene er egnet for deg som har erfaring både med tømrerarbeid og stålmontasje. The positions are suitable for those who have experience with both carpentry and steel assembly, thrive on construction sites, and want varied work tasks.

Hva vi ser etter

  • Relevant erfaring fra tømrer- og stålmontasjearbeid.

  • God forståelse for tegninger og montasjeanvisninger.

  • Erfaring med bruk av vanlige håndverktøy og maskiner på byggeplass.

  • Må kunne gjøre seg godt forstått på engelsk.

  • Førerkort klasse B og bil er en stor fordel

Relevant experience from carpentry and steel assembly work. Experience with using common hand tools and machinery on a construction site. Must be able to speak good English. Driving license class B and own car is a big advantage.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Montering av stålkonstruksjoner og prefabrikkerte elementer.

  • Tømrerarbeid i forbindelse med bygging, tilpasning og etterarbeid.

  • Samarbeid med prosjektledelse og andre faggrupper for å sikre fremdrift og kvalitet.

Assembly of steel structures and prefabricated elements. Carpentry work in connection with construction, adaptation and finishing work.

Vi tilbyr

  • Gode samarbeidsevner og evne til å kommunisere tydelig.

  • Punktlig, pålitelig og engasjert i kvalitet og HMS.

Nordvest Bemanning AS er et bemanningsbyrå med lang erfaring innen formidling og utleie av faglært arbeidskraft. Vi rekrutterer i dag medarbeidere til et bredt utvalg av fagområder. Our head office is located on Askøy just outside Bergen and we are at the moment a team of 150 co-workers.

jobs.title: Erzieher - Pädagoge - Erziehungswissenschaft (m/w/d) als Fachkraft Eingliederungshilfe (Erzieher/in)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Erziehungswissenschaften B.A.; Sonderpädagoge; Rehabilitationspädagoge; Bildungswissenschaften

Stellenbeschreibung:
Die Neue Wege Neue Chancen gGmbH unterhält Hilfsangebote für Menschen, die ihren Alltagsverpflichtungen aus eigener Kraft vorübergehend nicht nachkommen können.

Zweck der Gesellschaft ist die selbstlose Unterstützung von Personen, die in schwierigen Lebenslagen auf die Hilfe anderer angewiesen sind. Wir unterstützen Menschen, die ihren Alltagsverpflichtungen aus eigener Kraft vorübergehend nicht nachkommen können, zur Sicherung der gesellschaftlichen Teilhabe. Ziel ist es, unseren Kundinnen und Kunden durch unsere Unterstützung zu ermöglichen, ihren Alltag besser bewältigen und ein weitgehend selbstbestimmtes Leben zu führen.

Unsere Hilfeleistungen bestehen in der Unterstützung bei administrativen Dingen, zum Beispiel dem Ausfüllen eines Antrags. Hilfe in Alltagsfragen, wie zum Beispiel bei der Suche einer Wohnung. Begleitung zu Behörden oder Ärzten oder anderen sozialen Einrichtungen, wie zum Beispiel einer Schuldnerberatung. Wir sind Ansprechpartner bei Ängsten, Sorgen und Nöten, haben ein offenes Ohr und versuchen gemeinsamen mit den Hilfesuchenden die jeweils beste Lösung zu finden. Häufig ist es für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden schon eine große Hilfe durch unser Angebot eine Bezugsperson mit einem offenen Ohr zu haben.

Eine Berichterstattung über unsere Arbeit sehen Sie in diesem Beitrag:                                                                                                                                                     Wenn die Psyche schmerzt: "Neue Wege Neue Chancen" hilft in schwierigen Lebenslagen (youtube.com) (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Sv0PYEZ2VSw)

WIR SUCHEN

für unsere Standorte in Einbeck und Göttingen je eine/n Fachkraft in der Eingliederungshilfe in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit (Arbeitszeiten nach Absprache) für die Unterstützung unserer Kundinnen und Kunden.

WIR BIETEN

- Eine ausfüllende Tätigkeit, bei der Sie sich für Ihre Mitmenschen einsetzen können.
- Eine unbefristete Festanstellung in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit.
- Arbeitszeiten, die sich nach Absprache an Ihrer Lebenssituation orientieren. Maximal eine 5-Tage-Woche, nach Absprache auch weniger.
- Verzicht auf Schichtarbeit.
- Eine leistungsgerechte Entlohnung.
- Prämien, Boni und geldwerte Leistungen (Notebook, Handy) in Absprache.
- Die Möglichkeit eines Dienstrads, E-Bikes oder Dienstwagens, in Absprache auch zur privaten Nutzung.
- Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
- Fortbildungsangebote.
- Freiheiten, sich einzubringen und eigene Ideen umzusetzen.
- Innerbetriebliche Entwicklungs- und Aufstiegschancen.
- Ein kollegiales Miteinander und ein nettes Team.

SIE

– haben entweder einen Studienabschluss oder eine Berufsausbildung als Sozialarbeiter/in, Sozialpädagoge/in, (Erlebnis-/ Freizeit-) Pädagoge/in, Heilpädagoge/in, Psycholog/in, in Sozialwissenschaften mit dem Wahlfach Erziehungswissenschaften oder in einem vergleichbaren Studium bzw. sind Sucht-, Drogenberater/in, Streetworker/in, Erzieher/in, Heilerziehungspfleger/in, Gesundheits- bzw. Krankenpfleger/in, Altenpfleger/in, Ergotherapeut/in, Sozialtherapeut/in und/ oder haben eine vergleichbare Qualifikation durch eine Tätigkeit in einem Beruf erlangt.
– sind zuverlässig und belastbar
– gehen auf Menschen zu und sind kommunikativ

Wildau bei Berlin

Sie möchten nicht nur planen, sondern aktiv an der digitalen Infrastruktur von morgen mitwirken? In dieser Position bringen Sie Ihre Erfahrung in Telekommunikationsprojekten ein und gestalten zukunftsweisende Netze aktiv mit. - Sie erstellen und pflegen Planunterlagen sowie projektbezogene Informationen

- Sie überzeugen durch Teamfähigkeit sowie ein sicheres und kommunikatives Auftreten

- Unser Kunde sucht langfristig,  weswegen der Arbeitsvertrag selbstverständlich unbefristet ist. Sie haben die Möglichkeit  langfristig spannende Aufgaben zu übernehmen.

Ebenso besteht die Möglichkeit, fortlaufende Weiterbildungen wahrzunehmen und erfolgreich abzuschließen.

Mit mehr als 20 Jahren Firmenbestehen, ist unser Kunde im Bereich der Versorgungstechnik und des Tiefbaus spezialisiert. Diese ist bestrebt seinen Kunden eine Komplettlösung, auf höchstem Niveau anzubieten, um deren Kundenzufriedenheit zu gewährleisten

jobs.title: IT-Systemintegrator / IT-Systemadministrator Microsoft 365 (m/w/d) (IT-Administrator/in)
jobs.description:
IT-Systemintegrator / IT-Systemadministrator Microsoft 365 (m/w/d)

Über uns:

Die Neo Lox GmbH ist ein wachsendes Eisenbahnverkehrsunternehmen. Wir entwickeln flexible Lösungen für Gütertransporte sowie für Baustellen- und Projektlogistik und wickeln den Logistikbedarf unserer Kunden effizient auf der Schiene ab.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir einen IT-Systemintegrator / IT-Systemadministrator Microsoft 365 (m/w/d). In dieser Position unterstützt du unsere interne IT, betreust Arbeitsplätze, Hardware und Microsoft-Systeme und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Mitarbeitenden technisch zuverlässig arbeiten können.

Deine Aufgaben:

Als IT-Systemintegrator / IT-Systemadministrator bist du verantwortlich für die Betreuung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung unserer IT-Arbeitsplätze sowie unserer Microsoft-Systemlandschaft.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:

• Du übernimmst den Einkauf, die Einrichtung, den Austausch und die Pflege von Hardware wie Notebooks, PCs, Monitoren, Druckern, Mobilgeräten und weiterer IT-Ausstattung

• Du richtest neue Arbeitsplätze ein, betreust bestehende IT-Arbeitsplätze und stellst sicher, dass Mitarbeitende zuverlässig mit der benötigten Technik arbeiten können

• Du unterstützt bei der Administration und Pflege unserer Microsoft-Landschaft, insbesondere Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Entra ID und Azure

• Du verwaltest Benutzerkonten, Gruppen, Berechtigungen und Zugriffe und unterstützt bei der Umsetzung sicherer IT-Strukturen

• Du bearbeitest Supportanfragen, analysierst technische Störungen und sorgst für eine schnelle sowie lösungsorientierte Fehlerbehebung

• Du unterstützt bei klassischen Systemadministrator-Aufgaben, zum Beispiel bei Windows-Clients, Benutzerverwaltung, Geräteverwaltung, Updates, Richtlinien und Systemkonfigurationen

• Du pflegst die IT-Dokumentation, unterstützt bei der Inventarisierung von Hardware und Software und wirkst an der Weiterentwicklung interner IT-Prozesse mit

• Du unterstützt bei IT-Security-Themen, zum Beispiel bei Zugriffsschutz, Benutzer- und Rechtekonzepten, Gerätesicherheit, Microsoft-Sicherheitsfunktionen, Updates und Sicherheitsrichtlinien

• Du arbeitest eng mit den Fachabteilungen zusammen und unterstützt bei der technischen Umsetzung neuer Anforderungen

Dein Profil:

- Du verfügst über ein gutes technisches Verständnis und interessierst dich für IT-Systeme, Hardware, Microsoft-Cloud-Lösungen und moderne Arbeitsplatzumgebungen.
- Erste Erfahrung in der Systemintegration, IT-Administration, im IT-Support oder in der Betreuung von IT-Arbeitsplätzen ist von Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich. Auch motivierte Quereinsteiger mit technischem Verständnis, Lernbereitschaft und Interesse an Microsoft-Technologien sind willkommen.
- Wünschenswert sind Kenntnisse in Microsoft 365, Outlook, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Entra ID, Azure und Windows-Umgebungen.
- Von Vorteil sind Erfahrungen oder Grundkenntnisse in typischen Systemadministrator-Aufgaben wie Benutzerverwaltung, Rechte- und Rollenmanagement, Geräteverwaltung, Arbeitsplatzbetreuung, Softwareverteilung, Updates und Fehleranalyse.
- Kenntnisse in Microsoft Entra ID, Azure, Microsoft 365 Admin Center, Exchange Online, Intune, Endpoint Management oder Microsoft Defender sind ein Plus.
- Microsoft-Zertifikate oder die Bereitschaft, Zertifikate im Bereich Microsoft 365, Azure, Entra ID, Endpoint Management oder IT-Security zu erwerben, sind ausdrücklich willkommen.
- Du bringst ein gutes Verständnis für IT-Sicherheit, Datenschutz, Zugriffsschutz und sichere Systemkonfigurationen mit oder hast Interesse, dich in diesen Bereichen weiterzuentwickeln.
- Du arbeitest sorgfältig, zuverlässig und lösungsorientiert und hast Freude daran, technische Probleme zu analysieren und verständlich zu lösen.
- Kommunikationsstärke, Teamfähigkeit und eine serviceorientierte Arbeitsweise runden dein Profil ab.

Unser Angebot:

• Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem wachsenden Eisenbahnverkehrsunternehmen

• Ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit spannenden IT- und Microsoft-Cloud-Themen

• Die Möglichkeit, eigene Ideen einzubringen und interne IT-Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten

• Unterstützung bei Weiterbildung, Schulungen und Microsoft-Zertifizierungen

• Kurze Entscheidungswege und eine offene, kollegiale Zusammenarbeit

• Eine langfristige Perspektive in einem zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen

Warum Neo Lox?

Wir stehen für Wertschätzung, Innovation und Teamgeist.

Bei uns bist du keine Nummer, sondern ein wichtiger Teil unseres Erfolgs.

Wir bieten dir ein Umfeld, in dem du dich weiterentwickeln kannst und langfristig Karriereperspektiven hast.

jobs.description:
Empregado de Mesa

Descrição da empresa

You create experiences for our guests. As an employer, we create experiences for you. How? At The Cloud One, every day is unique. Never same-same, always thrillingly different. With us, you have the freedom to be who you are – or who you want to be. Because here, individuality is what matters. With equal – and exciting – opportunities for all. We believe in an inclusive culture that puts people like you at the heart of what we do, because we know that you’re the ones who make the difference. For us, respect and success go hand in hand. We’re locally rooted: connected to the city, its culture and its people. Are you with us?

Descrição do emprego

Estamos à procura de um(a) Empregado(a) de Mesa com paixão pelo serviço, atenção ao detalhe e vontade de proporcionar experiências memoráveis aos nossos clientes. A pessoa selecionada irá integrar uma equipa dinâmica e colaborativa numa unidade hoteleira em Lisboa, onde o foco está na hospitalidade genuína e no serviço de excelência.

Principais Responsabilidades:

- Receber e acompanhar os clientes de forma cordial e profissional.
- Apresentar o menu, esclarecer dúvidas e fazer sugestões adequadas.
- Servir refeições e bebidas com eficiência, atenção e simpatia.
- Assegurar que todas as necessidades dos clientes são atendidas durante o serviço.
- Preparar e organizar mesas antes e após o serviço.
- Colaborar com a equipa de sala e cozinha para garantir um serviço fluido.
- Cumprir com os padrões de higiene, segurança e qualidade definidos pela unidade.

Qualificações

Formação e Experiência:

- Experiência mínima de 3 anos em funções semelhantes (preferencialmente em hotelaria ou restauração de luxo).
- Formação na área de hotelaria ou restauração (valorizada).

Competências Técnicas:

- Conhecimento de técnicas de serviço à mesa.
- Capacidade de trabalhar com sistemas de POS.
- Conhecimento das normas HACCP.

jobs.title: Jefe de Mantenimiento (Leiter/in - Betriebliche Instandhaltung)
jobs.description:
Jefe de Mantenimiento

Descripción de la empresa

Nuestro corazón es turquesa.

Trabajar para Motel One es como estar en casa de un amigo, donde el reconocimiento y el apoyo gozan de la máxima importancia y las cualidades personales son bien acogidas. Nos tratamos de igual a igual y formamos equipo: desde la dirección hasta los becarios.

Con nuestra pasión conjunta por el diseño moderno y la alta calidad de servicio, creamos un hogar para nuestros huéspedes en Motel One. Nuestros más de 95 hoteles en 13 países impresionan por su diseño exclusivo, los altos estándares de servicio y las ubicaciones privilegiadas en el centro urbano, siempre a un precio atractivo.

Como fundadores y embajadores del concepto de diseño asequible, nos estamos expandiendo con éxito por las ciudades de Europa y más allá. Únase a nuestro equipo y demos forma juntos a Motel One.

Descripción del empleo

Como Jefe de Mantenimiento, será responsable de supervisar y coordinar el mantenimiento integral del establecimiento, garantizando el correcto funcionamiento de las instalaciones, equipos y sistemas. Asimismo, trabajará en coordinación con proveedores y empresas de servicios externas para asegurar unos estándares óptimos de calidad, seguridad y eficiencia.

Entre sus principales responsabilidades se encuentran:

- Supervisar el correcto funcionamiento de los equipos, ascensores e instalaciones técnicas de todo el establecimiento, realizando un seguimiento exhaustivo de cualquier incidencia o deficiencia detectada.
- Actuar como principal enlace de comunicación y coordinación con empresas y proveedores externos, especialmente en la planificación, supervisión y seguimiento de los trabajos de mantenimiento.
- Realizar inspecciones diarias de las instalaciones con el objetivo de identificar posibles averías, desperfectos o necesidades de mantenimiento, así como ejecutar o coordinar las correspondientes labores de reparación y renovación.
- Colaborar estrechamente con los distintos departamentos del establecimiento, adquiriendo una visión transversal de las operaciones y ampliando conocimientos en nuevas áreas de actividad dentro de un entorno de trabajo multicultural.

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Requisitos

- Formación técnica y/o experiencia profesional previa en puestos relacionados con el mantenimiento de edificios, instalaciones o equipos técnicos. También se valorarán perfiles con experiencia en otros ámbitos técnicos que deseen desarrollar su carrera profesional en el sector hotelero.
- Certificación oficial en materia de prevención y control de Legionella, de acuerdo con la normativa vigente en España, para el mantenimiento higiénico-sanitario de instalaciones de riesgo por Legionella.
- Persona responsable, organizada, proactiva y resolutiva, con excelentes habilidades de comunicación y capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma.
- Interés por la tecnología y atención al detalle, con orientación a la prevención y detección de posibles incidencias.
- Flexibilidad, capacidad de adaptación y creatividad para encontrar soluciones eficaces, manteniendo siempre un alto estándar de calidad, incluso en situaciones de presión.
- Clara orientación al trabajo en equipo y disposición para colaborar con los diferentes departamentos del hotel, entendiendo que los objetivos son comunes y que la colaboración entre equipos es fundamental para garantizar el buen funcionamiento del establecimiento.

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator, Fleet (m/f/d) - Berlin (Fachverkäufer/in - Kraftfahrzeuge)
jobs.description:
What to Expect

As Operations Coordinator, Fleet you will help provide our customers with an extraordinary product experience through our internal fleet of vehicles for showroom, events, test drives, mobile rangers, and other purposes. As part of the Central Europe Operations team, you will be responsible for running our fleet operations in the region (DACH and Eastern Europe) and work with our EMEA and local sales and service counterparts to help assign and organize fleet vehicles in the right locations. You will also be responsible for managing their lifecycle into our used car sales process.We offer:

- Career Development & Training: At Tesla, you have the opportunity for personal and professional growth through regular performance reviews, targeted training measures, and further education options (e.g. high-voltage training, management training).
- Company Culture: Immerse yourself in our inspiring company culture, where innovation, teamwork, and passion are at the center.
- Innovative Projects & Technologies: You have the chance to work on groundbreaking projects and technologies that help shape the future of the automotive industry and sustainable energy.
- Benefits & Additional Services: You can expect a competitive salary and benefits package that includes Tesla stock or a Cash Award, access to our Corporate Benefits program, 30 days of vacation, a 13th monthly salary, as well as the option of a company pension scheme and a subsidy for the Deutschlandticket.
- Committed Team & Positive Working Atmosphere: Work in a dedicated and motivated team characterized by a great atmosphere and excellent teamwork. Be part of a team that contributes to a sustainable future and renewable energies.

What You’ll Do

- Fleet Organization: You organize and manage our internal fleet of test drive, showroom, loaner, mobile ranger, and other vehicles
- Cross-Team Collaboration: You collaborate closely with the Registration Team, Used Cars Specialists, Logistics, Local Operation Coordinators, Sales & Service Managers, and other fleet teams
- Efficient Allocation: You keep our fleet allocations clean, ensuring we get the most efficient use out of our vehicles
- Visibility & Oversight: You maintain visibility into all our fleet operations, including the locations of vehicles, the state of the cars, and any actions needed to improve the car or change its use
- Project Support: You support ad-hoc fleet-related projects such as car shows, events, Giga Factory Fleet, and others
- Inventory & Process Improvement: You assist with periodic physical inventory Fleet Audits and continuously improve processes and data structures
- Remarketing Integration: You cooperate with the remarketing team, integrating the vehicle trade-in and resale process to drive allocation of vehicles to various teams (Service, Supercharging, Giga Berlin, etc.)

What You’ll Bring

- Drive & Initiative: You are highly motivated and a self-starter with a strong desire for constant process improvement and the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.
- Industry Passion & Delivery: You are passionate about the automotive industry, bring cross-functional experience, and have a proven ability to drive initiatives to conclusion
- Process Expertise: You have a solid understanding of business processes and are highly attentive to detail, enabling you to understand and improve workflows.
- Relationship Building: You have the ability to establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with both internal and external partners
- Technical Proficiency: You work proficiently with MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and possess advanced computer skills
- Communication Skills: You have strong oral and written communication skills in English; knowledge of German is a plus
- Relevant Experience (Plus): Knowledge of vehicle registration processing and vehicle insurance claims is a plus

Tesla is an Equal Opportunity / Affirmative Action employer committed to diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, gender identity or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

Tesla is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

Privacy is a top priority for Tesla. We build it into our products and view it as an essential part of our business. To understand more about the data we collect and process as part of your application, please view our Tesla Talent Privacy Notice.

Job Requisition ID: 2026_COM_Assistant_10H

Location: Schweinfurt, DE, 97424 (100% On-site / Office-based)

Employment Type: Minijob (Up to €603/month)

Working Hours: 10 hours per week

Company: GEB Technology Europe GmbH

About Us

GEB Technology Europe GmbH is a wholly-owned subsidiary of GEB Shandong Golden Empire Precision Machinery Technology Co., Ltd. GEB focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of precision mechanical components, with a core emphasis on precision stamping technology. The company primarily produces bearing cages, precision automotive components, drive components for electric vehicles, and components for hydrogen fuel cells. Awarded the titles of "National Manufacturing Single Champion Demonstration Enterprise" and "National High-Tech Enterprise," GEB possesses a national enterprise technology center and has accumulated extensive experience in R&D design and intelligent manufacturing. Guided by the corporate philosophy "Quality is Gold, Customer is King," the company drives product innovation and technological advancement to meet high-end market demands. GEB will continuously focus on industries such as new energy vehicles, wind power, and hydrogen energy. Strategically aligned with "green, low-carbon development, and high-precision manufacturing," our goal is to create the world’s leading brand for bearing cages and become a global leader in core components for the new energy industry.

To strengthen our team in the Schweinfurt area, we are looking for a Commercial Assistant (m/f/d) to join us at the earliest opportunity for a part-time / Minijob position.

Your Responsibilities:

- Tax & Monthly Report Review: Assist in reviewing and verifying the daily bookkeeping entries (Buchungssätze) and monthly financial reports (BWA/G&V) prepared by the external German tax advisor (Steuerberater) to ensure data accuracy and compliance.
- HQ Reporting & Data Alignment: Responsible for compiling, translating, and preparing cross-border financial data to ensure information symmetry between the German subsidiary and the Chinese parent company group, acting as a reliable linguistic and cultural bridge.
- Document Management & Archiving: Systematically organize, verify, and archive physical/digital invoices, accounting vouchers, and financial documents; conduct strict compliance checks (e.g., tax IDs, company names, amounts) to meet local German audit requirements.
- Operational & Payment Support: Responsible for verifying various incoming invoices and preparing payment application forms, while assisting in driving and following up on the parent company’s payment approval workflows; conduct compliance pre-audits and data preparation for employee travel expense reports and administrative financial documents before submitting them to the parent company's finance team.

Your Profile:

jobs.title: System Administrator I - (IT Service Delivery) (Anwendungssystemadministrator/in)
jobs.description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a System Administrator I to join our IT Service Delivery team.

In this role, you will be responsible for:

** End-User Support & Troubleshooting**

- Provide on-site and remote end-user support (hardware, software, account/workstation setup) via chat, email, and in person, including scheduled visits to Dmart offices for maintenance and upgrades.
- Log, prioritise, and resolve tickets by business criticality (Jira, ServiceNow), covering networking, printers, and A/V, partnering with the Infrastructure team on larger projects.

** IT Administration & Asset Management**

- Track IT assets through their full lifecycle and maintain MDM (JAMF, Intune) compliance across enterprise devices.
- Support access management (Okta, SailPoint IIQ) and contribute to IT governance and compliance initiatives.

** Process Improvement & Collaboration**

- Maintain onboarding/offboarding efficiency and IT service KPIs/SLAs.
- Partner with senior IT team members to improve processes and automation, staying current on emerging tech.

** AI-Enabled Support & Tooling**

- Use AI assistants (Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) to speed up troubleshooting, draft knowledge-base articles, and summarise recurring issues.
- Pilot AI-assisted automations (prompt templates, scripts, no-code tools) to cut manual work in ticketing and onboarding/offboarding, sharing what works with the team.

Qualifications

- Minimum of 1 year of experience in IT operations or 1st-level support with hands-on experience managing workstations (Windows & MacOS) and endpoint devices.
- Strong troubleshooting skills for hardware and enterprise IT software.
- Ability to work independently and own issues end-to-end.
- High service orientation and excellent customer service skills.
- Strong communication skills (verbal & written).
- Work location type: on-site

Nice-to-Have Skills

- Hands-on experience with JIRA and Confluence for ticketing and documentation
- Administration experience with Slack, Google Workspace, and access management platforms (Okta, SailPoint IIQ)
- Practical experience using AI assistants (Copilot, Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) for support, documentation, or productivity tasks

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week

You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.

jobs.title: Head of E-Commerce / E-Commerce Manager (m/w/d) Albstadt, Tierfuttermittel, Haustierbedarf (E-Commerce-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Job-Typ: Vollzeit

Start: Januar 2027

Location: Albstadt (On-site Präsenz bevorzugt, Remote-Tage nach Absprache

machbar)

Wer wir sind

- Wir sind die Lyra Pet GmbH aus Albstadt (www.lyra-pet.de) – ein ehrliches, hochprofitables und stark wachsendes E-Commerce-Unternehmen im Petfood-Sektor (Fokus auf preisaggressive Grundversorgung in Großgebinden). Wir gehören zu einer größeren Holding, arbeiten hier am Standort aber hands-on, absolut pragmatisch und ohne Corporate-Bullshit. Wir sind ein kleines, schlagkräftiges Team, pflegen eine offene Feedback-Kultur (alle per "Du") und treffen Entscheidungen am Tisch, nicht in endlosen Calls.

Deine Ownership

- Shop- & Marketplace-Strategie: Du übernimmst unseren Webshop und die Marktplätze strategisch und operativ. Dein klares Ziel: Traffic in Sales konvertieren, die Conversion-Rate (CRO) optimieren und den GMV auf das nächste Level skalieren. Diese Position ist für uns ein strategischer Hebel.
- Team Lead: Du führst unser dreiköpfiges Marketplace-Team, das klare Strukturen, Workflows und KPI-getriebene Führung braucht. Zusätzlich teilst du dir die Führung für den Bereich Backoffice/Operations.
- Stakeholder Management: Du bist das zentrale Bindeglied zwischen unserer Muttergesellschaft (Brand & Performance Marketing) und unserer externen E-Commerce- Agentur, die unsere Marktplätze operativ steuert.
- Tech Stack: Wir arbeiten komplett im JTL-Ökosystem (JTL-Shop, JTL-Wawi). Wer eine reine Shopify-Spielwiese sucht, ist hier falsch.

Dein Profil

- Tiefgehende E-Commerce-Erfahrung (Shop-Management, Marktplätze, D2C). Wir setzen das Know-how im Umgang mit ERP-Systemen und Marktplatz-Dashboards im Daily Business voraus.
- Du bist ein Hands-on-Macher: direkt, strukturiert und kommst ohne Buzzword-Bingo aus. Du passt menschlich in ein bodenständiges Team, das Execution über Theorie stellt.
- Im Idealfall hast du tiefes JTL-Know-how – falls nicht, erwarten wir ein selbstständiges, extrem schnelles Onboarding in unsere Systemlandschaft.
- Proven Track Record in der Führung von Mitarbeitern und der operativen Steuerung externer Dienstleister und Agenturen.
- Vollzeit-Commitment. Ein hybrides Setup (Remote-Tage) ist nach Absprache machbar, aber deine regelmäßige Präsenz on-site in Albstadt ist uns für das Team-Alignment und schnelle Iterationen extrem wichtig.

Wir bieten

- Eine Key-Position in einem etablierten Scale-up mit ca. 20 Mio. € Jahresumsatz.
- High Impact, echte Verantwortung und kurze Entscheidungswege direkt mit dem C-Level.
- Ein Setup komplett ohne Schnickschnack, in dem nur Performance und handfeste Ergebnisse zählen.

Interesse?

Schick uns einfach Deine Bewerbung mit Gehaltsvorstellung als PDF an:

bewerbung@lyra-pet.de

jobs.description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are looking for a sharp, curious, and systems-minded Intern, to join our Product Operations, Local Shops team, who combines analytical rigor with strong project management skills. If you thrive in fast-paced, international environments, love building structured processes, and enjoy driving cross-functional alignment, this role is for you.

At Delivery Hero Local Shops team, you will be at the heart of growing our small and medium accounts across 60+ markets. In this role, you will own a portfolio of product enablement workstreams. You will work closely with central Product, Tech, and business functions as well as regional and local entity teams, driving everything from testing new features and preparing go-to-market documentation to evaluating initiative impact and coordinating complex, cross-functional feature rollouts.You will support smooth feature rollouts, help with partner enablement, and contribute to operational rigor across our onboarding and self-service ecosystem by:

- Supporting Feature Rollouts: Support rollout schedules for new operational enablement capabilities, helping coordinate between central Product/Tech teams, regional stakeholders, and local operational leads to support smooth go-lives.
- Testing & Quality Assurance: Support product teams with hands-on user testing, help validate new features, and assist with feedback loop collection prior to wide-scale deployment.
- Documentation & Knowledge Enablement: Help build clear, operational documentation and user guides for regional and local teams to adopt new products.
- Impact Measurement & Reporting: Help track post-launch adoption, support analysis of key performance metrics, and contribute to measuring the operational impact of feature rollouts to provide insights to relevant stakeholders.
- You'll work within a highly international team: spanning 60+ markets, you’ll be exposed to a multi-cultural environment in the central team and interact with diverse regional and stakeholders from day one
- You'll grow fast: the breadth of the role (analytics, operations, commercial) means you'll develop a rare mix of skills in a short time, and learn a lot

Qualifications

- Academic Background: in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
- Some relevant experience: you have prior internship or practical experience in an analytical, operations, or project management role, ideally within a fast-paced startup or multinational environment.
- System & Process-Oriented Mindset: Strong capability to map complex workflows, conduct root cause analysis, and design structured, scalable processes that resolve operational friction.
- Analytical Thinking & Problem Solving: Strong ability to define what success looks like, determining what metrics to measure, mapping how leading and lagging indicators relate, and translating raw data into actionable insights
- Stakeholder Management & Communication: Good written and verbal English communication skills; comfortable supporting alignment across cross-functional teams (including Product, Engineering, and regional business operators).
- Proactivity & Ownership: Self-driven attitude with a bias for action, a curious mindset to ask the “why” and troubleshoot issues independently (leveraging AI tools to move faster and learn on the fly), and the drive to take end-to-end ownership of assigned projects.

jobs.description:
🌟 Stellenangebot: Medizinisch-technische/r Radiologieassistent/in (MTR / MTRA) - Basel, Schweiz

Ihre Perspektive in Basel
Möchten Sie Ihre Fachkompetenz in einem hochmodernen medizinischen Umfeld einbringen und von den attraktiven Rahmenbedingungen des Schweizer Gesundheitswesens profitieren?
Im Auftrag einer renommierten Radiologie-Praxis bzw. Klinik im Raum Basel suchen wir eine engagierte Persönlichkeit mit ausgeprägter Expertise im Bereich der Mammographie sowie Vielseitigkeit in der allgemeinen Bildgebung.
Ihre Aufgaben
Schwerpunkt Mammographie: Eigenverantwortliche und empathische Durchführung von Mammographien auf höchstem technischem Niveau sowie Betreuung der Patientinnen während des gesamten Untersuchungsablaufs.
Allgemeine Radiologische Diagnostik: Kompetente Durchführung von Routine- und Spezialuntersuchungen in den Bereichen Röntgen, Computertomographie (CT) und Magnetresonanztomographie (MRT).
Prozess- & Qualitätsmanagement: Einhaltung und Sicherstellung höchster Qualitäts-, Strahlenschutz- und Hygienestandards.
Patientenorientierung: Professionelle, einfühlsame Vorbereitung und Betreuung der Patienten in einer vertrauensvollen Atmosphäre.
Das bringen Sie mit
Ausbildung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung als MTR / MTRA (Medizinisch-technische/r Radiologieassistent/in) oder eine vergleichbare, in der Schweiz anerkannte Qualifikation.
Fachkompetenz: Nachweisbare, vertiefte Erfahrung und hohe Routine in der Mammographie.
Vielseitigkeit: Gute Praxiskenntnisse und Sicherheit im Umgang mit Geräten der Sparten Röntgen, CT und MRT.
Persönlichkeit: Hohe Sozialkompetenz, Empathie im Umgang mit Patienten sowie eine zuverlässige, selbstständige und teamorientierte Arbeitsweise.
Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
Das erwartet Sie
Attraktive Vergütung: Schweizer Gehaltsstandard inklusive hervorragender Sozialleistungen und Vorsorgekonzepte.
Modernste Technologie: Arbeiten mit Geräten der neuesten Generation in einem dynamischen und professionellen Team.
Umfassender Relocation-Support: Als Deutsch-Schweizer Vermittlungsverbund begleiten wir Sie persönlich beim Übergang nach Basel (Anerkennung der Diplome, Behördengänge, Wohnungssuche, steuerliche Orientierung).
Work-Life-Balance: Geregelte Arbeitszeiten, planbare Schichten und die hohe Lebensqualität der Dreiländereck-Region Basel.
Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt?
Senden Sie Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf, Zeugnisse, Diplome) einfach per E-Mail an uns. Wir begleiten Sie diskret, kostenfrei und Schritt für Schritt auf Ihrem Weg zu Ihrer neuen Herausforderung in der Schweiz!

- Proaktive Neukundenakquise im industriellen Umfeld mit Fokus auf den Ausbau des Kundenportfolios im Gusssegment

- Entwicklung und Umsetzung zielgerichteter Vertriebs- und Marktbearbeitungsstrategien zur nachhaltigen Markterschließung
- Technische und kaufmännische Beratung von Kunden hinsichtlich individueller Gusslösungen mit hoher Lösungsorientierung
- Auf- und Ausbau belastbarer Kundenbeziehungen durch regelmäßige Vor-Ort-Termine und persönliche Betreuung auf Entscheiderebene
- Überzeugende Präsentation und Verhandlung von Angeboten - sowohl vor Ort als auch in digitalen Formaten

Ihre Benefits

- Attraktives Gehalt ab 96.000 € brutto pro Jahr zzgl. leistungsabhängiger Bonusanteile von bis zu 20.000 € jährlich
- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge sowie zusätzliche Absicherung (z. B. Berufsunfähigkeitsversicherung)
- Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten zur fachlichen und persönlichen Entfaltung
- Hohe Gestaltungsspielräume und eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten im Vertriebsbereich
- Zuschüsse und Mitarbeiterangebote, u. a. Mitarbeiterrabatte
- Betriebseigene Kantine sowie ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld
- JobRad-Leasing für mehr Mobilität und Work-Life-Balance
- Betriebsärztliche Betreuung zur Unterstützung Ihrer Gesundheit

Ihr Profil

- Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Gießereitechnik, Maschinenbau oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im technischen Vertrieb, idealerweise in der Gussbranche
- Gute Kenntnisse in SAP sowie im Umgang mit MS Office (insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint)
- Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb industrieller Produkte
- Verständnis für Marktanalysen und Wettbewerbsvergleiche
- Praxis in der Erstellung von Angeboten sowie in Preisverhandlungen
- Kenntnisse in Produktionsprozessen der Metallverarbeitung oder Gießerei
- Gute Englischkenntnisse für die internationale Kommunikation

Unser Angebot ist wie für Sie gemacht? Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung - gern online oder per E-Mail unter der Kennziffer VA47-16526-DDDI bei Herrn Matthias Schreiber.

Auch wir wissen: Kein Mensch ist perfekt, Karrierewege verlaufen selten geradlinig. Entscheidend ist, dass wir den Willen haben, mit- und voneinander zu lernen. Bewerben Sie sich gerne, auch wenn Sie (noch) nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllen. Wir freuen uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen!

jobs.title: Director of Product, Vendor Promotions - Vendor (Product-Lifecycle-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Company Description

As the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience, fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide, powered by tech, designed by people. As one of Europe’s largest tech platforms, headquartered in Berlin, Germany, Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index. We push hard, learn quickly and stay human along the way. It’s this wonderful mix of high performance and real community that makes Delivery Hero a place where ambition and belonging grow side by side. If you’re curious, collaborative and ready to dive deep into meaningful work, you’ll fit right in.

Job Description

We are on the lookout for a Director of Product to join the AdTech team on our journey to always deliver amazing experiences.

As part of our AdTech team, you’ll enable our partners to meet their future customers at the perfect moment. Through a range of products that we have developed to offer advertising solutions, we help restaurants increase their visibility and reach, improve their order conversion, and eventually drive more sales by covering the entire marketing funnel.

In this role, you will lead the development of key features of our vendor-paid promotions products - we’re building some of the most successful and innovative promotions products in the e-commerce industry. Our products enable vendors to rapidly grow their business in a targeted and customized way.

- Own the product vision and strategy to establish vendor promotions as a key lever for Delivery Hero’s success in the marketplace
- Build a world-class e-commerce product through in-depth product discovery, focus on the user, and optimization for long-term product sustainability
- Collaborate within a cross-functional team dedicated team comprised of commercial performance managers, data scientists and analysts, UX researchers, designers and engineers
- Align your ideas with our regional teams and get the buy-in from global and regional C-level stakeholders for your product agenda
- Join our large and growing global product community and act as a product champion and mentor

Qualifications

- 10+ years of experience building digital growth/promotions and products in a high-performance environment
- Strong track record of driving business results
- 7+ years of experience leading teams; ability to motivate and inspire others
- Demonstrated ability to work highly independently with a very high degree of ownership
- Highly analytical profile; ability to evangelise, explain and align the product agenda by reference to data and expected impact
- Strong ability to communicate, listen and negotiate to reach effective solutions in complex organisational environments
- Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken

Additional Information

Ensuring you and all our Heroes are looked after, happy, and healthy is always on the menu. Because if you’re in good shape, then we’re in good shape.

- Make the most of our hybrid working model (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-9/hybrid-work-at-delivery-hero) and join the team for face-to-face connection and collaboration in our beautiful Berlin campus 2 days a week
- We offer 27 days holiday with an extra day on 2nd and 3rd year of service
- We will support you in developing yourself and your career growth opportunities: 1.000 € Educational Budget, Language Courses, Parental Support and access to the Udemy Business platform to explore a variety of online courses.
- Get moving and release those wonderful, mind-boosting endorphins: Health Checkups, Meditation & Gym.
- Cash. Dough. Cheddar. Whatever you call it, we’ll help you with it: Employee Share Purchase Plan, Sabbatical Bank, Public Transportation Ticket Discount, Life & Accident Insurance, Corporate Pension Plan
- The power of getting together over some food is unrivaled. Here are a few ways to help you do that. All the yum: Digital Meal Vouchers and Food Vouchers.
- Wondering what relocating to Berlin is like? In this article, we’ve put together10 things you should know about moving to Berlin (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/blogmoving-to-berlin-guide?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullet+text&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and how Delivery Hero can support you. You can also visit our relocation hub (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/relocation-hub?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) and check out more information about moving to Berlin.
- Ready to prepare for your interview? Check out the list of the 5 most common interview questions and answers (https://careers.deliveryhero.com/delivery-hero/2025-10/the-5-most-common-interview-questions-and-how-to-answer-them?utm_source=jobdescription&utm_medium=bullettext&utm_campaign=JD+Enhancements) created in collaboration with our recruiters.

jobs.title: Programme & Community Developer (Community-Manager/in)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Facilitation; Productowner

Stellenbeschreibung:
Programme & Community Developer Berlin · 32–36 hrs/week · Starting September/October 2026 or by arrangement · fixed on-site times: 3–4 evenings + 1 weekend day

⚠️ Important – please read first: This position is funded exclusively through § 16e SGB II. You can only apply if you meet this funding requirement: **at least 21 of the last 24 months receiving Jobcenter benefits (Bürgergeld/SGB II).**Please note: time with the Agentur für Arbeit (unemployment benefit / Arbeitslosengeld I) does NOT count – only benefits received through the Jobcenter count. If you're unsure whether you qualify, it's best to check quickly with your Jobcenter contact before applying.

About ForEveryone ForEveryone is a non-profit social enterprise in Berlin. We bring people from different backgrounds together, among other things through our community café at Boxhagener Platz and through workshops, events and activities for an international Berlin audience. We are growing, and we are currently reshaping our whole range of activities.

What this role is about We are looking for someone to oversee, develop and be present across our whole range of activities – from workshops to events at our community café at Boxhagener Platz (jam sessions, music nights, exhibitions and more). The clear goal: turning individual activities into recurring small communities with their own memberships. Instead of activities we have to market and fill again every time, we want formats people come back to regularly – a knitting club, a sports format, creative combinations, a recurring music night. You drive this: you sense what the community wants, develop formats to match, test them, run them yourself, recruit and support the volunteers who help carry them, and make sure the good ones actually happen and grow.

What you'll do

- Oversee and support the offering. You keep an eye on all running activities – workshops and café events alike – are regularly present on site, and make sure everything runs smoothly, including the operational side in our booking tool (cancellations, refunds, correct details) – a small but important part of the week.
- Develop and test formats and events. You sense what activities the community wants, identify new workshop, event and mini-formats, research trends and seasonal demand (what are others offering, what works in a summer lull?), and honestly test which formats land well enough to sustain, and which don't.
- Build mini-communities with memberships. You develop formats with recurring communities in mind – ones people belong to as members – and take them from first idea to an established, recurring offering.
- Run activities and enable volunteers. You run workshops and events yourself on a regular basis, at a good standard – weekly, sometimes with support from volunteers. You recruit volunteers (including from among participants), onboard them, give them direct feedback, and support them until they can carry a format.
- Guide formats through their phases. For new formats: experiment and learn from feedback. For established ones: set up clean processes, with reliability and scaling in mind.

What you bring

- Experience running workshops, events, groups or community formats, at a quality others can build on.
- A feel for people and communities, and enjoyment in recruiting and supporting volunteers.
- Conceptual strength: you can develop formats, test them, and judge honestly what works.
- Self-direction and ownership – you drive your area like a genuine project lead.
- Fixed on-site times: at least 3–4 evenings per week (around 2–3 hours each, within the 5–10 pm window) plus 1 day at the weekend (Saturday or Sunday, daytime or evening). These are your core working hours. The rest of your time you can arrange flexibly from the office. This on-site presence comes with a lot of creative freedom, but it is also a clear expectation.
- Comfortable with digital tools; German and English are a strong plus for our multilingual community.

What to expect from us

- A role with real room to shape things: you are building something that doesn't exist yet.
- A small, committed team and real closeness to a lively, international community.
- We set the strategic and financial direction (e.g. the membership model) as managing directors; you develop and decide on the formats independently, with our final sign-off.

Terms

- Hours: 32–36 per week
- Start: September/October 2026 or by arrangement
- Pay: €2,400–2,800 gross/month (at 36 hrs)
- Location: Coworking Kiezlab, Berlin · hybrid

Möchtest du dazu beitragen, eine Welt mit nachhaltigem Wohlstand zu schaffen?Bei Tesla ist das unsere Mission!Als Used Car Sales Advisor (m/w/d) spielst du eine entscheidende Rolle, wenn es darum geht, Kunden auf ihrem Weg zum Besitz eines gebrauchten Tesla-Fahrzeugs zu unterstützen. Du bist ein/e Produktexpert/in, die sich für die Mission von Tesla begeistert und potenziellen Kunden die Vorteile des Besitzes eines „Tesla Certified Pre-Owned“ vermitteln kann. Du wirst mit den Kunden zusammenarbeiten, um deren Bedürfnisse zu verstehen, sie über Tesla-Fahrzeuge aufzuklären und sie durch den Verkaufsprozess zu führen, um sicherzustellen, dass sie eine fundierte Entscheidung treffen.Intern spielst du eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Definition, Umsetzung und dem Erfolg unseres neuen Certified Pre-Owned-Programms.

Wir bieten

- Ein dynamisches und temporeiches Umfeld, in dem Integration, Lernen und Zusammenarbeit der Schlüssel zum Erfolg sind
- Die Möglichkeit mit innovativer Technologie, fortschrittlichen Tools und Software zu arbeiten
- Fortlaufende Schulungen und Weiterbildungen, damit du deine Fähigkeiten und deinen beruflichen Werdegang ausbauen kannst
- Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Vergütungs- und Leistungspaket einschließlich Tesla-Aktien; sowie leistungsorientiere Bonuszahlungen

Was zu tun ist

- Expertise: Du bist ein/e Produktexpert/in für Tesla-Fahrzeuge und -Technologien, die die Vor- und Nachteile älterer Modelle kennt und sich über die neuesten Marktentwicklungen und Branchentrends auf dem Laufenden hält
- Beratung: Das umfassende Informieren potenzieller Käufer über die Merkmale, Vorteile und besonderen Eigenschaften der Tesla-Gebrauchtfahrzeuge, sowie das Erstellen maßgeschneiderter Fahrzeugempfehlungen auf der Grundlage von Kundenpräferenzen gehören zu deinen Aufgaben
- Verkauf: Du schaffst außergewöhnliche Kundenerlebnisse und leitest fachkundig durch den Verkaufsprozess und berücksichtigst dabei Aspekte wie Finanzierungsalternativen, Inzahlungnahme und Liefertermine

Die Familie hat verschiedene Standorte in Deutschland, Österreich, Schweiz, Italien, zu denen sie begleitet wird. ● Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung (HAK/HBLA/HLW).

● Aktive/r Teamplayer/in mit sehr guten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Learning Agility.

● Hochmoderne Arbeitsplätze, die nach neuesten ergonomischen Kriterien optimiert sind.

● Individuelle Entwicklungswege durch vielfältige interne und externe Weiterbildungen.

Hochvolt- und Sicherheitsschulungen sowie weitere Technische Trainings)

Nuestro corazón es turquesa.

Trabajar para Motel One es como estar en casa de un amigo, donde el reconocimiento y el apoyo gozan de la máxima importancia y las cualidades personales son bien acogidas. Nos tratamos de igual a igual y formamos equipo: desde la dirección hasta los becarios.

Nuestros más de 80 hoteles en doce países impresionan por su diseño exclusivo, los altos estándares de servicio y las ubicaciones privilegiadas en el centro urbano, siempre a un precio atractivo.

Como fundadores y embajadores del concepto de diseño asequible, nos estamos expandiendo con éxito por las ciudades de Europa y más allá. Únase a nuestro equipo y demos forma juntos a Motel One.

El objetivo de este puesto es ofrecer una atención profesional a nuestros huéspedes, desde una cálida bienvenida en el check-in hasta una bonita despedida en el check-out. Sus responsabilidades también incluirán las siguientes:

- Atender a nuestros huéspedes, incluyendo la realización del check-in y check-out
- Revisar y procesar reservas, sobrerreservas y otras opciones
- Gestionar la facturación, incluida la gestión de pagos, así como transacciones y cobros en efectivo
- Realizar tareas organizativas y administrativas en el front-office y back-office (por ejemplo, gestión de ausencias, respuesta a correos electrónicos)
- Adquirir conocimientos interdepartamentales sobre nuevas áreas de actividad mediante el trabajo en nuestros equipos multiculturales

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Requisitos

Tanto si es un profesional del mundo de los hoteles como si está cambiando de carrera profesional, ¡estamos seguros de que su perfil encajará en nuestra empresa! ¡La personalidad y los dotes de anfitrión son nuestra prioridad! También tendrá que reunir los siguientes requisitos:

- Tener formación en el sector de los hoteles y/o tener experiencia profesional en la industria hotelera/catering o estar buscando un cambio de carrera profesional
- Tener un excelente sentido de la calidad y el servicio, así como dotes de anfitrión y pasión por la industria hotelera
- Ser una persona abierta y comunicativa y tener un sólido dominio del inglés
- Ser una persona a la que le guste trabajar en equipo y que esté dispuesta a proporcionar asistencia en todos los departamentos: ¡en Motel One, los objetivos son conjuntos, así que nos ayudamos entre todos!

jobs.description:
Senior Accountant Manager

Opis firmy

Ponad 100 hoteli w 13 krajach, które imponują wyjątkowym designem, najwyższymi standardami obsługi i doskonałymi lokalizacjami w samym sercu miast, a wszystko to w atrakcyjnej cenie. Jako założyciel i prekursor koncepcji budget design, z sukcesem rozwijamy się w metropoliach Europy i poza nią.

Opis oferty pracy

- Prowadzenie i nadzór nad księgowością operacyjną hoteli w Polsce zgodnie z obowiązującymi standardami oraz wytycznymi Centrali;
- Uzgadnianie rejestru VAT zakupu i sprzedaży;
- Raportowanie wyników finansowych dla hoteli w Gdańsku i Warszawie do Centrali, w tym analiza odchyleń oraz rekomendowanie działań korygujących.
- Ścisła współpraca z działem Controllingu, audytorami i pozostałymi działami hotelowymi w zakresie zagadnień finansowych, w tym obsługi procesów KSeF.
- Przygotowywanie przelewów do płatności, księgowanie wyciągów, rozliczanie kart kredytowych
- Przygotowywanie tygodniowych, miesięcznych i rocznych raportów finansowych zgodnie z wymaganiami działu kontroli finansowej.
- Czynny udział w procesach zamknięcia miesiąca, obejmujący uzgadnianie kont, kontrolę kosztów, inwentaryzację oraz weryfikację danych operacyjnych hoteli.
- Zapewnienie terminowego przygotowania dokumentacji do składania deklaracji podatkowych oraz zgodności z przepisami prawa podatkowego.
- Wsparcie w bieżących analizach finansowych oraz projektach związanych z optymalizacją kosztów i efektywnością operacyjną hoteli.
- Dbanie o prawidłowy obieg dokumentów w firmie oraz weryfikacja prawidłowości dokumentów księgowych

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Kwalifikacje

- Wyższe wykształcenie ekonomiczne;
- Min. 4 lata doświadczenia w dziale kontrolingu, mile widziane w branży hotelarskiej;
- Praktyczna, zaawansowana znajomość pakietu MS Office (w szczególności Excel);
- Znajomość języka angielskiego lub niemieckiego - warunek konieczny;
- Znajomość specyfiki finansów hotelowych (USALI) oraz wskaźników charakterystycznych dla branży hotelarskiej;
- Wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności analitycznego myślenia;
- Samodzielność oraz dobra organizacja pracy;
- Odpowiedzialność i terminowość;
- Gotowość do odbywania delegacji służbowych.

jobs.description:
Receptionist

Company Description

Our heart beats turquoise.

Working at Motel One is like coming home to friends, where you can be your true self and where appreciation and support matter. We meet on an equal footing and see ourselves as one team: from our management to our trainees.

We create a home away from home for our guests with our shared passion for modern design and high-quality service. Our more than 100 hotels in 14 countries impress with exclusive design, high service standards and first-class inner-city locations at an attractive price.

As the founder and pioneer of the budget design concept, we are successfully expanding in the metropolises of Europe and beyond. Become part of our team and develop Motel One with us.

Job Description

As a Receptionist, you are the first and last impression of our hotel, placing the guest at the centre of everything you do. You will deliver a warm, genuine and professional welcome, ensuring every interaction creates a positive and memorable experience. From managing check-ins and check-outs to responding to guest enquiries and resolving requests with care and efficiency, you will provide exceptional service while working collaboratively with your colleagues to exceed guest expectations. You will take pride in creating a welcoming atmosphere, anticipating guests' needs and ensuring every stay reflects the high standards and hospitality of Motel One.

Qualifications

- Previous experience in a hotel reception or customer service role is desirable.
- Experience using Opera Cloud or a similar Property Management System (PMS) is an advantage, although full training will be provided.
- A warm, friendly and professional personality with a genuine passion for delivering exceptional guest service.
- A positive attitude, strong communication skills and the ability to remain calm and organised in a fast-paced environment.
- A proactive team player who takes pride in creating memorable guest experiences.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to multitask while maintaining high standards of service.
- Must be eligible to work in Ireland and currently resident in Ireland.

Security & Identity

Cloud Security

Data Security & Compliance

AI & Security Innovation
