jobs.title: PhD Stipend in Intelligent Industrial Energy Systems, Physics-informed AI, digital twins and advanced control
jobs.description:
Help build the systems that will electrify industry
Industrial energy systems are about to change fundamentally. For more than a century, industrial processes have been designed as isolated, deterministic systems. You model them, you optimize them, you operate them. That paradigm is breaking down. As electricity replaces fossil fuels, industrial systems must operate under fundamentally new conditions: fluctuating renewable energy, dynamic electricity prices, and increasing system complexity.

In the future, industrial energy systems will not simply run.

  • They will understand themselves.
  • They will learn from data.
  • They will anticipate and adapt.
  • They will optimize continuously.

At Aalborg University, we are starting to build the scientific foundations for those systems. We are looking for a PhD researcher who wants to be part of that.

The stipend is open for appointment from 15 September 2026 or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

What this PhD is really about
This PhD focuses on modelling and controlling electrified industrial thermal systems under real-world conditions. The work is embedded in a collaborative research project with industrial partners, providing access to realistic system configurations, experimental setups and operational data. The scientific ambition is to develop methods that combine physical models and data-driven approaches for adaptive, real-time operation of complex energy systems. Applications such as drying processes serve as test cases, but the goal is to establish methodologies that extend across industrial thermal systems more broadly.

How do we create industrial energy systems that combine physics and data to become adaptive, autonomous and trustworthy?
To get there, you will work at the intersection of thermal energy systems, machine learning and scientific AI, system modelling and identification, as well as optimization and control.

Your work will focus on developing new methods that integrate first-principles models with data-driven learning, supported by reduced-order representations and designed for real-time optimization and control. In essence, this is about physics-informed AI-approaches where physical insight and data reinforce each other rather than compete.

The ambition is to move beyond abstract or idealized solutions. Think digital twins that are not just conceptual, but genuinely useful in practice. Think control systems that can operate robustly under uncertainty, rather than relying on simplified assumptions.

The systems you will be working with are real world, industrial scale energy systems rather than simplified lab set-ups. They include high-temperature, high-power applications, including heat pumps, thermal storage, and complex process units, where both physical understanding and intelligent control are essential.

What you will do
Your day-to-day research will move between theory, modelling and real systems.

  • You will build mathematical and physics-based models of complex thermal systems.
  • You will develop reduced order representations enabling real-time implementation suited for online optimization of operating conditions and control.
  • You will combine the models with data driven learning to adapt to varying operating conditions.
  • You will design control strategies that can operate under real-world constraints.

Some of your work will be purely theoretical. Some of it will be validated against experimental setups and industrial data. You will publish your work, present it internationally, and build a research profile that is relevant far beyond this specific application.

The environment you will step into
You will not be placed inside a narrow, predefined research group. Instead, you will work across a small, complementary team that brings together different pieces of the puzzle:

thermal systems and physical modelling advanced control and system-level thinking industrial electrification and future energy technologies

This is an emerging collaboration, not a finished structure.  This means that you are not just executing a predefined roadmap. You are helping shape the direction.

Your supervisors
You will be supported by a team with different strengths, scientifically and personally.

Henrik Sørensen is Head of Section and your main supervisor. His focus is not only on research, but on building researchers. He will push you, give you space, and expect you to grow into an independent scientist.

Henrik C. Pedersen is Vice Head of Research and one of the key profiles within modelling and control at AAU. He will challenge your thinking, sharpen your methods and connect your work to a broader scientific context.

Anna Lyhne Jensen represents the next generation of energy researchers.
Her work focuses on electrification of industrial processes and future thermal systems, and she is deeply engaged in the green transition. She will be your closest collaborator in many parts of the project.

Together, the team is not uniform, and that is exactly the point. No single discipline can solve this problem.

Who you are
You likely have a background in energy engineering, mechanical engineering, control, applied mathematics, physics or a related field.

But more importantly, we are looking for someone who:

  • Has a strong curiosity about how complex systems actually work.
  • Is comfortable with mathematical modelling and analytical thinking.
  • Is motivated to combine physical insight with data-drive methods.
  • Enjoys building models and methods – not just analyzing existing ones.
  • Has the ambition and persistence to tackle difficult problems and carry them through.

This is a demanding PhD. It requires both independence and engagement, and a willingness to work at the intersection of disciplines. You don’t need to know everything from the start - but you should have a clear drive to develop expertise and contribute at a high scientific level.

What you get out of it
This PhD is not just about writing three papers and moving on. It is about building a profile that sits at the intersection of energy systems, AI & modelling and optimization & control. That combination is rare, and extremely valuable, both in academia and industry.

  • You will work with real systems, real data and real problems.
  • You will collaborate with industry.
  • You will be part of the broader European research landscape in energy and sustainability.

And you will have a high degree of freedom to shape your own direction.

Why this matters
Industrial heat is one of the hardest parts of the green transition. Electrification alone is not enough. If we cannot control and optimize these systems intelligently, we will not unlock their full potential. This PhD is about contributing to these missing pieces.

Expected starting date is 15 September 2026 or as soon as possible thereafter.

Interested?
If you want to work on something that is technically challenging, scientifically interesting, and actually matters — we would like to hear from you. Applications should include a CV, transcripts and a short motivation.

For further information, feel free to contact:

Henrik Sørensen, hs@energy.aau.dk

Qualification requirements
PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at: the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are    
AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real‑world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg campus.
AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday life. New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk.

How to apply
Your application must include the following:

  • Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV)
  • Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades) 
  • Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website. 

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Further information  
Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.
Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

Salary and terms of employment
When pursuing a PhD at Aalborg University, you'll receive a stipend which includes both salary
and pension benefits. The base salary starts at a minimum of 31.242,75 DKK before taxes, with an
additional 18,07% added for pension contributions. However, the final salary can be negotiated
based on your qualifications and experience, with seniority playing a key role in determining the
main salary.
Read more about pension options here.

At Aalborg University's Doctoral School, engineering PhD students enjoy unique career
development opportunities. These include personalized DISC profile assessments with feedback,
career-focused courses, and networking events with trade unions, employers, and other relevant
parties. Learn more about these initiatives at our Career Hub.

The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities (the Appointment Order) and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities (in Danish).

Salary and terms of employment are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) (in Danish) 

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world
Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

Keitä olemme?

Ramudden luo kokonaisvaltaisia työturvallisuusratkaisuja tietöihin, rakennuksiin, tiloihin, rautateille ja erilaisiin infrastruktuurin projekteihin. Teemme työmme turvallisesti ja välittäen!

Haemme liikenteenohjaajia useille työmaille pääkaupunkiseudulle! Mitä tarjoamme? Tarjoamme turvallisen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön. Laadukkaat työvälineet ja -varusteet

Reilun ja tasapuolisen kohtelun

Vaihtelevia työmaita ja työpäiviä

Mahdollisuuden edetä uralla sekä Erilaisia työsuhde-etuja

jobs.title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
jobs.description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor DK summer / Spain winther

About the Role

As a Flight Instructor, your primary responsibility will be delivering flight training onboard our aircraft. Depending on operational needs, you may also conduct simulator sessions and classroom-based theoretical instruction.

You will guide students throughout their training journey and help ensure the highest standards of pilot education.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI

  • Set to have a split base between Denmark in the summer and Spain in the winter

  • Based in either DK or Spain

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Ready for Take-Off?

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

Relocation: Candidates must be willing to relocate and live within commuting distance of our base in Aarhus, DK fulltime or parttime depending on the position.

jobs.title: Guide
jobs.description:
Activity Guide

We are now looking for an **Activity Guide** to join our team. In this role, you will be at the heart of our international activity operations – safely guiding our guests through unique nature experiences and contributing to the development of our activity services.

What we offer

- Meaningful work with one of the pioneers of tourism in Lapland, where sustainability and quality are at the heart of everything we do.

- An inspiring working environment: in your free time, you can enjoy the peace and beauty of Laplands nature – skiing, hiking, fishing or watching the Northern Lights.

- The support of an encouraging work community: you will work in an international environment with the warm and relaxed atmosphere of a family-owned company.

- A wide range of staff benefits and opportunities for personal and professional development.

- Staff accommodation can be arranged if needed.


Your responsibilities

- Safely and professionally guiding guests on a variety of activities, such as snowshoeing, snowmobile safaris, Northern Lights excursions and ice fishing.

- Ensuring excellent guest experiences through warm, clear communication and professional service.

- Preparing equipment and maintaining activity areas.

- Working in the equipment storage and service area.

- Following safety guidelines and company procedures.

- Supporting the development of activity products and daily operations.

- Reporting to the Activity Manager.


Who are we looking for?

You are responsible, proactive and passionate about the outdoors and customer service. You enjoy seasonal work where no two days are exactly the same and thrive in an international environment.

You have:

- Solid experience in guiding or outdoor activities; previous experience in Lapland is considered an advantage.

- Good physical fitness and a safety-first mindset.

- The ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

- Excellent communication and customer service skills.

- Fluency in English; other language skills, such as Finnish, German or French, are considered an advantage.

- A valid Category B driving licence.

- A willingness to learn and develop your skills.


Ready for an adventure?

If you have a passion for nature, adventure and creating unforgettable guest experiences, you might be the person we are looking for.

**Start date:** Late November.

If this sounds like you and you are interested in joining our team, send us your application and CV. We would love to hear from you!

Harriniva Hotels & Safaris

Harriniva Hotels & Safaris is a family-owned pioneer of tourism in Lapland, located in Muonio in Fell Lapland, close to the Swedish border. Founded in 1973 as a camping and caravan site on the banks of the Tornio–Muonio River, Europes longest free-flowing river, Harriniva has grown into three full-service resorts surrounded by the pristine nature of Lapland.

Today, Harriniva Hotels & Safaris consists of **Harriniva Adventure Resort**, **Jeris Lakeside Resort** and **Torassieppi Eco Reindeer Resort**.

Every day, our team works to deliver on our promise: **Best in Wilderness**. At Harriniva, we do our utmost to ensure that every guest experiences the unique nature of Lapland in an unforgettable way – taking home lasting memories and the feeling of being at their best in the wilderness.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant to the Secretary General (maternity cover)
jobs.description:
Are you a strategic thinker, structured and with exceptional execution and communication skills? And do you have experience with executive and strategic support to senior management and knowledge of humanitarian and global affairs? We are looking for an experienced, proactive, extrovert and solutions oriented Executive Assistant to the Secretary General of the Danish Refugee Council (DRC). You will support the Secretary General in her daily work, work closely with the DRC Executive Management Team and engage with a variety of internal and external stakeholders.

About the job

The office of the Secretary General is a small dynamic team, supporting the Secretary General, the Executive Management Team, the Board of Directors, and the Council of DRC. The office also supports DRC’s overall organisational processes and its overall strategy, provides management and administrative support to the Secretary General, and organises global staff meetings. The office works and coordinates closely with departments in headquarters as well as DRC offices across the world.

 

Your key responsibilities will include:

·         Day-to-day comprehensive executive support and advice to the Secretary General, including on external engagements, positioning and communication, in close coordination with relevant teams. Liaising and communicating clearly and professionally on behalf of the Secretary General internally in DRC and with external stakeholders.

·         Support to the Executive Management Team (EMT), including preparation of agendas and presentations, decision-making documents and minutes, follow-up to decisions, and preparation of regular bilateral meetings between the SG and EMT members, including agenda setting. 

·         Coordinating and advising on processes for preparing the Secretary General’s external engagements, including drafting and proof reading of products (briefs, talking points, presentations etc.) for the Secretary General, and ensure timely and efficient follow-ups and minutes, and feedback to relevant teams.

·         Making sure that the Secretary General receives information requiring her attention and action and managing the Secretary General’s calendar.

·         Identify opportunities to simplify processes and strengthen ways of working through digital tools, automation and AI-enabled solutions.

·         Ensuring expense management in Microsoft Dynamics, related to SG travels, events and meetings (primary task of student assistant).

·         Ensuring legalisation of documents required across the organisation, including notarisation, apostilles, and coordination with embassies and translation services (primary task of student assistant).

 

About you

To be successful in this role we expect you to have:

·         A relevant master’s degree in international relations, political science or similar.

·         Excellent collaboration, analytical, organisational and communication skills, a flexible and solution-oriented attitude, and a structured and independent way of working with the ability to see the bigger picture while maintaining a strong attention to detail and high-quality deliverables.

·         Ability to maintain overview of a broad operational and political portfolio, advise on priorities and ensure timely execution and follow-up.

·         Solid knowledge of humanitarian affairs and operations, as well as international relations and developments impacting the work of DRC.

·         Experience in interacting with many different stakeholders, including high level, ideally from diplomacy and/or external relations from a global organisation.

·         Ability to deliver high-quality analytical inputs, and to draft complex briefing materials, talking points, and political or legal reports in fast-paced, high-pressure environment is required.

·         Full professional proficiency in Danish and English. Basic knowledge of French and/or Spanish is desirable.

 

All employees should master DRC's core competencies:

Striving for excellence: You focus on reaching results while ensuring an efficient process. 

Collaborating: You involve relevant parties and encourage feedback. 

Taking the lead: You take ownership and initiative while aiming for innovation. 

Communicating: You listen and speak effectively and honestly. 

Demonstrating integrity: You uphold and promote the highest standards of ethical and professional conduct in relation to our values and Code of Conduct, including safeguarding against sexual exploitation, abuse and harassment.

We offer

An interesting workplace with excellent colleagues and plenty of scope for contribution with your own ideas. The possibility of working closely with and supporting the Secretary General and the Executive Management Team, as well as colleagues across our global organisation.

Contract length: 9 months with the possibility of extension (maternity cover)

Work location: Lyngbyvej 100, 2100 Copenhagen Ø, just by Ryparken station

Start date: mid-November 2026 or the soonest hereafter

Salary and conditions will be in accordance with the agreement between DRC and AC. This is a national position for which local terms and conditions apply. Salary will be determined based on qualifications.

Please note that you need to have the right to work in Denmark (through nationality or existing work visa) in order to be considered for this role. 

 

Application process

All applicants must upload a cover letter and an updated CV in English (no longer than four pages) as well as degree certificate. Applications sent by email will not be considered.

Closing date for applications: 2 September 2026. We expect to conduct interviews in September.

Further information 

For questions regarding the vacancy please contact Vibeke Bach Madsen, Corporate Strategic Advisor in the Secretary General’s Office: vibeke.bach.madsen@drc.ngo. We will do our best to respond to as many inquiries as possible.

For more information about the Danish Refugee Council, please visit our website drc.ngo.

Danish Refugee Council is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and positive work environment based on mutual respect for all employees. All applicants are considered for employment regardless of personal characteristics or attributes.

jobs.title: Välinehuoltaja
jobs.description:
**Välinehuoltaja tunturiin talvikaudelle 2026-2027 – tule mukaan huippuporukkaan!**

Haluatko viettää talven tunturissa ja työskennellä laadukkaiden talvivälineiden parissa? Etsimme Levi Ski Resortin vuokraamoon ja välinehuoltoon motivoitunutta ja oma-aloitteista välinehuoltajaa talvikaudelle 2026-2027.

Tehtävässä pääset huoltamaan laskettelu-, lumilautailu- ja maastohiihtovälineitä sekä työskentelemään osana Suomen johtavan hiihtokeskuksen ammattitaitoista tiimiä. Työ sisältää myös asiakaspalvelua, vuokraustoimintaa sekä muita monipuolisia välinevuokraamon tehtäviä.

**Mitä työ pitää sisällään?**

Pääset osaksi Levi Ski Resortin välinehuollon ja vuokraamon rentoa ja osaavaa tiimiä. Päivittäisiin tehtäviisi kuuluvat muun muassa:

- Laskettelu-, lumilauta- ja maastohiihtovälineiden huolto

- Välineiden vastaanotto ja käyttökuntoon valmistelu

- Asiakaspalvelu ja vuokraustoiminta

- Välineiden kunnon seuranta ja varaston ylläpito

- Muut vuokraamon monipuoliset työtehtävät

- Kilpatason alppi- ja maastohiihtovälineiden kisahuollot


Työnkuvaan kuuluu myös vaativien, kilpatason välineiden niin sanottujen kisahuoltojen tekeminen sekä alppi- että maastohiihtovälineille. Pääset työskentelemään huippuluokan huoltolaitteiden ja materiaalien parissa sekä vastaamaan aktiiviharrastajien ja kilpaurheilijoiden välineiden suorituskyvystä. Tehtävä tarjoaa erinomaisen mahdollisuuden syventää osaamista talviurheiluvälineiden huollossa aina kilpatasolle asti. Yksikään päivä ei ole samanlainen, ja pääset työskentelemään sekä kotimaisten, että kansainvälisten asiakkaiden parissa.

**Miksi meille töihin?**

Tarjoamme sinulle:

- Monipuolisen työn ainutlaatuisessa tunturiympäristössä


Nykyaikaiset työvälineet ja laadukkaat huoltolaitteet

- Kannustavan ja hyvähenkisen työyhteisön

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää ammattitaitoasi välinehuollon ja asiakaspalvelun parissa

- Henkilöstöedut, joiden avulla pääset nauttimaan rinteistä ja laduista myös vapaa-ajalla


**Mitä toivomme sinulta?**

- Aikaisempaa kokemusta laskettelu-, lumilauta- ja maastohiihtovälineiden huollosta, niin käsin tehdyistä, kuin koneellisista huolloista ja kilpatason välinetuntemusta

- Perustietämystä talviurheiluvälineistä ja alueen palveluista

- Reipasta ja positiivista asennetta

- Valmius työskennellä sesonkiluonteisessa työssä, iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin sekä huippusesongeissa

- Kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti, että osana tiimiä

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittää osaamistasi

- Suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa


Eduksi katsotaan pyörien huolto-osaaminen sekä muu tekninen kokemus välineiden kunnossapidosta.

**Työsuhteen tiedot**

- Työsuhteen kesto: määräaikainen, noin marraskuu 2026 – huhtikuu 2027

- Työaika: keskimäärin 37,5 h / viikko

- Palkkaus: Hiihtokeskusalan työehtosopimuksen mukaisesti

- Työnantaja: Oy Levi Ski Resort Ltd


Majoitus: Oman majoituksen järjestäminen on ensisijaisesti hakijan vastuulla. Tarvittaessa voimme kuitenkin auttaa majoituksen järjestämisessä yhteismajoituksessa muiden hiihtokeskuksen kausityöntekijöiden kanssa.

Työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan syksyllä 2026. Tarkempi aloitus- ja päättymisajankohta sovitaan valitun henkilön kanssa sesongin tarpeiden mukaan.

jobs.title: Face Deduplication Collection
jobs.description:
The project compensation rate is $0.55 USD per accepted image.

The objective of this project is to collect a large and diverse dataset of current neutral selfies, head-pose captures, and historical facial images to support machine-learning research and facial recognition model training at TELUS.

 

The focus is on capturing real-world variation across lighting, poses, expressions, accessories, environments, and aging to improve model accuracy and robustness. The collection includes:

 

• Current Neutral Selfies – clean frontal selfies serving as high-quality identity references, with natural variation in appearance and surroundings.

• Current Head-Pose Captures – selfies captured in assigned head directions to introduce pose variation.

• Historical Images – older photos from participants’ galleries to capture natural aging and long-term appearance changes.

 

To qualify for payment, you must submit a minimum of 20 valid images. The maximum payout is based on 24 accepted images. Due to the strict automated and manual Quality Control (QC) process, we strongly recommend submitting 30 images to help ensure that enough images remain valid after review

 

Note: Please use a Gmail address as your primary account when applying for this project.

 

Qualification path

 

No specific education is needed to perform the project task.

jobs.title: Verkkoasiantuntija, Patria Oyj, Tampere
jobs.description:
Tehtävänkuvaus

Verkkoasiantuntijana toimit keskeisessä roolissa Patrian tietoliikennetiimissä vastaten vaativien ja turvaluokiteltujen verkkoympäristöjen (mukaan lukien TL3 ja TL4) toimivuudesta ja kehityksestä. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä datacom-tiimin ja ratkaisuarkkitehtien kanssa varmistaen, että tietoliikenneverkot täyttävät niille asetetut laatu- ja turvallisuusvaatimukset.

Patrialla pääset työskentelemään teknologisesti haastavassa ja yhteiskunnallisesti merkittävässä ympäristössä, jossa jokainen ratkaisu on osa suurempaa kokonaisuutta. Asemapaikkasi on Tampereella.

Tarjoamme vastuullisen ja ainutlaatuisen roolin puolustusteollisuuden toimintaympäristössä, jossa pääset näkemään sellaista teknologiaa ja toteutuksia, joita ei siviilisektorilla tule vastaan. Patrialla työskentelet osana kokenutta tiimiä, jossa asiantuntijuuttasi arvostetaan ja jossa saat tueksesi tekniseen laatuun ja turvallisuuteen tähtäävän työyhteisön.

Työtehtävät
- Ympäristöjen ylläpito-, konfigurointi- ja ongelmanratkaisutehtävät (sisältäen palomuurit, reitittimet, kytkimet ja WLAN-tukiasemat).
- Virtuaaliverkkojen (VLAN) ylläpito ja optimointi.
- Aktiivinen yhteistyö ja sparraus datacom-tiimin sekä ratkaisuarkkitehtien kanssa.

Etsimme

- Työkokemusta: Vahvaa, noin 5 vuoden kokemusta vaativista tietoliikenneverkoista ja monimuotoisista ympäristöistä.
- Teknistä osaamista: Syvällistä ymmärrystä IT-verkkojen toimintalogiikasta, reitityksestä sekä palomuuriteknologioista. Ymmärrystä siitä, kuinka tietoverkot rakentuvat (mukaan lukien IPv4-osoitelaskenta, VLAN-tekniikka, dynaaminen ja staattinen reititys, verkkolaitteiden konfiguraatioiden tulkinta sekä tietoliikenteen perustermistö).
- Prosessiosaamista: Kykyä omaksua ohjeistuksia ja noudattaa sovittuja prosesseja tarkasti turvallisuuskriittisessä ympäristössä.
- Kielitaitoa: Sujuva suomen ja englannin kielen taito.

Eduksi katsomme: Kokemuksen useiden eri laitevalmistajien ratkaisuista, laiteautentikaatiosta, edistyneestä vianselvityksestä sekä kokemuksen viranomaisvaatimuksista (esim. Katakri) tai muun viitekehyksen ympärille rakennetun ympäristön kanssa toimimisesta.

Tehtävään valitulle henkilölle tullaan tekemään perusmuotoinen turvallisuusselvitys sekä huumausainetestaus.

Rekrytointiprosessimme
Academic Work hoitaa tätä hakua asiakkaansa puolesta, jonka toiveena on kaikkien tehtävää koskevien kysymysten osoittaminen Academic Workille.

Hakijoita haastatellaan jatkuvasti ja mikäli olemme edenneet jo rekrytointiprosessissa pidemmälle, saatamme sulkea haun ennen lopullisia valintoja. Valintaprosessiin sisältyvät luonteenpiirteitä sekä kognitiivista kykyä mittaavat testit. Testit toimivat työkaluina oikean tekijän löytämiseksi tehtävään sekä takaavat tasa-arvoisen ja oikeudenmukaisen arvioinnin.

jobs.title: Närvårdare, Södragatan
jobs.description:
Arbetsuppgifterna är mångsidiga och varierande. Det handlar om att skapa en välfungerande vardag tillsammans med dem som bor på Södragatan genom stöd och service i att ta hand om sig själv, sitt hem och sina relationer utifrån personens egna förutsättningar. Vi samarbetar med andra enheter inom Kommunernas socialtjänst k.f., och med den enskilda klientens nätverk.

Som person ser vi att du har lätt för att kommunicera med andra och har ett gott bemötande. Du är flexibel och noggrann i ditt arbete, du har en god samarbetsförmåga men trivs även med att arbeta på egen hand. Framför allt tycker du att det är roligt och stimulerande att arbeta med människor! Vi lägger stor vikt vid personliga egenskaper och tror att du med ditt arbete kan bidra till det vi har fokus på i all verksamhet - delaktighet, självständighet och livskvalitet.

Som stöd i arbetet håller vi regelbundet gemensamma arbetsgruppsmöten och får metodhandledning i grupp. Inom KST värnar vi om arbetstagarens möjlighet att förena arbete med familjeliv och fritid. I företagshälsovården ingår sjukvård på allmänläkarnivå och i våra friskvårdförmåner ingår massage, kultur och motion.

För en tillsvidareanställning är behörighetskravet närvårdare eller motsvarande examen registrerad i Valvira. Sökanden utan närvårdarexamen kan komma att beaktas för visstidsanställning i brist på behöriga sökanden.

Anställningen är tillsvidare på 80 procent (30,60 h/vecka) i periodarbetstid. Den uppgiftsrelaterad lönen är 80 % av 2 948,07 euro vid formell behörighet, samt eventuella erfarenhetstillägg. Arbetet inleds enligt överenskommelse. Prövotid om 6 månader tillämpas och intervjuer kan ske löpande under ansökningstiden.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja (78,43 %), Pixne-klinikka, Maalahti
jobs.description:
Haemme osa-aikaista (78,43 %) lähihoitajaa Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialueelle, alkusijoituspaikka Pixne-klinikka Maalahdessa.

Pixne-klinikka tarjoaa sosiaalityön päätöksen tai maksusitoumuksen perusteella laitoskuntoutusta henkilöille, joilla on päihdeongelma tai päihdesairaus.

Lähihoitajan työ Pixne-klinikalla on vaihtelevaa ja monipuolista. Työssä menestyminen edellyttää joustavuutta, hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä. Kuntoutusohjelma on strukturoitu, ja sitä toteutetaan ryhmäterapeuttisten menetelmien sekä yksilöllisen ohjauksen avulla.

Yksikkö on ruotsinkielinen, mutta arvostamme suomen kielen taitoa.

Tervetuloa tiimiimme!

Lähihoitajan tutkinto tai terveydenhuollon ammattihenkilöistä annetun asetuksen (564/1994) tai valtioneuvoston sosiaalihuollon ammattihenkilöistä antaman asetuksen (153/2016) mukainen tutkinto.
Tyydyttävä suullinen ja kirjallinen taito ruotsin kielessä.
Yksikkö on ruotsinkielinen.

Lähihoitajatutkinnon suorittaneilta edellytetään rekisteröitymistä Valviran molempiin ammattihenkilörekistereihin, Terhikkiin ja Suosikkiin.

Valitulla tulee olla voimassa tartuntatautilain (1227/2016) 48 § mukainen rokotussuoja.

Sovelletaan koeaikaa.

jobs.title: Demand Generation Lead, Growth
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America and Europe, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the last year we’ve made a lot of progress producing quality content and messaging, and we’re now looking for someone to help us distribute it to the right audiences.

As Demand Generation Lead, you’ll own how future customers find and first experience Linear, across web, search, and paid media. Your objective is to build awareness and pipeline, particularly with larger companies.

It’s likely this role will operate and feel a little different to what you might find elsewhere. Linear is a very brand forward company, so there will be scenarios where we have to turn down seemingly great opportunities to protect perception. We’re unlikely to ever use retargeting pixels and gated content, for example.

We’ve got a basic demand motion in place today but we’ve barely scratched the surface. As the first demand generation hire, you’ll own the strategy and lead on delivering it.

The marketing team is small but has an outsized impact, and we intend to keep it that way. You’ll have real influence on how Linear grows, and you’ll be encouraged to take ownership and deploy tooling and practices that help you be more effective.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in the US and Europe. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Work with Magic, our in-house design team, on the web pages and ad creative that future customers see first

 - Own paid media end to end, from channel strategy and budget to the creative itself, including account-based campaigns for enterprise accounts in partnership with sales and event marketing

 - Own search, both the classic kind and the answers AI gives when someone asks which tools to use

 - Define how we measure success for this motion

 - Use AI and automation tools actively to move faster and do more. This is a core part of how we expect this role to operate, not a nice-to-have

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years in growth or demand generation at a B2B SaaS company, with hands-on experience across web, paid media, and ABM, and real time spent generating pipeline for an enterprise sales team

 - Genuine design sense. You can direct creative and identify when something feels off

 - Strong instincts around Linear’s core audience (product and engineering teams), and you can speak their language

 - Disciplined with capital (anyone can throw dollars at problems), but you know when to double down

 - Fluent in measurement without being captive to it. You can build the reporting and argue the pipeline math, and still defend spend a dashboard will never really explain

 - Deep fluency with AI tooling. You default to automation and use it to do work that would otherwise take a team

 - Very well versed with attribution, but somewhat disillusioned with it. We’re not going to spend much energy defining attribution, we just need someone with good instincts

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - A story about our mission: Read Me https://linear.app/readme

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - Our CEO and co-founder, Karri at 20VC: How to Grow Capital Efficiently in a World of BS Growth https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vqDYkuzbSM

 - Make an Org Chart You Want to Ship — Advice from Linear on How Heirloom Tomatoes Should Inspire Team Design https://review.firstround.com/make-an-org-chart-you-want-to-ship-advice-from-linear-on-how-heirloom-tomatoes-should-inspire-team-design/

 - Building our teams: Why and how we do work trials at Linear https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear

 - A video series: Conversations on Quality https://linear.app/quality

 - Read about our recent Series C Fundraise https://linear.app/now/building-our-way and Giving our team liquidity https://linear.app/now/giving-our-team-liquidity-through-linear-s-first-tender-offer



Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

A note on recruitment fraud: all official Linear hiring communication comes from an @linear.app http://linear.app email address, and all open roles are listed at linear.app/careers http://linear.app/careers. We never ask candidates for payment or financial information. Suspicious messages can be reported to security@linear.app.

jobs.title: Myyjiä, S-market Pohjolankatu Iisalmi
jobs.description:
Primary location:
IISALMI

S-MARKET POHJOLANKATU IISALMI etsii nyt MYYJIÄ vakituisiin työsuhteisiin - ihan tavallisiin töihin, harvinaisen mukavien työkavereiden joukkoon

Sopimustunnit: 4-37,5 t/vk
Työt alkavat: sopimuksen mukaan syksyllä 2026

Työtä kuvataan usein korulauseilla, mutta meidän mielestämme tavallisuudessa ei ole mitään pahaa. Me Osuuskauppa PeeÄssällä sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä - eikä se tarkoita tylsää porukkaa, päinvastoin. Työ on hyvää ja sujuvaa arkea, jossa teemme myös muiden arjesta, ja välillä juhlastakin, vähän parempaa. Ja joskus juhlitaan itsekin. Jos työpaikkailmoitusten kliseet kyllästyttävät, tule meille ihan tavallisiin töihin.

S-market Pohjolankatu on Iisalmen keskustaan avautuva uusi kauppapaikka, jossa pääset mukaan rakentamaan myymälän toimintaa alusta asti. Uudessa S-marketissa luodaan yhdessä tekemisen tavat, jotka helpottavat niin asiakkaiden asiointia kuin tiimin yhteistä työskentelyä. Laajojen aukioloaikojen myymälässä päivät ovat monipuolisia ja vaihtelevia, ja jokaisen työntekijän panos näkyy heti. Onnistuminen syntyy siitä, että myymälä on kunnossa, asiakkaat kohdataan hyvin ja työkaverit pidetään mukana.

Myyjänä päiväsi kuluvat vaihtelevassa rytmissä kassatyön, kuorman purun ja hyllytyksen parissa - välillä olet myös asiakasetsivä, joka auttaa löytämään sen oikean jogurtin. Työhösi kuuluu lisäksi hävikin ja saatavuuden hallintaa, eli pidät huolen siitä, että hyllyt ovat täynnä ja hävikki pysyy mahdollisimman pienenä. Perehdytämme sinut monipuolisesti koko kaupan saloihin: kassasta kuormaan, kampanjoiden esillepanoon ja varaston hallintaan asti. Työ on liikkuvaa ja nopeatempoista, joten päivät kuluvat vauhdilla eikä tekeminen käy yksitoikkoiseksi.

Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos viihdyt asiakkaiden parissa, tartut hommiin reippaasti ja tykkäät tehdä töitä yhdessä muiden kanssa - ja jos arvostat poikkeuksellisen hyviä henkilökunta-aleja, kannustavaa työporukkaa ja sitä pientä ylpeyden tunnetta, kun asiakas lähtee kaupasta hymy huulilla. Työ on vuorotyötä, ja odotamme hakijoilta valmiutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa toimipaikan laajojen aukioloaikojen mukaan, myös öisin ja juhlapyhinä.

Edellytämme sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa.
Arvostamme kaupan alan työkokemusta ja koulutusta.

Mitä se ihan tavallinen työ meillä on
- Henkilökuntaetuja: alennuksia ruoasta, juomasta, meikeistä, elektroniikasta, ravintoloista, hotelleista, pankkipalveluista ja monesta muusta mukavasta asiasta.
- Epassin etuja: jopa 250 € arvosta vuodessa.
- Rahaa: työehtosopimuksen mukainen palkka, 11,16 €/t - 14,93 €/t kokemusvuosista riippuen. Lisät tuovat kivasti extraa, ne maksetaan myös TES:n mukaisesti.
- Tulospalkkaus: mahdollisuus ansaita ylimääräinen jopa 2 kuukauden palkka vuodessa.
- Työpaikka, johon on kiva tulla ja olla. Ei tarvitse olla yhtä iloista perhettä, mutta älä ylläty, jos työkavereista tulee ihan vaan kavereita.
- Mahdollisuus vaihtaa tehtäviä tai alaa: jos itse haluat.

Jos ihan tavallinen työ hyvässä porukassa kuulostaa sinun jutultasi, hae mukaan jo tänään.

Hakuaika päättyy: 23.8.2026.

Lisätietoja: marketpäällikkö Mari Levoskin, mari.levoskin@sok.fi tai kenttäpäällikkö Joonas Marjanen, joonas.marjanen@sok.fi, puh. 050 348 6353


Osuuskauppa PeeÄssä on yli 134 000 asiakasomistajan omistama palvelualan yritys Pohjois-Savossa. Tavoitteenamme on olla Parhaan Elämän Edelläkävijä Savossa. Meille se tarkoittaa merkityksellistä työtä, reilua työnantajuutta ja arjen sujuvuutta. Olemme ylpeitä siitä, että voimme tuottaa osuustoiminnallista hyötyä ja kehittää sitä jatkuvasti arvojemme mukaisesti: #tunteella, #toimeliaasti, #ylpeästi ja #yhdessä.

jobs.title: Tekninen myyjä
jobs.description:
Tekninen myyjä, KTT Tekniikka Oy

**KTT Tekniikka Oyon osa ruotsalaista Beijer Tech -konsernia ja yksi Suomen luotettavimmista teollisuuden kunnossapito- ja huoltokumppaneista. Pidämme asiakkaidemme tuotannon käynnissä tarjoamalla teollisuuden huoltopalveluita, komponentteja, suunnittelua, projektinhallintaa sekä konepajapalveluita. Olemme Kumeran ja Jeffrey Raderin virallinen huoltokumppani sekä maahantuomme Jauren ja Samiflexin kytkimiä. Toimipisteemme sijaitsevat Kotkassa ja Lappeenrannassa, mutta palvelemme asiakkaitamme koko Suomen alueella.Kasvumme jatkuu, ja rekrytoimme nyt joukkoommeteknisen myyjän, joka haluaa rakentaa pitkäjänteisiä asiakassuhteita ja kasvattaa liiketoimintaamme.**

**TEKNINEN MYYJÄ Toiminta-alueena on Keski- ja Itä-Suomi. Voit työskennellä kotoa käsin tai toimipisteiltämme Kotkassa tai Lappeenrannassa.**

**Roolin painopiste on asiakkuuksien aktiivisessa hoidossa ja kehittämisessä. Olet paljon liikkeellä asiakkaiden luona, tunnet heidän tuotantonsa ja tarpeensa ja myyt KTT:n palveluita sekä edustamiamme komponentteja. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä teknisen myyntipäällikön kanssa, jolle myös tässä tehtävässä raportoidaan.**

**Työtehtäväsi:**

- Asiakkuuksien hoito ja kehittäminen toiminta-alueellasi: säännölliset tapaamiset ja liikkuminen asiakkaiden luona

- KTT Tekniikan palveluiden ja komponenttien myynti olemassa oleville asiakkaille

- Uusasiakashankinta alueellasi

- Asiakastapaamisten suunnittelu, sopiminen ja toteutus

- Tarjousten laadinta yhdessä sisäisten sidosryhmien kanssa


**Saat:**

- Vakituisen työsuhteen vakavaraisessa, kansainväliseen Beijer Tech -konserniin kuuluvassa ja kasvavassa yhtiössä

- Itsenäisen ja monipuolisen työn, johon voit aidosti vaikuttaa

- Mahdollisuuden osallistua myynnin kehittämiseen

- Kiinteän kuukausipalkan 3 500–4 500 €, riippuen koulutuksesta ja kokemuksesta

- Hyvän ja räätälöidyn perehdytyksen

- Lisäkoulutuksia tarpeen mukaan

- Kulukorvaukset oman auton käyttöön työmatkoilla

- Mahdollisuuden etätyöhön

- Epassi-henkilöstöedut


**Edellytämme:**

- Käytännön kokemusta teollisuudesta, esimerkiksi kunnossapidosta, huollosta, tuotannosta ja teknisestä myynnistä, jotta voit työskennellä itsenäisesti alusta lähtien

- Aktiivista ja oma-aloitteista työotetta: viihdyt liikkeellä ja asiakkaiden luona

- Vähintään 3 vuoden työkokemusta myynnistä teollisuusasiakkaille

- Sujuvaa suomen kielen kirjallista ja suullista osaamista

- Hyviä käytännön IT-taitoja

- Toiminnanohjausjärjestelmän tuntemusta (esim. Monitor)

- Oman auton käyttöä


**Eduksi luemme:**

- Kokemuksen komponenttimyynnistä tai teknisestä tukkukaupasta

- Valmiit kontaktit teollisuusasiakkaisiin Keski- tai Itä-Suomen alueella

- Muun kielitaidon


**Voit menestyä tässä tehtävässä, kun:**

- Olet yrittäjähenkinen ja hyvä asiakaspalvelija

- Olet hyvä tunnistamaan asiakkaiden tarpeita ja löytämään niihin ratkaisuja

- Olet ennakoiva ja hallitset hyvin ajankäyttöäsi

- Olet sosiaalinen, ulospäin suuntautunut, hyvä ja monipuolinen kommunikoija

- Olet taitava verkostoitumaan

- Sinulla on hyvä paineensietokyky

- Olet oma-aloitteinen ja motivoitunut ennen kaikkea hyvistä tuloksista


**Jos koet olevasi etsimämme henkilö, ole hyvä ja lähetä hakemuksesi viimeistään 7.9.2026 mennessä. Töiden aloittaminen sopimuksen mukaan, viimeistään 4.1.2027.**

jobs.title: Junior Planner
jobs.description:
Are you curious about how bestselling fashion products stay available in stores and online around the world? Do you enjoy working with data and finding solutions? If you're looking for a place where you can learn, grow and make an impact from day one, this could be your next step.

Join SELECTED's Essentials department as our new Junior Planner and become part of the team behind one of our most important business areas. Together, we ensure that our bestselling products are available when and where our customers need them, across international markets.

YOUR TEAM
Essentials is home to SELECTED's Never Out Of Stock programme, also known as NOOS. Here, we work to keep our bestselling products available throughout the year by balancing customer demand, inventory and product availability. To make that happen, we work closely with colleagues across Sales, Buying and Product, as well as with our international suppliers. 
You'll join a skilled and supportive team where knowledge is shared openly, responsibility comes early and you'll have plenty of opportunities to learn, develop and make an impact.

YOUR ROLE
As a Junior Planner, you'll help ensure that SELECTED's bestselling products are available throughout the year. By combining data, analysis and close collaboration with colleagues across the business, you'll see how every planning decision helps keep our bestselling products moving.
From day one, you'll contribute to the team's work while developing your analytical skills and commercial understanding. As you grow in the role, you'll gradually take on more responsibility and build your expertise within different planning disciplines. Depending on your development and business needs, you'll have the opportunity to specialise within areas such as demand planning or replenishment planning.

Your tasks will include:

  • Monitoring sales, stock levels and product availability across international markets

  • Analysing data and identifying trends that support planning and business decisions

  • Supporting forecasting, replenishment and purchasing activities

WE LOOK FORWARD TO HEARING FROM YOU

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations. You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win. If you're competitive, curious, and energised by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.

 


WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE

 - Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy

 - Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers

 - Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff

 - Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running

 - Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion

 


SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - Business fluency in English

 - Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels

 - Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response

 - Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations

 - Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models

 - High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritise based on signal and data, not just volume

 - You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

 


NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling

 - Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

Kannustamme sekä autamme henkilöstöämme kehittämään osaamistaan ja panostamme hyvään yhteishenkeen. Avaamme jatkuvasti uusia myymälöitä ja rekrytoimme uusia osaajia. Would you like to play a key role in shaping and delivering sustainability reporting in a leading Nordic retail group? We are looking for an experienced CSRD Reporting Expert to lead our CSRD reporting and reporting development projects. Position is in Tokmanni Group's Sustainability team and for a one-year parental leave replacement.

In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating and delivering Tokmanni Group's CSRD reporting and supporting the continuous development of reporting processes and practices. The position plays a key role in ensuring high-quality sustainability disclosures and compliance with evolving reporting requirements.

While the title includes project management responsibilities, we are primarily looking for a hands-on sustainability reporting professional. You have personally worked on CSRD reporting, collected and validated sustainability data, interpreted reporting requirements, and written report content. We are primarily looking for candidates who have hands-on experience preparing CSRD reports for listed companies, either in-house or in a consulting role. Success in this role requires both project leadership skills in cross company network and extensive hands-on experience in sustainability reporting, combined with deep practical expertise in the European Sustainability Reporting Standards (ESRS) and their application in corporate reporting.



Your key responsibilities

- Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of Tokmanni Group's CSRD reporting process
- Collect, analyze, validate, and manage sustainability-related data across the organization
- Prepare and develop sustainability report content in line with ESRS requirements
- Interpret sustainability reporting regulations and translate regulatory requirements into practical reporting actions
- Support the update and further development of the Group's Double Materiality Assessment
- Develop reporting processes, data management practices, and reporting tools
- Produce and review reporting materials in both Finnish and English
- Coordinate and review translations between Finnish and English to ensure consistency and quality
- Work closely with stakeholders across sustainability, finance, HR, procurement, legal, marketing, business operations, and external assurance providers.



What we expect from you

- Hands-on experience preparing CSRD reporting in a listed company or as a consultant supporting listed companies
- Proven track record in sustainability data collection, data management and drafting CSRD-compliant sustainability report content
- Deep and comprehensive expertise in the ESRS standards and demonstrated ability to apply them in practice within CSRD reporting
- Strong understanding of the sustainability reporting regulatory landscape and reporting frameworks
- Excellent written communication skills and experience drafting reporting content
- Fluency in both Finnish and English, with the ability to translate and adapt content between the two languages. Proficiency in Swedish is considered an asset.
- Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail
- A structured, self-driven, and solution-oriented way of working
- Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills, with the ability to drive progress without formal authority. - Ability to start working as soon as possible.

We also value experience in double materiality assessments, reporting system development, and knowledge of the retail or consumer goods industry.



What we offer

We offer you a unique opportunity to work at the heart of sustainability reporting in one of Finland's leading retail groups. You will have a visible and impactful role, working with a broad range of stakeholders and contributing to the development of Tokmanni Group's sustainability reporting and reporting capabilities.

You will join a friendly and supportive team where collaboration is valued and success is achieved together. We offer a flexible hybrid working model that combines office and remote working, enabling both effective teamwork and focused individual work.

In addition, we provide a competitive package of employee benefits, including ePassi, staff discounts, and a wide range of partner benefits.



Application instructions and further information

The position is a fixed-term parental leave replacement for one year. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found. The weekly working hours are 37.5 h/week. The primary workplace is Tokmanni Group's Head Office in Mäntsälä, Finland, and the role follows the Group's hybrid working model. Occasional travel within the Group may be required.

Please submit your application, CV, and salary expectation as soon as possible or at the latest on August 28th. We will review applications during the application period and fill the position immediately once the right candidate is found.

Further information will be given by Kaisa Matsson, Group Head of Sustainability tel. 040 6734948 or by email kaisa.mattson@tokmanni.fi. Please call on Wednesday Aug 19th 9-12 and Friday Aug 21st 10-13.

Tehtävässä pääset vaikuttamaan keskeisesti asiakaskokemukseen, tiimin toimintaan ja asiakaspalvelun tulevaisuuden toimintamalleihin. Tavoitteena on kehittää asiakaspalvelusta dataohjatumpi liiketoimintaamme tukeva kokonaisuus.

Kehität reklamaatioiden ja poikkeamien käsittelyä sekä koordinoit myynnin tukitoimintoja. Lisäksi vastaat raportoinnista ja suorituskykymittareiden seurannasta sekä edistät uusien data- ja AI-pohjaisten toimintatapojen käyttöönottoa. Tehtävässä työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä myynnin, logistiikan, tuotannon sekä muiden tukitoimintojen kanssa.

- kokemusta asiakaspalvelun ja palvelutoimintojen johtamisesta

- näyttöjä prosessien kehittämisestä ja toiminnan tehostamisesta

- vahvoja johtamis- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja

- asiakaslähtöistä ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta

- kykyä hyödyntää dataa toiminnan kehittämisessä

- soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa tai vastaavaa kokemusta

- sujuvaa suomen ja ruotsin kielen taitoa sekä hyvää englannin osaamista

- keskeisen roolin kasvavan Foodservice-liiketoiminnan kehittämisessä

- mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa asiakaspalvelun tulevaisuuden toimintamalleihin

- monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtäväkentän

- ammattitaitoisen ja eteenpäin katsovan työyhteisön

- mahdollisuuden kehittää sekä asiakaskokemusta että sisäisiä toimintamalleja

- kilpailukykyisen palkkauksen ja henkilöstöedut

jobs.description:
Job Number: R0246726

Facilities Planner

The Opportunity:

Seeking an energetic and skilled Facilities Planner to work at Indo-Pacific Region! Join our team to lead project planning, data analysis, and collaboration across Pacific installations. If you excel at multi-stakeholder coordination, strategic recommendations, and staff-level planning for military or OCONUS facilities, we invite you to help shape our mission and support operational objectives.

On our team, youâll work on challenging projects for sensitive missions from beginning to end while collaborating with senior leadership. Using computer-related facilities management software and your problem-solving skills, youâll help develop creative solutions for mission-critical projects.

In this role, youâll closely impact the mission byâ¯maintaining infrastructure in government space, such as power, heating, and cooling, closely involved in those aspects such as a government power outage. With mentoring, exposure to challenging projects, and opportunities to learn new tools and skills, we focus on growing as a team to make the best solutions for our customers.

Work with us as we facilitate projects that impact the mission for the better.

What Youâll Work On:

  • Analyze, formulate, and recommend facility standards and design and space criteria and usage through space utilization studies and forecasts for clients.
  • Lead analyses and solution development for facility planning and management.
  • Perform complex activities as related to the control and management of cost, schedule, risk, and resource optimization. Prepare and/or review facilities estimates and site proposals for client review as to cost and feasibility.
  • Work closely with clients to develop plans and programs responsive to present and anticipated portfolio and facility, or individual space requirements. Recommend planning, design, and construction standards or milestones.


Join us. The world canât wait.

You Have:â¯â¯

  • 2+ years of experience with planning, coordinating, and managing Military Construction (MILCON) and Unspecified Minor Construction (UMC) and understanding their processes through the Project Objective Memorandum (POM)
  • 2+ years of experience demonstrating and communicating with installations for planning concepts, principles, techniques, and practices of MILCON and UMC efforts
  • 2+ years of experience conducting data analysis and making recommendations regarding facilities planning and data-informed refinement of plans, methods, and techniques during the POM Cycle of MILCON and UMC projects
  • 2+ years of experience working in Pacific Region
  • Experience in using Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, to engineer complex data models, author formal studies, and design high-impact MILCON and UMC executive briefings
  • Knowledge of concepts, principles, techniques, and practices related to master planning, installation planning, facilities planning, and Facilities Sustainment, Restoration, and Modernization (FSRM), or the civilian community equivalent, such as urban and regional planning, campus, or facilities planning
  • Ability to obtain a Secret clearance
  • Bachelorâs degree


Nice If You Have:â¯â¯

  • Experience with military planning or OCONUS Facility Planning
  • Experience in Lean Improvement, Planning, Data Analysis, or Management
  • Experience in conducting comprehensive staff-level planning to coordinate, validate, and advocate for multi-stakeholder requirements, ensuring installation capabilities directly supported tenant command operational objectives
  • Experience identifying facility-related needs, resources, and problems, and providing analytical assistance to military and civilian leaders in making decisions on goals, policies, priorities, plans, programs, and methods of implementation designed to support required activities of the installation
  • Experience working independently without specific guidelines to identify facility requirements and interpret, adapt, and apply policies, guides, procedures, regulations, and precedents to new or unique situations
  • Experience collaborating with higher level commands such as United States Forces Japan, Indo-Pacific Command, or Marine Forces Pacific
  • Secret clearance


Clearance:â¯

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allenâs benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individualâs particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience, as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compensation range for this position is $61,900.00 to $141,000.00 (annualized USD). The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is just one component of Booz Allenâs total compensation package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.

Identity Statement

As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.

Candidate AI Usage Policy

AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided.

Work Model

Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support engagement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Russian-speaking, hands-on Project Manager with strong Product Management skills to join a small, early-stage fintech environment. You will work directly with the CTO, engineering team, and business stakeholders to turn incomplete business ideas into clear product requirements, user flows, wireframes, prioritized backlogs, and executable delivery plans.   • Own backlog refinement and prioritization based on business value, urgency, risk, dependencies, and engineering effort.

  • Plan and coordinate sprints and releases while managing scope, blockers, risks, dependencies, and changing requirements.

  • Work closely with the CTO, engineers, and business stakeholders to clarify requirements, resolve product and technical tradeoffs, make practical decisions, and keep key changes documented.

  • Proven ability to turn vague business ideas into clear requirements, user flows, low-fidelity wireframes, and executable plans using Figma, Balsamiq, Miro, FigJam, Whimsical, or similar.

  • Comfortable working directly with CTOs and engineers, discussing technical constraints, challenging assumptions, and making product decisions in a fast-changing early-stage environment.

  • Strong written and spoken English; stable employment history, typically 2â3+ years per company, or credible explanations for shorter engagements.
