jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As a Software Engineer on Collections Infra, you’ll help scale the infrastructure behind Notion’s database block. Databases power views, boards, charts, forms, and the workflows customers use to run their companies; as Notion grows into larger enterprise deployments and AI-native work, those systems need to become faster, more reliable, and ready for much higher concurrency. This team sits between infrastructure and product, building backend architecture that improves the customer experience while becoming a platform other Notion teams can build on. You’ll work on problems like database load performance, microservices, high-volume writes from agents, and the flexibility that makes Notion databases powerful and hard to scale.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - By your 90th day, you’ll understand how Collections Infra supports Notion’s database block, ship improvements to database performance or reliability, and build context on the scale challenges behind larger enterprise workspaces and AI-driven write volume.

 - You’ll use AI as a real engineering collaborator: to learn unfamiliar systems faster, explore debugging paths, generate tests, summarize traces or logs, and pressure-test implementation plans before shipping.

 - You’ll contribute to the team’s work to make databases faster and more reliable at P95 scale, especially as customers build larger centralized databases with more concurrent usage.

 - By the end of your first year, you’ll have helped raise the quality bar for Collections infrastructure through better architecture, observability, documentation, or system boundaries that make future work easier to build on.

 - You’ll partner with senior engineers and product-facing teams to evolve Collections as a platform, balancing internal developer needs with the external customer experience of databases.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Strong backend engineering fundamentals, with interest in performance, reliability, scalability, and systems that need to hold up under real customer load.

 - Curiosity about distributed systems, microservices, and data-layer trade-offs; experience in these areas is helpful, but we care most about your ability to learn quickly and reason from first principles.

 - Practical comfort with JavaScript or TypeScript, or the ability to ramp quickly in a codebase where those tools matter.

 - Grit and truth-seeking in technical problem solving: you can iterate when the first approach does not move P50/P95 performance, and you’re motivated by finding the real bottleneck.

 - A self-guided learning style: you use docs, code, teammates, and AI to build context, ask better questions, and turn ambiguity into steady progress.






Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $150,000 - $200,000 per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.description:
ööadministraator

Tööülesanded: Klientidega suhtlemine: kõnedele ja kirjadele vastamine, info jagamine ja küsimustele reageerimine.
Külastajate vastuvõtt, sisse- ja väljaregistreerimine ning vajalike dokumentide vormistamine. Arveldamine erinevate maksevahenditega (sularaha, kaardimaksed, makselingid, arved). Hotelliprogrammi korrektne administreerimine: broneeringute haldamine, külaliste andmete uuendamine, aruannete koostamine. Broneeringute tegemine, muutmine ja kinnitamine telefoni, e-kirja või online-kanalite kaudu. Koostöö toateenijatega: saabumiste ja lahkumiste info edastamine, erisoovide koordineerimine. Jooksvate küsimuste lahendamine, info liikumise korraldamine ja operatiivne reageerimine ootamatutele olukordadele. Kliendirahulolu, ohutuse ja hotelli öise töö sujuvuse tagamine. Hotelli üldalade korrashoiu jälgimine (fuajee, koridorid, välisuksed). Öiste raportite koostamine ja vahetuse üleandmine päevasele administraatorile. Turvalisuse tagamine: külastajate liikumise jälgimine, kahtlaste olukordade tuvastamine ja vajadusel reageerimine vastavalt protseduuridele.

Omalt poolt pakume: Paindlikku vahetustega töögraafikut – võimalus töötada nii osalise kui ka täistööajaga.
Kohapealset väljaõpet, mis tagab kindlustunde ja oskused töö edukaks alustamiseks. Võimalust lõpetada katseaeg varem tubli töö korral ning saada palgalisa. Tasuta kohvi, teed ja joogivett igas vahetuses. Väikest, ühtehoidvat ja toetavat meeskonda, kus sinu panust märgatakse. Stabiilset töösuhet ja tööandja tuge igapäevastes tööülesannetes. Võimalust areneda hotellinduse valdkonnas ja võtta aja jooksul suuremaid vastutusalasid. Igakuist lisatasu vastavalt tehtud tööle. Võimalust töötada osalise tööajaga. Lähtuvalt hotelli asukohast on mugav ja soodne tööle tulla ka Harjumaa piirkonnast - kasutades transpordiks rongi. Kollektiiv on väike, rõõmsameelne ja kokkuhoidev.

Muud nõuded: Enne kandideerimist palume veenduda, kas teil on:
- positiivne ellusuhtumine ja valmidus teha öist tööd; - korrektsus ja paindlikkus; - riigikeele oskus.

jobs.title: Senior Automation Engineer, DK - Esbjerg
jobs.description:
Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:
  • Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
  • Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
  • Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
  • Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
  • Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
  • Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
  • Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
  • Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
  • Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
  • Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.

Your profile & qualifications
You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.
You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:
  • Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
  • Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
  • Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
  • Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
  • Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
  • Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
  • Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
  • Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
  • Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
  • Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.

Welcome to Semco Maritime 

At Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape. 

While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in. 

Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future. 

So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.  

We know that our people are our greatest strength. We strive to build an inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves, contribute their perspectives, and feel part of the team. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and believe that diverse teams help us find better solutions and move the energy transition forward.   

Care to join the movement? 
Change. With us. 

Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

jobs.title: Project assistant: Formulation development of novel tuberculosis compounds into long acting injectables at SDU in Odense
jobs.description:
A two-year position within pharmaceutical sciences focusing on formulation development and biopharmaceutical understanding of the performance of novel compounds for the treatment of tuberculosis is available at the Department of Physics, Chemistry, and Pharmacy in the pharmacy research group. 

Starting date: 01 October 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

Application deadline: 31 August 2026

Project background

Long-acting injectables (LAIs) are pharmaceutical products intended for weekly, monthly or with an even lower administration frequency, which provides a continued drug release and thereby a steady exposure of the delivered compound. LAIs are typically administered intramuscularly (IM) or subcutaneously (SC) as oil solutions, in situ forming gels, microspheres, implants, micro- or nanosuspensions, with focus on suspensions in the present work. For individuals suffering of tuberculosis LAIs can provide a huge benefit in disease treatment, due to the long duration time the disease requires. 

LAIs have, with huge clinical success, been applied in the treatment of antipsychotic conditions and the area contains some of the most successful LAI formulations seen from a therapeutic perspective. In the 1960s, oil-based parenteral depot formulations, containing antipsychotics, were introduced in the clinical practice. Since then, the micro- and nanosuspension technology has significantly advanced and many of the more recent LAIs are nano-or microsuspensions. Hence, this is currently one of the important technologies in the field of LAIs and also the focus of the present project. 

The common approach to manipulate the performance of LAI suspensions release rate relies on changing particle size distribution of the crystalline API. This strategy is fundamentally explained by the Noyes-Whitney equation, which describes the dissolution rate of particles in sink conditions. According to the Noyes-Whitney equation, the dissolution rate is proportional to the total surface area of the drug particles. Some commercial products confirms thus and also a few academical studies have reported correlations between the particle size and the in vivo release, hence it is clearly a point that should be clarified when working with a new compound for a LAI suspension. Aside from particle size, other formulation aspects can significantly impact performance, such as formulation composition and the level of flocculation. In addition, API crystal form properties, such as morphology, level of amorphous contents and residual solvent in the API, may have a significant impact on dissolution, indicating that the selection of version and form is crucial not only for manufacturability and stability purposes, but also for performance.

This project aligns closely with Quality by Design (QbD) principles, emphasizing risk assessment, formulation understanding, and robust design space development, but systematically investigating the formulation impact on in vivo release of LAI suspensions in nonclinical models using the obtained data to generate a risk matrix for in vivo impact of potential particle size variations. A successful outcome of this project will provide a formulation that can be taken to clinical trials for the treatment of tuberculosis with the tools to understand the biopharmaceutical performance of LAI suspensions with the relevant compounds supported by quality tools on the stability. 

The work will be conducted in close cooperation with Professor René Holm and other colleagues working on the project.

Qualifications

  • We are looking for a candidate with a strong interest in working with pharmaceutical formulation and evaluation focused on formulation and characterization of suspensions. 

  • The candidate will hold a BSc, a M.Sc. in pharmacy, chemistry, or closely related area. 

  • Previous experiences with one or more of the following are considered an advantage: 

    • formulation design of suspensions, 

    • particle size characterization, 

    • chemical stability studies,

    •  bioanalysis, and 

    • in vivo studies.

The candidate must be independent and fluent in English both orally and written. 

For further information about the position please contact Professor René Holm (reho@sdu.dk).

Natural Science Research – Interdisciplinary Strength

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science, SDU and is located in Odense. At the Department, we contribute to solving some of society’s greatest challenges within energy, environment, health, and sustainability. We succeed because we build bridges between disciplines and transcend traditional boundaries. Our interdisciplinary mindset is not only a fundamental condition, but also our strength. And it is a strength that ensures our research and education are recognized both nationally and internationally.

Our vision is to create and apply knowledge across the natural sciences. We are unique in housing research within physics, chemistry, and pharmacy under one department, which provides excellent opportunities to explore the intersections between these disciplines. Read more about our vision here.

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out.

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

We recommend that you read how to apply before you apply.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

jobs.title: Student Assistant in Architecture & Technology
jobs.description:
Are you studying IT, software engineering, computer science, or a related field and looking for a student position where you can work with enterprise architecture, documentation, and modern technology? At Nordic RCC, you will join a team helping build the digital foundations that support the Nordic power system and the green transition.

If you are looking to make an impact in supporting the green transition of the energy sector across Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark, you might be the person we are looking for.

Join a fast-developing Nordic company and become a part of an agile environment where we develop innovative solutions. Nordic RCC is an important contributor to the green energy transition, supporting the Nordic transmission system operators in ensuring efficient and secure operations of the Nordic electricity power system.

Your role

As a student assistant in Architecture & Technology, you will be part of a dynamic team that includes architects across multiple domains. In this role, you will support the Architecture & Technology team in documenting our architecture landscape and develop guidelines and standards for architecture documentation. You will work closely with Enterprise, System and Application Architects and gain first-hand experience of how architecture is used to guide technology decisions across a growing organisation.

What you will do

  • Assist the architecture team in ensuring the quality of existing documentation

  • Create architecture models according to standards and guidelines, and support in architecture modelling and documentation activities

  • Assist in implementation governance tools

  • Contribute to governance activities, including architecture reviews and assessments

  • Research emerging technologies, trends, and industry best practices

  • Prepare presentations, reports, and decision material for management and stakeholders

We’re looking for someone with

  • Relevant Background: You are currently pursuing a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Software/IT Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field

  • Collaborative Attitude: You enjoy working with others and are comfortable interacting with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

  • Interest in Architecture & Technology: You are curious about how organisations design, govern, and evolve their technology landscape

  • Structured Working Style: You have an eye for detail and enjoy creating order, structure, and clarity in documentation and information

  • Analytical and Curious Mindset: You have a strong curiosity for technology, and enjoy analysing complex topics, identifying patterns, and creating structure and clarity from information

  • Proactive Approach: You take initiative, ask questions, and are not afraid to explore new topics independently while seeking guidance when needed

Through this role, you will gain practical experience with enterprise, system, and application architecture, on-premises technologies, and technology strategy. You will have the opportunity to work alongside experienced architects and technology professionals while contributing to initiatives that support Nordic RCC's mission and the green energy transition.

The role is designed to provide meaningful hands-on experience, allowing you to apply your academic knowledge in a real-world environment while developing both your technical and professional skills.

The position will require approximately 10-15 hours per week, depending on your study workload. We are flexible during exam periods and expect that you have at least 1½ - 2 years left of your studies.

If you do not tick all the boxes, but think you could be a good match, don’t hesitate to apply for this position.

What We Offer: A Flexible and Inclusive Workplace

You will join a diverse organization of 25 nationalities, where inclusivity is celebrated, with more than 30% women on board (and a commitment to improving this balance). We are located in Copenhagen Towers office in Ørestad, with the flexibility to balance on-site and remote work 2 days a week.

At Nordic RCC, we live by the values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency—values defined by our employees that shape how we collaborate and innovate. If you see yourself thriving in such an environment, we’d love to hear from you.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note that the process includes any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to provide information to the same extent as the candidate for security clearance.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than 15 September. We will conduct interviews on a continuous basis. If you have any questions, please contact Camilla Schneider Bergman, Head of Architecture & Technology M: +45 29 11 16 39. (Not available until 1 September)

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include photographs in your CVs or application materials.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

jobs.title: Management Support Role to Service Operations - At the Heart of the Nordic Power System
jobs.description:
Are you motivated by supporting highly skilled engineers and contributing to the secure operation of the Nordic power system? Do you thrive in an environment where operational reliability, collaboration, and continuous improvement are essential?

At the Nordic Regional Coordination Centre, in the Service Operations department, you will work closely with a team of engineers delivering critical services to the Nordic Transmission System Operators around the clock. In the role, you will act as a daily sparring partner and facilitator for the engineering team, helping ensure effective coordination between control center duties and development activities outside the operator chair.

This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the security of supply and the Nordic green energy transition, while supporting the development of engineers working in a highly specialized operational environment.

Nordic RCC – supporting security of supply and the green energy transition

Nordic Regional Coordination Centre (RCC) provides critical services and insights to support the national Transmission System Operators (TSOs) in Finland, Norway, Sweden and Denmark — to ensure the efficient operation and use of the Nordic power system and high security of power supply at any time.

Based in Copenhagen, Nordic RCC is one of six RCCs in Europe, equally owned by the Nordic region's four electricity TSOs: Fingrid, Statnett, Svenska Kraftnät, and Energinet.

As European power systems integrate and evolve to meet climate goals, Nordic RCC provides regional coordination, integrated services, regional insights and recommendations to the Nordic TSOs and their control centres, to support cross-border operational security 24/7.

Join Nordic RCC, a fast-developing company determined to make a significant impact in the energy sector and to provide for a secure and efficient transition to the green, sustainable energy system.

Right now, we are looking for a management support role who would like to make a difference!

Job description:

You would be supporting an engineering team that works in a hybrid setup, combining:

  • Operator-on-shift roles in the Nordic RCC coordination centre, supporting Nordic TSOs around the clock

  • Work outside the operational shift including projects, operational follow-up, and continuous improvement activities

Your primary focus will be daily coordination, professional sparring, and supporting the development of effective structures and ways of working across the team, supporting and facilitating the performance of these roles.

You will NOT be part of the Operator on-shift roster, who is performing the coordination centre tasks and services 24/7.

The position does not initially include formal personnel management, as the engineers in the setup today report directly to the Head of Department in Service Operations. You will work closely with the Head of Department on topics like department structure and set-up, and by providing day-to-day coordination and operational support, as well as mentoring and sparring on subject matter topics with the team.

Responsibilities:

  • Driving department strategy and development in collaboration with the Head of Department (HoD) supporting effective coordination between coordination centre duties and non-operational activities, both within the team and externally towards other departments

  • Facilitating knowledge sharing, supporting and securing continuous training and collaboration

  • Supporting engineers in their professional development, and acting as a sparring partner, particularly those early in their careers

  • Identifying opportunities to improve structures, processes, and operational workflows

  • Supporting planning, prioritization, and follow-up across shifts, projects, and operational tasks

  • Contributing to continuous improvement of service quality and operational efficiency as well as securing the level of contingency and business continuity

  • The role will include sharing of responsibilities as part of 3rd line support with Head of Department as the department runs 24/7 operational services

Requirements:

You bring experience from a technical or operational environment and enjoy supporting the development and collaboration of highly skilled professionals.

We expect that you:

  • Have experience working in a technical, operational, or knowledge-intensive organization

  • Demonstrate strong ability to mentor, support, and collaborate with technical specialists

  • Have experience identifying and improving structures, processes, and ways of working

  • Are comfortable working in a complex environment with the responsibility of 24/7 operational services

  • Communicate clearly and effectively across technical and organizational boundaries

Additional beneficial competencies include:

  • Experience from the power system, electrical infrastructure, or energy sector

  • Engineering or technical background

  • Experience working in control centre or operational environments

  • Familiarity with organizations delivering 24/7operational services

We encourage you to apply even if you do not meet all the listed requirements.

What we offer

You will be joining a company of competent, diverse, and enthusiastic colleagues. We are currently 25 nationalities with over 30% women (striving to improve this balance) and all ages.

Your daily workplace will be in our newly furnished office premises in Copenhagen Towers, Ørestad. We offer workplace flexibility to ensure a healthy work-life balance, including the possibility to work from home some of the time. 

Our values of fellowship, curiosity, respect, and transparency have been defined by all employees. They identify how we behave and shape the way we work together, and we expect you to see yourself in them.

The position is conditioned upon a satisfactory background check as well as a national security clearance, both of which will be facilitated by Nordic RCC. You can read more on security clearance here. Please also note, that the process includes that any spouse, registered partner, cohabitant, steady partner, co-resident, child over 18 living at home and parent with the same address as the candidate must also consent to be examined.

Application deadline and contact information

Please apply online as soon as possible (in English) and no later than September 13th  2026. We may conduct interviews on a continuous basis.

A cover letter is not required, but we kindly ask you to include a few sentences in your CV explaining why you are interested in the position. Applications are only accepted through our online recruitment system.

To ensure a fair and unbiased recruitment process, we kindly request that you do not include a photograph in your CV or any other materials.

jobs.title: Front of House Manager – Diamond Slice
jobs.description:
Front of House Manager – Diamond Slice

Location: Copenhagen, Denmark (Nørrebro)

Position: Full-Time (37 hours / week)

Salary: 28,000 – 35,000 DKK / month (based on experience)

Start Date: As soon as we find the right candidate

About Diamond Slice

At Diamond Slice, we bring proper New York slice shop culture to Copenhagen. We elevate the humble slice with high-hydration sourdough, top-tier seasonal local ingredients, natural wines, craft beers, and cocktails—all served in a fast-paced, high-energy, welcoming neighborhood environment.  We pride ourselves on exceptional quality, great hospitality, and an unpretentious vibe.

We are growing and looking for a driven Front of House Manager to lead our floor operations, nurture our team culture, and deliver outstanding guest experiences.

The Role & Key Responsibilities

As FOH Manager, you will take ownership of the day-to-day guest experience, lead shift execution, and serve as a key operational anchor for both our daily service and special events.

  • FOH Leadership & Experience: Take ownership of the Front of House, ensuring smooth service flow, excellent atmosphere, and high operational standards.

  • Team Coaching & Motivation: Train, mentor, and inspire the FOH team to build a high-performing, friendly, and efficient service squad.

  • Guest Communication: Serve as the primary face and voice for guest interactions, handling feedback, special requests, and inquiries with warmth and professionalism.

  • Festivals & Events Logistics: Play a central, hands-on role in planning and executing logistics for outdoor festivals, pop-ups, and special catering events.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for an experienced hospitality leader who takes initiative, and thrives with autonomy.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years of experience in hospitality (with proven leadership or supervisory experience preferred).

  • Autonomy & Problem Solving: Self-motivated, proactive, and comfortable taking ownership to solve operational challenges independently.

  • Assertive Communication: Unafraid to speak up, bring issues to the table, and constructively challenge the status quo to make operations better.

  • Feedback Culture: Skilled and comfortable with both giving and receiving direct, constructive feedback with colleagues and leadership.

  • Guest-Centric Mindset: Genuinely loves host culture, high-energy environments, and personal interactions with guests.

  • Schedule Availability: Fully comfortable working evenings, weekends, and peak service hours.

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation: 28,000 – 35,000 DKK / month, aligned with your experience.

  • Flexible Schedule: High degree of scheduling flexibility, provided operations run smoothly and team coverage is secure.

  • Autonomous Role: Real freedom to shape FOH operations and make your mark on our growing brand.

  • Great Culture: A fast-paced, supportive, and passionate workplace with high standards and great pizza.

How to Apply

Ready to join the Diamond Slice team?

Please submit your CV along with a short introduction telling us about yourself and why you'd be a great fit for Diamond Slice to: work@diamondslice.dk

Note! Applications must include: "Diamond Slice FOH Manager" in the subject line to be considered.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and we will hire as soon as we find the right candidate.

jobs.title: Junior Embedded Software / Payload Engineer
jobs.description:
Want to work within sustainability and drones? Looking to be part of an innovative, fast-growing Danish greentech company with global reach? Then Explicit might be the place for you. 

Our tech team is looking for a new colleague to help build and improve the electronics that turn our drones into precision measuring instruments. If you enjoy hands-on hardware work in a greentech environment and want real ownership over what you build, we want to hear from you. 

About the job 

You will be part of a small, talented tech team, responsible for designing, building and maintaining our fleet of custom UAV deployed across the world to help map critical emissions. 

Responsibilities: 

  • Developing payload firmware that communicates with our drone systems (MAVLink / DJI) and onboard gas instrumentation and other sensors. 

  • Helping to bring new sensor instruments from datasheet to bench to flight. 

  • Improving and fixing existing payloads, diagnose issues on the bench and through in-flight data, harden the firmware, and ship the fix. 

  • Building small interface and breakout PCBs in KiCad, from assembly and bringing it up through to your own revisions. 

  • Potential for CAD and other mechanical work, depending on your qualifications. 

About you 

  • A bachelor's degree or similar/higher in electronics, robotics, computer engineering, mechatronics, physics or similar. 

  • 1+ years of hands-on experience, from your studies, a project, or a job. 

  • Tinker with Arduino/Raspberry Pi type projects. 

  • Wired up and used Serial/UART, I²C, SPI, etc., not just read about them. 

  • Basic C/C++ (or Arduino) and a bit of Python. 

  • English at a professional level. 

Nice to have 

  • Curiosity about drones, sensors and physical measurements. 

  • PCB design/KiCad experience, with signal/noise integrity knowledge. 

  • CAD and/or mechanical knowledge. 

  • Python for log analysis and quick tooling. 

  • Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement. 

What we offer 

  • A permanent, full-time position in a fast-growing greentech company with real-world impact. 

  • Competitive benefits including paid pension, health insurance, parental leave and 6 weeks' holiday allowance. 

  • Real hardware ownership early on, with a senior engineer to learn from. 

  • A flat hierarchy where ideas are heard, initiative is encouraged, and responsibility comes early. 

  • A close-knit, supportive team that values collaboration, trust and learning. 

  • Work that measurably cuts industrial emissions. 

About Explicit 

Explicit ApS is a pioneering Danish engineering company specialising in drone-based emissions monitoring across the energy, maritime, waste management, and other industry sectors. We deliver reliable, transparent and actionable emissions data to some of the largest energy companies all over the world using our patented drone-based methodology. Every measurement depends on the payload the drone carries: the boards, firmware, and sensors.

jobs.description:
About Us

We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals.

During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you!

Compensation Structure

This role is 100% commission-based, which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results.

Training Period (Weeks 1–4)

We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed:

  • Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes).

  • Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most.

    • Week 0: Unpaid

    • Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum

    • Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum

By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period.

Post Training Period:

  • Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually

  • Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually

*The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets.

What will you be doing?

Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit.

We are looking for team members who are:

  • Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily.

  • Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills.

  • Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently.

  • Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches.

  • Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure!

  • Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets.

  • Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you!

You will need:

  • Home office or a quiet place to work.

(*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system)

jobs.title: Campaign Manager, Brand
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s Integrated Marketing team connects our brand story to the world—ensuring that every campaign, launch, and experience builds on global awareness of Notion as the intelligent, AI-connected workspace for modern work. We're looking for an experienced, creative, and rigorous brand campaign expert who excels at conceptualizing innovative campaign strategies and bringing clarity to complex challenges.

 

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

The Campaign Manager, Brand brings Notion’s mission, product capabilities, and customer stories to life through targeted, insight-driven brand campaigns. This role is responsible for conceptualizing, developing, and executing integrated marketing programs that connect Notion’s core value props to the needs and aspirations of our customers—from individuals to global enterprises.

Reporting to the Campaign Lead, you’ll drive seasonal campaigns, brand activations, and special projects that aim to build excitement among both current customers and prospects. You’ll work closely with Product Marketing, Growth Marketing, and Creative to transform feature launches, product education, and customer insights into powerful, scalable brand moments that build understanding, drive conversion, and reinforce Notion’s position as the AI workspace for teams. Responsibilities include:

 - Lead cross-functional campaign execution, from concept to delivery, for both special brand projects and feature-led programs

 - Partner with Creative to generate out-of-the-box brand marketing concepts, breaking from the industry mold and encouraging blue sky thinking

 - Partner with Product Marketing to develop strategies that translate product value into meaningful narratives for the target audience of each activation or campaign

 - Partner with Growth Marketing to define the right mix of content, media, and channels to reach each segment effectively

 - Manage campaign briefs, creative deliverables, and timelines—ensuring clarity, accountability, and alignment across stakeholders

 - Integrate brand and performance media buying from planning through delivery and reporting

 - Define and track KPIs for each campaign, analyzing and sharing results and applying insights to optimize future programs

 - Ensure all campaigns maintain a cohesive Notion voice and brand expression, while adapting to audience needs and regional contexts




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 8+ years of experience in integrated or brand marketing, preferably in AI or tech, with proven success leading complex projects to fruition

 - Idea catalyst: You bring a concept-led approach and an opinionated point of view, sparking, shaping, and shepherding breakthrough concepts until they're undeniable

 - AI fluency: You have deep, first-hand experience experimenting with new AI tools, and are passionate about staying on top of fast-moving industry trends

 - Speed: You bias towards action and operate with ambition, creating processes that help cross-functional teams do the same

 - GTM expert: You have strong understanding of and passion for go-to-market planning, messaging, and storytelling for brand-driven campaigns

 - Collaborative: People on the projects you lead become the best versions of themselves by working with you, across product, creative, and data teams

 - Order agent: You possess strong organizational and analytical skills, with the ability to balance multiple work streams and deadlines at once while iterating for improvement




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Familiarity with hybrid audience targeting

 - Experience supporting global and/or regionalized campaigns

 - Experience using Notion—both personally and professionally



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Millions of people use Notion every day, and we’re growing quickly. The Infrastructure Security team’s mission is to build a secure-by-default foundation across Notion’s technical stacks—architecting systems that make the secure path the easy path. As an IC4 on this team, you’ll own meaningful infrastructure security problems end-to-end: from identifying risk, to designing pragmatic controls, to shipping secure defaults that scale across engineering.



This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

 - Participate in (and help drive) mitigation strategies during security-related incident response.

 - Empathetic communication: you communicate nuanced ideas clearly in writing and in real time; in disagreements, you engage thoughtfully and look for the right compromise.

 - AWS security best practices, zero trust architectures, and/or deep IAM expertise.

jobs.title: ein wissenschaftlicher Referent / eine wissenschaftliche Referentin (m/w/d) (Archäologe/Archäologin)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Bauforscher*in

Stellenbeschreibung:
Gestalten Sie die Zukunft der internationalen Forschung

Das Deutsche Archäologische Institut (DAI) ist eine weltweit führende Forschungseinrichtung im Bereich der Archäologie und Altertumswissenschaften. Es ist dem Auswärtigen Amt, einer obersten Bundesbehörde, nachgeordnet und leistet an seinen insgesamt 20 Standorten europa- und weltweit einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Schutz und Erhalt sowie zur Vermittlung von kulturellem Erbe. Sie finden uns im Internet unter http://www.dainst.org (http://www.dainst.org) .

An der Abteilung Madrid des Deutschen Archäologischen Instituts (DAI) ist zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt die Stelle

eines wissenschaftlichen Referenten / einer wissenschaftlichen Referentin (m/w/d)

(Kennziffer: 08/2026)

in Vollzeit im Rahmen eines unbefristeten Beschäftigungs- bzw. Dienstverhältnisses. Eine Teilzeitbeschäftigung ist grundsätzlich möglich. Gehen entsprechende Bewerbungen ein, wird für den Arbeitsplatz geprüft, ob den Teilzeitwünschen im Rahmen der dienstlichen Möglichkeiten (insbesondere hinsichtlich der Anforderungen des Arbeitsplatzes und der gewünschten Gestaltung der Teilzeit) entsprochen werden kann.

Für Tarifbeschäftigte richtet sich das Entgelt beim Vorliegen der persönlichen Voraussetzungen bis Entgeltgruppe 13 TVöD Bund. Bei Vorliegen der laufbahn- und haushaltsrechtlichen Voraussetzungen besteht die Möglichkeit der Ernennung in das Beamtenverhältnis. Für Beamt*innen erfolgt die Besoldung bis Besoldungsgruppe A 13 BBesO. Bei Tarifbeschäftigten des Bundes sowie Beamtinnen und Beamten ist zunächst eine Abordnung mit dem Ziel der Versetzung zum DAI vorgesehen. Der Dienstort ist Madrid.

Das Arbeitsgebiet der Abteilung Madrid umfasst Spanien, Portugal und Marokko. Dieser geografische Raum bildet mit der Meerenge von Gibraltar eine zentrale Brücke zwischen Europa und Afrika sowie zwischen der Mittelmeerwelt und der Atlantikküste. Die Abteilung widmet sich der Erforschung von rund 7.000 Jahren Archäologie in diesen Kulturzonen, vom Neolithikum bis zum Beginn der Neuzeit. Seit ihrem Bestehen hat die Abteilung Madrid leistungsfähige Forschungsinfrastrukturen aufgebaut. Dazu zählen eine der größten archäologischen Fachbibliotheken der Iberischen Halbinsel mit mehr als 90.000 Bänden, umfangreiche Archiv- und Fototheksbestände sowie eine Forschungsstelle in Lissabon.

Aufgabenbeschreibung

Der Aufgabenbereich umfasst insbesondere:

- Entwicklung eigener Forschungsfragen im westlichen Mittelmeerraum (mit Fokus auf Austausch- und Entwicklungsprozesse zwischen Nordafrika und der Iberischen Halbinsel).
- Konzeption und Leitung eines eigenen Forschungsprojektes in Nordafrika (in Marokko und/oder Algerien).
- Leitung und Koordination des Forschungsdatenmanagements und des Archivs/Fotothek der Abteilung
- Capacity building und Netzwerkarbeit, z. B. Durchführung von Schulungen und/oder Summerschools und Mitwirkung in der Verbundforschung des DAI, (z. B. TANA-Netzwerk, TANMed).
- Eigenverantwortliche Budgetplanung und Mittelabrechnung für die betreuten Projekte und Arbeitsbereiche.
- Fachliche Leitung unterstellter Mitarbeiter sowie Anleitung von Hilfskräften und Praktikanten.
- Einwerbung von Drittmitteln.

Ihr Profil

Vorausgesetzt werden:

- Ein mit hervorragender Promotion abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium auf dem Gebiet der Archäologie (Ur- und Frühgeschichte/Vor- und Frühgeschichte, Klassischen Archäologie, Archäologie der römischen Provinzen, Spätantike und frühes Christentum/Christliche Archäologie) oder Bauforschung.
- Deutsch verhandlungssicher in Wort und Schrift (mind. Niveau C2).
- Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Forschungs- und/oder Feldforschungsprojekten in Nordafrika.
- Erfahrung im Bereich Forschungsdatenmanagement und/oder in der Arbeit mit wissenschaftlichen Archiven/Fototheken.
- Vorlage eines überzeugenden Konzeptes zu den wissenschaftlichen Perspektiven und Capacity building für die ersten drei Jahre der Anstellung.

Wir freuen uns über:

- Kenntnisse einer für den Forschungsraum relevanten Sprachen bzw. Bereitschaft zum Erlernen dieser Sprachen.
- Bereitschaft zur Koordinierung von Arbeitsgruppen, Kolloquien und Mitarbeit in internationalen Kooperationen.
- Bereitschaft zum aktiven Auslandsdienst, d. h. internationale Kontaktpflege in Spanien und Nordafrika, enge Zusammenarbeit mit den deutschen Auslandsvertretungen in den Gastländern, Teilnahme an institutseigenen Kolloquien, Tagungen usw.

Als Mitarbeiterin oder Mitarbeiter des DAI bringen Sie eine hohe Sensibilität für Gleichstellung und Antidiskriminierung mit. Sie verfügen über interkulturelle Kompetenz und sind in der Lage, mit Menschen unterschiedlicher Herkunft respektvoll und offen zu kommunizieren und zu kooperieren.

Ihre Vorteile:

Abwechslungsreiche und kulturnahe und Aufgaben

Sie arbeiten in einer national wie international angesehenen Forschungseinrichtung des Bundes, die die weltweite Forschung und Nachwuchsförderung, den Schutz von kulturellem Erbe sowie die kulturelle Verständigung und Zusammenarbeit zum Ziel hat.

Arbeitsplatzsicherheit

Auch in Krisenzeiten bieten wir Ihnen ein sicheres Beschäftigungsverhältnis im öffentlichen Dienst.

Flexibles und familienfreundliches Umfeld

Wir fördern eine gute Vereinbarkeit von Beruf, Familie und Pflege durch:

• flexible Arbeitszeiten (Rahmenarbeitszeit von 6:00 bis 22:00 Uhr)

• Gleitzeit mit Stundenausgleich (z. B. durch Gleittage)

• Möglichkeiten zur Teilzeit und mobilen Arbeit

• kostenfreien Familienservice mit Beratungs- und Vermittlungsangeboten.

Motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld

jobs.title: Vice President Turbo Charging Research & Development (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a highly skilled, strategic and innovative Vice President R&D to lead and manage the research and development of new turbocharging products, components, and technologies within our organization.

In this role, you will be responsible for overseeing the entire R&D process, including product performance testing, validation, and ensuring product safety and reliability. You will lead a team of ca 120 R&D employees and manage a budget of over 50 MUSD. You will collaborate closely with the division presidents and other senior leaders to ensure that all product releases meet the highest standards before launch. You and your experts will also support the process of technology scouting beyond turbocharging. Located in Baden, you will report to the CEO and be part of the extended management team.  

Your Responsibilities:

1. R&D Strategy and Leadership:

Lead and manage the turbocharging R&D department to drive the development of new products, components, technologies and engineering methodologies aligned with the company’s strategic goals.
Define and execute the TC R&D strategy ensuring it supports the company's vision and objectives.
Foster an innovative environment that encourages creative solutions, research breakthroughs, and efficient development processes.
Secure that the R&D budget is spent efficiently on related projects and initiatives.
Represent the company in industry organizations and initiatives, (eg. CIMAC Greenhouse Gas Strategy Group, Swissmem industry sector for the internal combustion engine industry), and support the Swiss IMO delegation.
2. Product Development and Innovation:

Oversee the development of new products from concept through to prototype, ensuring that each product meets performance, safety, and reliability standards.
Manage the research and design process to ensure efficient, cost-effective product development that reflects the customer needs and is in line with Accelleron Product Market Strategy.

3. Product Performance Testing and Validation:

Ensure that robust testing and validation processes are in place to assess product performance and reliability with adherence to safety and quality standards.
Maintain and continuously develop testing and computing infrastructure.
Focus on improving product performance, reliability and safety.
Identify potential risks and implement corrective actions throughout the product lifecycle.

4. Collaboration with Management:

Work closely with the Division Presidents and senior management to ensure alignment on product development goals and timelines.
Jointly approve and sign-off on all product releases with the Division Presidents to ensure that all products meet the required standards before market launch.
Enhance the opportunities that AI provides in collaboration with AI organization.
Collaborate with Vice President Strategy and Investor Relations on scouting of new technologies.

5. Continuous Improvement:

Identify opportunities for process improvements within the R&D department and across the organization to optimize efficiency and productivity.
Stay current on industry trends, research methodologies, AI and emerging technologies to maintain competitive advantage and drive innovation.
Build and maintain networks with diverse stakeholders such as universities, research institutions and associations to gain broad perspective of development and to represent the company.

6. Leadership and Development:

Lead, mentor, and manage the R&D team, ensuring that each member is supported in their professional development and empowered to contribute to the team’s success.
Secure that competences needed now and in the future are acquired and developed.
Foster a collaborative, high-performance and effective safety culture within the department.

​Your Qualifications:

In depth and proven knowledge of turbocharging technologies and research methodologies including an advanced degree in mechanical engineering.
Robust experience of leading R&D operations and engineering globally across a complex technology portfolio.
Strong track record of creating and leading technology strategies, investment prioritization and innovation portfolios, preferably on enterprise level and closely aligned with business strategy.
Experience of repeatedly leading technology development from concept through validation to market introduction, especially leading turbocharger programs successfully converting innovation into commercial outcomes.
Deep understanding of product performance testing, validation, safety, and reliability assessments as well as regulatory compliance.
Exceptional stakeholder and influencing skills based on having regularly interfaced with executive leadership, government agencies, universities, industry consortia and regulatory bodies while advising on technology and policy topics.
Excellent leadership skills with collaborative and people-focused leadership style proven in successfully leading sizable global teams.
Future technology and innovation orientation combined with strong business and investment acumen.
Curiosity, learning agility and entrepreneurial mindset.

Your benefits:

Attractive compensation & benefits
Employee Assistance Program
Global parental leave program
Flexible working models
We look forward to receiving your application. If you want to discover more about Accelleron, take another look at our website accelleron.com.

jobs.title: AI Product Counsel
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

As an AI Product Counsel on the Product and IP Legal team, you’ll focus on advising our AI product development team as they build and ship AI functionality—covering everything from product counseling for launches to accelerating AI partnership deals. This role exists because Notion is building the AI workspace that helps every person and team get more done, with intelligence embedded across the tools they use to think, create, and collaborate. We’re bringing frontier intelligence to the “Fortune 5 million,” across an unusually broad surface area (models, workflows, features, and platform). This role is central to that effort. This role reports to our Head of Product and IP Legal and will work closely day-to-day with our Lead AI Product Counsel.

 

This role will be based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Accelerate partnerships for AI product development: collaborate with cross functional stakeholders to streamline and de-risk the partnership path, including model reviews, procurement and evaluation agreements.

 - Value add AI product development: provide pragmatic, product-oriented counsel that helps teams ship AI features and iterations quickly and responsibly. Monitor and translate emerging AI regulations into practical product guidance, launch requirements, and risk-based recommendations for cross-functional teams.

 - Support customer-facing AI questions by partnering with Sales, Privacy, Security, and Product to provide clear, accurate responses on Notion AI capabilities, safeguards, and commitments.

 - Pitch in to provide product legal support across the business as bandwidth allows.

By day 90, you’ll…

 - Build strong context on Notion AI’s product surface, roadmap, and risk posture, with trusted relationships across AI Product, Engineering, Privacy, Security, Procurement, and GTM.

 - Ship a practical AI contracting and model-review playbook that helps teams move quickly on vendor deals, model launches, and evaluation agreements without re-litigating the same questions.

 - Start using AI in your own practice to draft redlines, summarize risk positions, maintain reusable clauses, and spot issues faster across AI vendor and product work.

By the end of year 1, you’ll…

 - Establish a scalable AI legal operating model for vendor procurement, model approvals, product counseling, regulatory tracking, and customer-facing AI questions.

 - Become a go-to advisor for AI launches at Notion, translating fast-moving product, regulatory, and customer trust issues into clear recommendations and durable guardrails.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - 5+ years of product counseling experience with a technology company and/or law firm (in‑house experience strongly preferred), including advising cross-functional teams on AI/ML-powered product development.

 - Experience reviewing and negotiating vendor agreements (including identifying risk and moving quickly from “issues” to workable paths).

 - AI and data licensing experience, with strong partnership across Privacy and Security to translate model, data, and customer requirements into practical product and vendor terms.

 - Sound judgment in ambiguity: make crisp risk calls, name trade-offs clearly, and keep teams moving.

 - Demonstrated curiosity about AI and a willingness to adopt AI tools to work smarter, move faster, and deliver better results. Developing your personal AI fluency is required for this role.

 - A Juris Doctor (JD) degree and admission to the California or ability to be registered as in-house counsel in California.




Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $230,000 - $260,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550. https://dev.notion.so/a3ce416456924276a59de91bca740028?pvs=21



#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Demand Generation Lead, Growth
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America and Europe, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Over the last year we’ve made a lot of progress producing quality content and messaging, and we’re now looking for someone to help us distribute it to the right audiences.

As Demand Generation Lead, you’ll own how future customers find and first experience Linear, across web, search, and paid media. Your objective is to build awareness and pipeline, particularly with larger companies.

It’s likely this role will operate and feel a little different to what you might find elsewhere. Linear is a very brand forward company, so there will be scenarios where we have to turn down seemingly great opportunities to protect perception. We’re unlikely to ever use retargeting pixels and gated content, for example.

We’ve got a basic demand motion in place today but we’ve barely scratched the surface. As the first demand generation hire, you’ll own the strategy and lead on delivering it.

The marketing team is small but has an outsized impact, and we intend to keep it that way. You’ll have real influence on how Linear grows, and you’ll be encouraged to take ownership and deploy tooling and practices that help you be more effective.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in the US and Europe. You can work from anywhere within those regions. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you’ll do

 - Work with Magic, our in-house design team, on the web pages and ad creative that future customers see first

 - Own paid media end to end, from channel strategy and budget to the creative itself, including account-based campaigns for enterprise accounts in partnership with sales and event marketing

 - Own search, both the classic kind and the answers AI gives when someone asks which tools to use

 - Define how we measure success for this motion

 - Use AI and automation tools actively to move faster and do more. This is a core part of how we expect this role to operate, not a nice-to-have

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years in growth or demand generation at a B2B SaaS company, with hands-on experience across web, paid media, and ABM, and real time spent generating pipeline for an enterprise sales team

 - Genuine design sense. You can direct creative and identify when something feels off

 - Strong instincts around Linear’s core audience (product and engineering teams), and you can speak their language

 - Disciplined with capital (anyone can throw dollars at problems), but you know when to double down

 - Fluent in measurement without being captive to it. You can build the reporting and argue the pipeline math, and still defend spend a dashboard will never really explain

 - Deep fluency with AI tooling. You default to automation and use it to do work that would otherwise take a team

 - Very well versed with attribution, but somewhat disillusioned with it. We’re not going to spend much energy defining attribution, we just need someone with good instincts

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - A story about our mission: Read Me https://linear.app/readme

 - How we work: Designing remote work at Linear https://linear.app/now/designing-remote-work-at-linear

 - Our CEO and co-founder, Karri at 20VC: How to Grow Capital Efficiently in a World of BS Growth https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4vqDYkuzbSM

 - Make an Org Chart You Want to Ship — Advice from Linear on How Heirloom Tomatoes Should Inspire Team Design https://review.firstround.com/make-an-org-chart-you-want-to-ship-advice-from-linear-on-how-heirloom-tomatoes-should-inspire-team-design/

 - Building our teams: Why and how we do work trials at Linear https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear

 - A video series: Conversations on Quality https://linear.app/quality

 - Read about our recent Series C Fundraise https://linear.app/now/building-our-way and Giving our team liquidity https://linear.app/now/giving-our-team-liquidity-through-linear-s-first-tender-offer



Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

A note on recruitment fraud: all official Linear hiring communication comes from an @linear.app http://linear.app email address, and all open roles are listed at linear.app/careers http://linear.app/careers. We never ask candidates for payment or financial information. Suspicious messages can be reported to security@linear.app.

jobs.title: Køkken souschef søges til Muban Thai Roskilde
jobs.description:
KØKKEN SOUSCHEF SØGES TIL THAIRESTAURANT

Vi søger en dygtig og engageret køkken souschef, som har lyst til at blive en vigtig del af den daglige drift i vores thairestaurant.

Du bliver en central person i køkkenet og arbejder tæt sammen med køkkenchefen og resten af teamet. Vi leder efter dig, der har passion for det thailandske køkken, tager ansvar og kan bevare overblikket, når tempoet er højt.

Om restauranten

Vi er en thairestaurant med fokus på autentiske smage, gode råvarer og retter tilberedt med respekt for det traditionelle thailandske køkken.

I køkkenet arbejder vi blandt andet med wokretter, curries, nudler, risretter og forskellige klassiske thailandske specialiteter. For os er kvalitet, smag og konsistens afgørende, og vi lægger stor vægt på, at gæsterne får den samme gode oplevelse hver gang.

Restauranten tilbyder både servering i restauranten og takeaway, og derfor kræver hverdagen et køkken, hvor samarbejde, planlægning og effektivitet går hånd i hånd.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

Som køkken souschef vil du blandt andet:

  • Støtte køkkenchefen i den daglige ledelse og koordinering af køkkenet

  • Tage ansvar for køkkendriften, når køkkenchefen ikke er til stede

  • Koordinere arbejdsopgaver og sikre et effektivt flow under travl service

  • Sikre, at retterne lever op til restaurantens krav til smag, kvalitet og præsentation

  • Deltage aktivt i tilberedning, produktion og mise en place

  • Planlægge prep og fordele arbejdsopgaver blandt køkkenpersonalet

  • Introducere, oplære og støtte nye medarbejdere

  • Bidrage til et godt samarbejde og en positiv arbejdskultur i køkkenet

  • Kontrollere varemodtagelse, lagerbeholdning og korrekt opbevaring af råvarer

  • Arbejde aktivt med at begrænse madspild og sikre et fornuftigt vareforbrug

  • Overholde og følge gældende regler for hygiejne, egenkontrol og fødevaresikkerhed

  • Bidrage med idéer til udvikling og forbedring af retter og menuer

We are looking for a skilled and motivated Kitchen Sous Chef to become an important part of the daily operation of our Thai restaurant.

As Sous Chef, you will work closely with the Head Chef and the rest of the kitchen team. We are looking for someone who is passionate about Thai cuisine, takes responsibility and is able to stay organised and focused in a fast-paced kitchen environment.

About the restaurant

We are a Thai restaurant focused on authentic flavours, quality ingredients and dishes prepared with respect for traditional Thai cuisine.

Our kitchen prepares a variety of dishes, including wok dishes, curries, noodles, rice dishes and classic Thai specialities. Quality, flavour and consistency are very important to us, and we aim to provide our guests with a great experience every time they visit or order from us.

We offer both dine-in service and takeaway, which means that teamwork, planning and efficiency are essential parts of our daily kitchen operation.

Your main responsibilities

As Kitchen Sous Chef, your responsibilities will include:

  • Supporting the Head Chef with the daily management and coordination of the kitchen

  • Taking responsibility for kitchen operations when the Head Chef is not present

  • Coordinating tasks and maintaining an efficient workflow during busy service periods

  • Ensuring consistent standards of taste, quality and presentation

  • Taking an active part in food preparation, production and mise en place

  • Helping reduce food waste and maintaining efficient use of ingredients

  • Ensuring compliance with food hygiene and food safety procedures

  • Contributing ideas for new dishes and menu development

  • Helping maintain an organised and efficient kitchen during both normal and busy service periods

About you

We are looking for someone who:

  • Has relevant experience from a professional kitchen

  • Preferably has experience with Thai or other Asian cuisine

  • Has experience with, or an interest in, supervising and coordinating kitchen staff

  • Can work independently while also being a strong team player

  • Is organised, reliable and responsible

  • Can remain calm and prioritise tasks during busy periods

  • Has a strong focus on quality and consistency

  • Preferably has knowledge of wok cooking, curries and traditional Thai flavour profiles

  • Understands food hygiene and food safety requirements

  • Is flexible regarding working hours and responsibilities

  • Can communicate in English. Knowledge of Thai is an advantage but is not required.

We offer

  • A permanent full-time position of 37 hours per week

  • An important role with responsibility and influence on daily kitchen operations

  • A professional and informal working environment focused on teamwork and quality

  • The opportunity to work with authentic Thai cuisine

  • Opportunities for professional and personal development

  • Varied responsibilities and working days

  • Flexible shift planning

  • Salary based on experience and qualifications

We are looking for a Sous Chef who enjoys taking responsibility, working as part of a team and contributing to the continued development of both the kitchen and the restaurant.
